abilities.name: Moon Blessing
abilities.description:
Each time Miya hits a target with her Basic Attack, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4s. Stacks up to 5 times.

After reaching full stacks, Miya summons a Moonlight Shadow with each Basic Attack that deals 30 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

abilities.name: Moon Arrow
abilities.description: Miya shoots two extra arrows with each Basic Attack, dealing 10/15/20/25/30/35<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the target enemy and 30% damage to nearby targets. This effect lasts 4/5/6/7/8/9s. Each extra arrow inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

abilities.name: Arrow of Eclipse
abilities.description: Miya launches an empowered arrow on the target area, dealing 270/300/330/360/390/420<scaleAD> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s. The arrow then splits into 6 scattering minor arrows, each dealing 40/53/66/79/92/105<scaleAD> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

abilities.name: Hidden Moonlight
abilities.description:
Miya removes all debuffs on her and conceals herself, gaining 65% extra Movement Speed. This state lasts 2s or until she launches an attack.

Miya gains full stacks of Moon Blessing upon leaving the state.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Miya's Ultimate first to conceal herself, then find an ideal position to attack the enemy and quickly stack her Passive. Utilize her 2nd Skill to immobilize the enemy and activate her 1st Skill to enhance her Basic Attacks to hit multiple targets at once.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: When laning, immobilize the opponent with Miya's 2nd Skill and use her 1st Skill to poke them and clear Minions at the same time.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Miya counters heroes who rely on targeted CC effects, such as Saber and Eudora, because she can easily escape their CC and respond with a strong counterattack. The split arrows from her 1st Skill are also very effective against heroes that summon units, such as Sun.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Miya is countered by heroes with a lot of AOE damage, such as Pharsa and Yve, because they can still hit her while she is concealed.

abilities.name: Bloodthirst
abilities.description: Balmond recovers 5% Max HP after killing a minion or creep, and 10% Max HP on a kill or assist.

abilities.name: Soul Lock
abilities.description: Balmond charges in the target direction for a set distance or until he hits an enemy hero, dealing 150/175/200/225/250/275<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies along the way. The enemy hero hit will be knocked back slightly, and have their Movement Speed reduced by 40% for 3s.

abilities.name: Cyclone Sweep
abilities.description:
Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 30/35/40/45/50/55 (+1.3% Total HP) (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times.

Each hit reduces the target's Physical Defense by 5% (up to 40%).

abilities.name: Lethal Counter
abilities.description:
Balmond unleashes a huge strike in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing True Damage equal to 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) plus 30/37.5/45% of the target's lost HP.

This skill only deals up to 1000/1500/2000 damage to non-hero units.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Balmond can close in on the enemy with Soul Lock, follow up with Cyclone Sweep for continuous damage, then cast his Ultimate to finish off low HP enemies.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Balmond can close in on the enemy with Soul Lock, follow up with Cyclone Sweep for continuous damage, then cast his Ultimate to finish off low HP enemies.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Balmond is best with Support heroes that can boost his Mobility and Survivability. Examples include Angela and Rafaela.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Balmond is strong against squishy heroes who lack the ability to escape once he closes the gap on them, such as Layla and Eudora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Balmond is countered by ranged heroes who can deal damage to Balmond outside of his attack range, such as Lesley and Irithel.

abilities.name: Enemy's Bane
abilities.description: Saber's attacks reduce enemies' Physical Defense by 3-8 for 5s on hit. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

abilities.name: Orbiting Swords
abilities.description:
Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deals 75/85/95/105/115/125 (+25% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies on hit. The sword will retract back to him after the duration

While active, Sword attacks deal 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and 50% damage to enemies along the path (damage reduced to 50% against minions). Each sword attack reduces the cooldowns of Orbiting Swords by 0.5s and Charge by 1s.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75/90/105/120/135/150<scaleAD> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies along the way while enhancing his next Basic Attack. Saber can dash to the target, and his enhanced Basic Attack deals 75/90/105/120/135/150<scaleAD> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slows the target by 60% for 1s.

abilities.name: Triple Sweep
abilities.description: Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience) and striking them 3 times over the duration. The first two strikes deal 120/170/220<scaleAD> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> each, while the third strike deals 240/340/440<scaleAD> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Saber can use his 1st Skill to poke and weaken the enemy, follow with his 2nd Skill to close in, then use his Ultimate to finish them off.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Saber can use his 1st Skill to poke and weaken the enemy, follow with his 2nd Skill to close in, then use his Ultimate to finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Saber works well with high-damage heroes who can help him burst down enemy heroes in teamfights, such as Kadita and Cyclops.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Saber's deadly combo makes him strong against squishy heroes, such as Layla and Eudora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Saber is countered by Support heroes with Survivability buffs, like Estes and Faramis.

abilities.name: Crimson Blood Banquet
abilities.description:
When Alice's skills hit, she gains 1 stack(s) of Crimson, lasting 4s. Once Crimson reaches 2 stacks, Blood Banquet activates, dealing 25 (+30% Total Magic Power) plus 0.5%-2.5% of the target's Max HP (scales with level) as Magic Damage to nearby units (hitting heroes with skills refreshes the duration) and recovering 10 (+3% Extra Max HP) HP for Alice every 0.5s.
While Blood Banquet is active, Alice gains 8% Movement Speed. Blood Banquet can deal up to 70(+10*Hero Level) Magic Damage to creeps.

abilities.name: Crimson Gleam
abilities.description: Alice fires blood energy forward, dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage>. Before the blood energy dissipates, this skill can be cast again to activate <highlight>Scarlet Shadow</highlight>, allowing Alice to blink to the blood energy's location.

abilities.name: Doom Waltz
abilities.description: Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350/390/430/470/510/550<scaleAP> (+130% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1s. If <highlight>Blood Banquet</highlight> is active at this time, it also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of <highlight>Blood Banquet</highlight>'s damage and healing Alice for the same amount.

abilities.name: Throne of Ruin
abilities.description:
Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%. After 1.5s, she descends with force, dealing 500/600/700 (+150% Total Magic Power) (+20% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1s.
While charging her Ultimate, Alice can only use Scarlet Shadow.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Use Alice's 1st Skill to poke the opponent and recast it to blink on top of them, then follow up with her 2nd Skill to CC the enemies and finish with her Ultimate to continue the attack.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use Alice's 1st Skill to poke the opponent and recast it to blink on top of them, then follow up with her 2nd Skill to CC the enemies and finish with her Ultimate to continue the attack.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: With her great sustainability in combat plus her mobility and CC, Alice counters heroes that lack burst and can't escape from melee enemies, such as Cecilion and Chang'e.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Alice is countered by heroes with Execute or Healing Reduction who can impede her from healing herself during the Ultimate. Heroes like Baxia or Martis can reduce her healing or kill her before she can heal.

abilities.name: Molina's Gift
abilities.description:
Upon taking fatal damage, Nana removes all debuffs on her and transforms, becoming untargetable and invincible, and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s. She also recovers 10% Max HP over the duration.

Nana can only transform once every 150s and cannot cast skills in the transformed form.

abilities.name: Magic Boomerang
abilities.description: Nana hurls her Magic Boomerang in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit on its way out and back. The boomerang deals 300/340/380/420/460/500<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the first enemy hit. For every additional enemy hit, the damage is reduced by 10% (max reduction of 30%).

abilities.name: Molina Smooch
abilities.description:
Nana throws Molina at the target location, dealing 250/275/300/325/350/375 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within range and Transforming enemy heroes hit into small animals.

If Molina does not hit an enemy hero, she will remain on the ground and chase the nearest enemy hero that comes into range, Transforming the first enemy hero she touches.

Transform: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 50% and Magic Defense by 30% for 1.5s. Transformed heroes cannot attack or use skills.

abilities.name: Molina Blitz
abilities.description: Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each time dealing 440<scaleAP> (+140% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies within and slowing them by 30% for 1s. Enemies hit consecutively will be stunned for 1s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Nana can use her 2nd Skill to slow the enemy first so she can hit and stun them with her Ultimate. She can then use her 1st Skill to finish off the low HP enemy.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Nana can use her 2nd Skill to harass enemy heroes and her 1st Skill to damage both enemy Minions and heroes, allowing her to poke enemies while farming.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Nana works best with heroes with CC skills, that will help her get the kills, such as Rafaela and Franco.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Nana's Passive gives her great survivability, making her strong against heroes with deadly combos, like Eudora and Kadita.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Nana can be countered by heroes with strong chasing abilities, like Zilong, Natalia, because they can chase Nana through her Passive duration.

abilities.name: Fearless
abilities.description:
Tigreal gains a stack of Fearless each time he uses a skill or is hit by a Basic Attack. After getting 4 stacks, Tigreal will consume all Fearless stacks to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from Turrets).

Attacks from Minions do not grant Fearless stacks nor trigger its effect.

abilities.name: Attack Wave
abilities.description: Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer and sends a shockwave that erupts 3 times in the target direction, each time dealing 270/320/370/420/470/520<scaleAD> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies along the fan-shaped area and slowing them by 20%/40%/60% for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Sacred Hammer
abilities.description:
Tigreal charges in the target direction, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge.

Use Again: Tigreal can use this skill again within 4s, dealing 280/300/320/340/360/380 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 0.6s.

abilities.name: Implosion
abilities.description:
Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, pulling nearby enemies to him and stunning them for 1.8s while dealing 600/800/1000 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects. The second half of the channeling can only be interrupted by Suppression.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Tigreal should cast his 2nd Skill to charge in and then pull the enemy team towards him with his Ultimate. At the end of his CC, cast his 2nd Skill again to extend it, then use his 1st Skill to deal damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Tigreal can use his 2nd Skill to charge the enemy target and knock them airborne by casting it again. He then finishes with his 1st Skill to deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Tigreal works well with heroes with strong initiation skills, that gives him a better chance to hit the enemies with his CC skills, such as Vexana and Odette.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Tigreal's Passive can negate enemy Basic Attacks, making him strong against heroes that deal damage with their Basic Attacks, such as Zilong and Freya.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: But as a melee hero, Tigreal is countered by Ranged Mage heroes like Chang'e and Zhask.

abilities.name: Pursuit
abilities.description:
After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Demon Hunter: Alucard deals 10% extra damage to Creeps.

abilities.name: Groundsplitter
abilities.description: Alucard rolls to the target location and slams his blade on the ground, dealing 270/290/310/330/350/370<scaleAD> (+85% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

abilities.name: Whirling Smash
abilities.description: Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345/390/435/480/525/570<scaleAD> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Fission Wave
abilities.description:
Passive: Alucard permanently gains 10/20/30% Hybrid Lifesteal.

Active: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10/15/20. Alucard gains 10/15/20 Hybrid Defense and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6s.

Use Again: Alucard releases a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 400/550/700 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description:
In teamfights, Alucard can cast his ULTIMATE to increase Lifesteal and mark enemies and then switch between 1st Skill and 2nd Skill
to follow Basic Attacks. Finally, use his ULTIMATE again for reaping kills.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Alucard can use his 1st Skill to deal damage and slow enemies first, and follow it with Basic Attacks for strikes. Then, he can use his 2nd Skill and follow it with Basic Attacks for more strikes.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: He's best with heroes with crowd control, such as Gatotkaca and Xavier, which makes up for his lack of powerful control abilities.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Alucard has great chase abilities and damage resistance, making him powerful against squishy Assassins like Harley and Aamon.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description:
But he can be countered by heroes with powerful control abilities like Franco and Johnson. If controlled, Alucard won't be able to steal HP
and can be easily eliminated.

abilities.name: Shadow Combo
abilities.description:
Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals extra True Damage equal to 100 plus 5 (+2.5% Total Magic Power)% of their lost HP (up to 2000 True Damage against creeps).

If the target is an enemy hero, the cooldowns of Karina's non-Ultimate skills are reduced by 1.5s.

abilities.name: Dance of Blades
abilities.description:
Karina enters the Dance of Blades state for 3.5s, during which she gains 45% extra Movement Speed, blocks all incoming Basic Attacks, and reflects 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage back to the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a cooldown of 0.4s).

Karina's next Basic Attack within the duration deals 150/165/180/195/210/225 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, slows the target by 45% for 1s, and is guaranteed to Crit. Casting the enhanced Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Dance of Blades state early.

abilities.name: Dance of Death
abilities.description: Karina launches a spinning slash, dealing 375/420/465/510/555/600<scaleAP> (+125% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Shadow Assault
abilities.description:
Karina dashes to the target enemy hero, dealing them 350/550/750 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, applying a Shadow Mark to them, and leaving a Shadowform behind them. The Shadow Mark and Shadowform both last 5s. If the enemy dies within the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset.

Use Again: Karina dashes back to the Shadowform's location, dealing 150/200/250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, close in on the enemy using Karina's 1st Skill and cut into their formation with her Ultimate. Use her 2nd Skill for a quick AOE followed by her Ultimate to dash back to her Shadowform. Finally, use her 1st Skill again and enhanced Basic Attacks to chase down enemies.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Karina's 1st Skill first to enter the Dance of Blades state and pounce on the enemy using the dash from her enhanced Basic Attack. Follow up with her 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks to trigger her Passive.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Karina works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, such as Tigreal and Faramis, since her Ultimate and 2nd Skill also hits anyone near her main target, setting them up to be chain killed by her Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Karina counters Marksmen that lack mobility, such as Layla and Hanabi, since her 1st Skill can neutralize their Basic Attacks and they can't escape her high mobility and burst damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Karina is countered by Tanky heroes with CC abilities, like Akai and Khufra because they can tank her damage, and protect their allies from her.

abilities.name: Tai Chi
abilities.description:
Akai gains a 25 (+5% Total HP) shield for 4s on each skill cast and marks enemy heroes and Creeps hit by his skills.

Akai's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+5% Total HP) extra Physical Damage to marked enemies.

abilities.name: Headbutt
abilities.description:
Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300/320/340/360/380/400 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. If Akai hits an enemy hero during this process, he'll knock them airborne for 0.5s and be able to roll in the Joystick's direction once.

Akai can cast Headbutt during Heavy Spin to quickly adjust his position.

abilities.name: Body Slam
abilities.description: Akai smashes the ground with his body, dealing 270/300/330/360/390/420<scaleHP> (+6% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2s.

abilities.name: Heavy Spin
abilities.description:
Akai removes all debuffs on him and spins for 4s, gaining Slow Immunity while continuously dealing 100/150/200 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemy heroes knocked back will knock back other heroes they collide with during the process.

Akai also gradually increases his Movement Speed by 70% over the duration. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Akai should use his 1st Skill to knock back the enemy, and roll into the enemy formation. Then use his Ultimate to disrupt the enemy formation, and continue to deal damage with his 2nd Skill after his Ultimate ends.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Akai should use his 1st Skill to knock back the enemy, and slow them down with his 2nd Skill, then spam his Basic Attack to deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Akai works best with heroes who can deal high burst damage as they can help him take down enemies caught in his Ultimate, such as Saber and Eudora.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Akai is strong against heroes with poor Mobility since he can easily catch and eliminate them with his Ultimate, such as Eudora and Odette.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Akai is countered by heroes with CC removers or transformation abilities that allow them to escape or counter Akai's Ultimate, such as Nana and Diggie.

abilities.name: Wasteland Force
abilities.description:
If no damage is taken within 5s, Franco gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% Max HP per second, and begins accumulating Wasteland Force (up to 10 stacks).

Franco will consume all Wasteland Force stacks on his next skill cast to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.

abilities.name: Iron Hook
abilities.description: Franco launches an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400/450/500/550/600/650<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and dragging them to Franco.

abilities.name: Fury Shock
abilities.description: Franco lashes out, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 300/330/360/390/420/450 plus 4% of his Max HP to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Bloody Hunt
abilities.description: Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8s and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50/60/70<scaleAD> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Use Flicker to reach key targets for his Ultimate. Follow up with 1st Skill to extend the CC, then 2nd Skill to deal damage and slow.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use 1st Skill to hook the enemy into a bad position. Follow up with 2nd Skill to slow, then Ultimate to suppress and secure a kill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Heroes with high burst damage such as Vale, Karina and Brody to take advantage of his CC.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Heroes with low mobility like Vale, Estes and Layla.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Heroes with high mobility or Control Immunity such as Wanwan, Fanny and Badang.

abilities.name: Shark Bite
abilities.description: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of <highlight>Tidal Energy</highlight> each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to <scaleAD> (+95% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> plus 4(+0.4*Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Crab Claw Cannon
abilities.description:
Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150/190/230/270/310/350 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and then 150% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10 (+10% Total Magic Power)% for 1s.

Every 100 Physical Attack Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.

abilities.name: Ale
abilities.description:
Bane chugs his ale, recovering 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) plus 5/6/7/8/9/10 (+1.5% Total Magic Power)% of his lost HP and gaining 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

Use Again: Bane spits venom in the target direction, dealing 140/180/220/260/300/340 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (scales up to 200% with charging time) to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Every 100 Magic Power Bane possesses additionally reduces this skill's cooldown by 7%.

abilities.name: Deadly Catch
abilities.description:
Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in the target direction, dealing 700/900/1100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, knocking them airborne for 0.8s, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3s).
This skill deals 40% damage to turrets.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Bane's 2nd Skill to close in and catch multiple enemies with his Ultimate. Use an enhanced Basic Attack when the enemies are knocked airborne, then use his 2nd Skill and another enhanced Basic Attack. Finally, use his 1st Skill and enhanced Basic Attack to chase and finish off the enemy.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Bane's 2nd Skill to get close to the enemy and hit them with an enhanced Basic Attack. Then use his 1st Skill to slow the enemy followed by another enhanced Basic Attack. And end with his 2nd Skill again with another enhanced Basic Attack.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Bane works best with heroes like as Tigreal and Luo Yi who can pull enemies together so he can do even more damage with his AOE.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Bane counters Tanks with high HP but low damage, such as Hylos and Belerick, because he can out-sustain them and deals HP percentage-based damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Bane is countered by Mages that deal heavy damage from afar, such as Vale and Xavier who can deal significant damage to him before he can get in range.

abilities.name: Mecha Legs
abilities.description:
Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks).

Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

abilities.name: Volley Shot
abilities.description:
Bruno kicks a Powerball on his next Basic Attack, dealing 100/125/150/175/200/225 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, slowing them by 30%, and speeding up by 30% for 0.5s.

The Powerball then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground. He or allied heroes can retrieve the Powerball for another attack and reduce the cooldown of Flying Tackle by 1s.

abilities.name: Flying Tackle
abilities.description:
Bruno makes a slide tackle in the target direction, dealing 140/165/190/215/240/265 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and stunning them for 0.5s.

If the Powerball is bouncing back, Bruno also draws the Powerball toward him.

abilities.name: Worldie
abilities.description: Bruno kicks his Energy Ball at the target enemy hero, dealing 250/350/450<scaleAD> (+83% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and knocking them back. The Energy Ball then bounces between nearby enemies up to 10 times, each time dealing 150/200/250<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. Each hit also reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 4/6/8% for 8s (up to 3 stacks).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, start with Bruno's 1st Skill to get a Powerball and try to get in as much damage as possible. Look for enemies that are close together to use his Ultimate on, then use his Basic Attacks and 2nd Skill to secure the kill or retreat from danger.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Bruno's 1st Skill to get a Powerball, and start attacking the enemy while picking up the ball. When the target is low, stun them with his 2nd Skill and finish them off with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Bruno is best with Supports that can force enemies to engage and allow him to make use of his early game damage, such as Franco and Khufra.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Bruno is strong against Marksmen that are weaker in the early game like Hanabi and Miya who Bruno can out-trade thanks to his high damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Bruno is countered by Tanks with high Physical Defense like Gatotkaca and Fredrinn that take greatly reduced damage from his attacks.

abilities.name: Double Shot
abilities.description: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4s penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 150<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. This damage can trigger attack effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description:
Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.

The bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets will take 11/12/13/14/15/16% less damage after the first bullet.

abilities.name: Trapping Recoil
abilities.description:
Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140/160/180/200/220/240 (+30% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.

abilities.name: Grenade Bombardment
abilities.description:
Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 280/340/400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.

Clint gains a grenade charge every 10/7.5/5s (up to 3).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Clint's Ultimate and enhanced Basic Attacks to whittle down enemies from a distance. Once the enemy is weakened from the constant bombardment, use Clint's 1st Skill, Basic Attack, 2nd Skill, and Basic Attack combo to finish them off.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Clint should use his 1st Skill followed by an enhanced Basic Attack, then his 2nd Skill followed by another enhanced Basic Attack. This combo maximizes his damage, immobilizes the target, and moves Clint out of harm's way.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Clint works best with Supportsthat can enhance his kiting ability, such as Rafaela and Angela.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Clint counters heroes with comparatively shorter range like Moskov and Miya thanks to the superior range of his skills and Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Clint is countered by Marksmen with burst damage like Melissa and Karrie since he lacks burst in the early and mid game to trade blows with them.

abilities.name: Divine Resurrection
abilities.description:
Rafaela can cast a special skill every 10s. After channeling for 2.5s, she instantly resurrects an ally and increases their Movement Speed by 30% for 5s (taking damage from heroes and Legend Creeps interrupts channeling and puts the skill on base cooldown).
This skill's cooldown is increased by 600% of the target's remaining respawn time, capped at 240s. This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

abilities.name: Light of Retribution
abilities.description: Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with <highlight>Light of Retribution</highlight>, dealing them 350/400/450/500/550/600<scaleAP> (+120% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage>, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by <highlight>Light of Retribution</highlight> again within 6s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

abilities.name: Holy Healing
abilities.description:
Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, recovering 100/105/110/115/120/125 (+35% Total Magic Power) HP for nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150/170/190/210/230/250 (+65% Total Magic Power) HP for herself and the most injured allied hero in range. She also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s.

Every 10 point(s) of Magic Power will add 1% to the Movement Speed bonus.

abilities.name: Holy Baptism
abilities.description: Rafaela unleashes the true power of <highlight>Holy Light</highlight> in the target direction, dealing 460/560/660<scaleAP> (+120% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Use 1st Skill to slow enemies, then her Ultimate for Control Effect, then use the 2nd Skill to restore allies' HP.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use 1st Skill to poke enemies and 2nd to heal and create distance.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: When teamed up with Fighters like Freya and Lapu-Lapu, Rafaela can boost their offensive power and survivability.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Rafaela has great healing and decent mobility, and performs well against heroes that lack burst damage or mobility, such as Masha and Barats.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Rafaela struggles against bursty and agile Assassins, like Ling and Hayabusa.

abilities.name: Superconductor
abilities.description: Eudora's skills inflict <highlight>Superconductor</highlight> for 5s on non-minion units hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by <highlight>Superconductor</highlight>.

abilities.name: Forked Lightning
abilities.description:
Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing 275/320/365/410/455/500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within.

When hitting targets affected by Superconductor, Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target, gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1s.
The lightning chain deals 10/12/14/16/18/20 (+4% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage over time and an additional 275/320/365/410/455/500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces this skill's cooldown by 50%.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.description:
Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their Magic Defense by 10/13/16/19/22/25 for 1.8s, dealing 300/320/340/360/380/400 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, stunning them for 1s.

If the enemy is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces the Magic Defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Thunder’s Wrath
abilities.description:
Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target area, dealing 600/800/1000 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to targets at the center. Then it strikes targets outside the center, dealing 300/400/500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage

Every time Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by Superconductor, it triggers a Thunderburst centered on the Superconductor target after a short delay, dealing 330/440/550 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Eudora's 1st Skill to apply Superconductor to enemy heroes, then cast 2nd Skill on the right target for an AOE stun, and follow up with her Ultimate for a massive burst to the stunned heroes. Finally, use her 1st Skill again to finish off the enemy.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: During the laning phase, start with Eudora's 2nd Skill to stun the enemy hero and apply Superconductor, then follow with her Ultimate, and center it over the enemy for massive damage. Finish with her 1st Skill to link with the enemy and finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Eudora's skills can deal massive AOE damage, so pairing her with heroes who can group enemies, like Diggie and Tigreal, will make it easier to maximize her damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Eudora possesses strong targeted CC and burst capabilities, allowing her to keep squishy heroes like Moskov and Obsidia in check.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Eudora lacks self-preservation and struggles against dive heroes or Assassins who can negate targeted CC, such as Hayabusa and Kadita.

abilities.name: Dragon Flurry
abilities.description:
After dealing damage to 3 times with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 times. Each hit deals 80 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Basic Attack damage and heals himself for 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP.

Zilong's Basic Attack deal 100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills ans Basic Attacks is increased by 30.

abilities.name: Spear Flip
abilities.description: Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250/270/290/310/330/350<scaleAD> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>.

abilities.name: Spear Strike
abilities.description:
Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250/290/330/370/410/450 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Physical Defense by 15/18/21/24/27/30 for 2s. He then launches a Basic Attack on the same target.

The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.

abilities.name: Supreme Warrior
abilities.description:
Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35/45/55% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5s.

For the duration, he can trigger Dragon Flurry after every 2 Basic Attacks (instead of the previous 3).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, activate Zilong's Ultimate to gain Movement and Attack Speed bonus before charging at the target enemy with his 2nd Skill. Cast his 1st Skill after closing in on the enemy and follow up with Basic Attacks to trigger the Passive effects.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Zilong should use his 2nd Skill to close in on the target enemy and lower their Defenses, then lift the target over his back with his 1st Skill, and spam Basic Attacks to trigger more Passive effects.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Zilong works best with heroes with strong defensive abilities that can hold off enemy attacks while he solos the lane, such as Pharsa and Hanabi.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: The immunity to Slow effects that Zilong gets from his Ultimate makes him strong against squishy heroes without CC skills, such as Layla and Lylia.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Zilong is still vulnerable to non-slow CC skills, making him weak against heroes with powerful single-target CC skills, such as Franco and Nana.

abilities.name: Air Superiority
abilities.description: During flight, Fanny deals 10%-20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed) and applies a stack of <highlight>Prey Mark</highlight> to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.

abilities.name: Tornado Strike
abilities.description: Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275/325/375/425/475/525<scaleAD> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Steel Cable
abilities.description:
Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2s until her energy runs out. Each successive cast reduces the skill's energy cost by 2.

Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.

abilities.name: Cut Throat
abilities.description: Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400/525/650<scaleAD> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. Each stack of <highlight>Prey Mark</highlight> on the target increases this damage by 30%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Fanny's 2nd Skill repeatedly to move around and use her 1st Skill when in the middle of the enemy. Look for low HP enemies to finish off with her Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Fanny's 2nd Skill at walls to quickly maneuver around and use her 1st Skill when near the enemy. Keep using her 2nd Skill to pass through the enemy to automatically trigger her 1st Skill, and use her Ultimate to secure kills.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Fanny works best with heroes that can chain AOE CC to keep the enemy pinned, such as Minotaur and Gatotkaca, so she can deal damage without interruption.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Fanny counters squishy heroes that lack targeted CC like Karrie and Irithel who cannot stop Fanny's extreme mobility while she bursts them down.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Fanny is countered by heroes that can restrict mobility, such as Kaja and Khufra, since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.

abilities.name: Malefic Gun
abilities.description: Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 115% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.
abilities.flavor_text: Target locked. Fire!

abilities.name: Malefic Bomb
abilities.description:
Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200/240/280/320/360/400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit (can Crit).

Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3s, and she gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.

abilities.name: Void Projectile
abilities.description:
Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target enemy that explodes on hit, dealing 170/200/230/260/290/320 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to targets in the area and applying a Magic Mark on them for 3s.
When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25s.

abilities.name: Destruction Rush
abilities.description:
Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500/650/800 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line.

Passive: The range of Layla's Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Her sight range is also slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, first use Layla's 1st Skill to increase the range of her 2nd Skill. With the extra range, she can easily apply marks to enemies. Use her Ultimate to detonate them all for a hefty bit of damage, and finish off with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, first use Layla's 2nd Skill to apply Magic Mark on the enemy, then detonate it with her 1st Skill for AOE damage while getting extra range for Basic Attacks to further harass the enemy from afar.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Layla works best with Tanks that can protect backline heroes, such as Minsitthar and Belerick, since their protection gives Layla more opportunities to deal damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Layla's relatively longer attack range lets her counter slow Tanks like Tigreal and Belerick.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Layla is countered by Assassins with high burst damage, such as Karina and Ling, as they can get the jump on Layla and melt her easily.

abilities.name: Rage Incarnate
abilities.description:
After casting a skill, Minotaur gains Motivation, recovering HP equal to 5 (+1*Hero Level)% of damage taken from enemy heroes by 3s.

Enraged State: Motivation HP recovery is increased to 200%.

abilities.name: Despair Stomp
abilities.description:
Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 325/360/395/430/465/500 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 40% while Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal 25 (+5% Total HP) extra Physical Damage for 2s.

Enraged: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by 25 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage

abilities.name: Motivation Roar
abilities.description:
Minotaur heals himself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP, recovering 220/240/260/280/300/320 (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for both of them and healing himself for an additional 8% of his lost HP.

Enraged: Minotaur heals himself and all nearby allied heroes.

abilities.name: Minoan Fury
abilities.description:
Minotaur enters Enraged state and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal 180/240/300 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slow them by 60%, while the final hit deals 200/250/300 (+85% Total Physical Attack) True Damage and knocks targets airborne for 0.8s. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack.

The Enraged state lasts 12s and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.
abilities.flavor_text: Rage grants me the power of destruction!

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Minotaur's 1st Skill to jump in and knock enemies airborne, then use his Ultimate to keep them CC'd and enter Enraged state. Use his 1st Skill to knock enemies airborne again and continue with Basic Attacks. Use his 2nd Skill when he or his team needs healing.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Minotaur's 1st Skill to knock the enemy airborne and reduce their Defense, then deal damage with his enhanced Basic Attacks. Use his 2nd Skill to heal him and his teammate to come out ahead in the trade.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Minotaur works best with burst damage Marksmen, such as Granger and Melissa, since his CC's give them more opportunities to deal damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Minotaur is strong against heroes that rely on chaining skills or attacks, like Paquito and Julian because he can interrupt their combos with his CC.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Minotaur is countered by long-range Marksmen like Layla and Lesley since his lack of speed makes him an easy target.

abilities.name: Noumenon Energy Core
abilities.description: Every 3s to 6s (scales with <highlight>Noumenon Blast</highlight> level), the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita 20<scaleHP> (+2.5% Total HP)</scaleHP> <scaleAP>(+20% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> shield. When Lolita casts a skill,  the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita and nearby allied heroes an extra shield. This shield can stack up to 3 times and lasts 30s.

abilities.name: Power Charge
abilities.description: Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4s will perform a short dash to the target, dealing 400/450/500/550/600/650<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and stunning them for 0.5s. This damage is doubled against Minions.

abilities.name: Guardian's Reflection
abilities.description:
Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and Projectiles in the direction of the shield for 3s. The shield will break after taking 1000/1200/1400/1600/1800/2000 (+15% Total HP) damage.

The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected. This skill can be interrupted by high level control effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Right back at you!

abilities.name: Noumenon Blast
abilities.description:
Passsive: Reduces the interval of Noumenon Energy Core by 1s each time this skill is upgraded.

Active: Lolita begins charging for 2s while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 60%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to 600/900/1200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2s (the damage and stun duration are based on the charge time).

Use Again: Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Lolita's 2nd Skill to reflect ranged attacks, followed by her 1st Skill to charge into enemies' midst, then use her enhanced Basic Attack to stun the target and deal damage. Follow up with her Ultimate for more damage and CC, and finish off the enemy with your team.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Lolita's 1st Skill and enhanced Basic Attack to stun the enemy, then use her 2nd Skill to reflect ranged attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Due to her powerful defensive and CC abilities, Lolita is great at protecting Marksmen like Hanabi and Layla.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lolita's shield makes her strong against heroes who rely on projectiles and ranged skills, such as Kimmy and Cyclops.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Lolita is countered by melee heroes with high burst damage like Ling and Paquito.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
abilities.description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of <highlight>Shadow Mark</highlight> on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6s and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
abilities.description:
Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 220/232/244/256/268/280 (+75% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2s. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens take 70% less damage after the first hit, and Creeps take 50% less damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy when hitting non-Minion enemies.

Passive: Hayabusa permanently gains 3/6/9/12/15/18% Spell Vamp.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
abilities.description:
Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing 130/140/150/160/170/180 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 2s. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash.

Use Again: Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken by 1s. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals 130/140/150/160/170/180 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy.

abilities.name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
abilities.description:
Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing 140 (+32% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

The attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark and each will consume a mark to deal 90/120/150 (+40/50/60% Extra Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage. Shadow Kill does not apply Shadow Mark.
abilities.flavor_text: I, will be Akakage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Hayabusa should use his 2nd Skill to hit an enemy with his phantom, then use his 1st and 2nd Skill on the target to apply Shadow Mark before unleashing his Ultimate. Afterwards, use his 1st Skill to finish off the enemy and escape with his 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Hayabusa's 2nd Skill to hit the enemy with a phantom, then strike with his 1st Skill, and use his 2nd Skill to blink away. Wait until Hayabusa's 1st Skill is off cooldown, then blink back to the enemy with his 2nd Skill and strike again with his 1st Skill followed by his Ultimate to secure the kill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Hayabusa works best with Fighters like Lapu-Lapu and Alpha who can initiate with him to quickly focus down key targets.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Hayabusa counters squishy heroes that lack CC to shutdown the blinks from his 2nd Skill, and who are also easy targets for his Ultimate, such as Chang'e and Cecilion.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Hayabusa is countered by heroes with targeted CC like Franco and Kaja who can lock him down before he can blink away.

abilities.name: Power of Einherjar
abilities.description:
Freya gains 1 Sacred Orb with each Basic Attack (up to 6 Sacred Orbs). Consuming 1 Sacred Orb grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack (max 6 stacks).
Sacred Orbs gradually recover when out of combat.

abilities.name: Leap of Faith
abilities.description: Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining 500/580/660/740/820/900<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> shield and dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAD> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4s.

abilities.name: Valkyrie Slash
abilities.description:
Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5s. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Sacred Orbs per cast.
This skill deals 50% damage to Creeps.

abilities.name: Valkyrie Descent
abilities.description:
Freya selects a target area and dives down as a Sacred Orb (gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction), dealing 300/425/550 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 40% slow to enemies in her path and at the landing point for 2s.

Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 10s, during which her Basic Attacks deal 30/45/60 extra damage (extra damage cannot Crit) and she recovers 40/60/80 (+40% Total Physical Attack) HP per Basic Attack, and her Basic Attacks deal splash damage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Use Freya's Ultimate to dive the enemy backline and start dealing Splash Damage. Use her 1st Skill to CC enemies and shield herself, then alternate between her 2nd Skill and AoE Basic Attacks to bring them down.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use Freya's 1st Skill to close the gap on enemies and knock them Airborne while giving herself a shield. Use her 2nd Skill once followed by 2 enhanced Basic Attacks to make use of the Attack Speed bonus and generate more Sacred Orbs from her Passive.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: In order for Freya to maximize her damage, she prefers heroes with CC like Belerick and Gatotkaca to lock down the enemy for her.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Freya not only has exceptional mobility, she also excels in prolonged engagements, making her highly effective against fragile, low-HP Marksmen, such as Lesley and Ixia. Her excellent sustained damage and mobility also allows her to counter Tanks with low damage, like Uranus and Baxia.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: However, all of Freya's skills have movement components, making her vulnerable to Phoveus's unique counter. Using her skills near Phoveus will allow him to quickly gain energy for his enhanced Basic Attacks. Freya is vulnerable to CC and movement-disabling effects, so Minsitthar and Obsidia's Ultimates can lock her down completely.

abilities.name: Mystic Favor
abilities.description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with Basic Attacks or skills within a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional 140<scaleAP> (+40% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <trueDamage>True Damage</trueDamage> and slow them by 20% for 1s (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).
abilities.flavor_text: Concentrated energy is capable of reaping anything apart!

abilities.name: Mystic Projectile
abilities.description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225/265/305/345/385/425<scaleAP> (+80% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1s.

abilities.name: Mystic Injunction
abilities.description: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing 30/36/42/48/54/60<scaleAP> (+10% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> every 0.25s to enemies within (up to 16 times).

abilities.name: Mystic Gush
abilities.description:
Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 110/160/210 (+32% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit every 0.2s (up to 16 times).

The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Gord should look to stun the enemy heroes with his 1st Skill, then follow up with his 2nd Skill and Ultimate to get a quick kill on them.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Gord should look to stun the enemy heroes with his 1st Skill, then follow up with his 2nd Skill and Ultimate to get a quick kill on them.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Gord works well with tanky heroes with reliable CCs, like Hylos and Belerick.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Gord is strong against melee heroes with poor Mobility, such as Barats and Fredrinn.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Gord is countered by heroes with gap closers, such as Fanny and Lancelot.

abilities.name: Assassin Instinct
abilities.description:
If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1s, she will enter Camouflage state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal 200 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while silencing the target for 0.25s.

Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the Camouflage state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1s.

Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.

abilities.name: Claw Dash
abilities.description:
Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250/270/290/310/330/350 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path.

After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5s.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Natalia releases a <highlight>Smoke Bomb</highlight> at her location, slowing enemies within by 25/35/45/55/65/75% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4s.
abilities.flavor_text: No one beats me in my own game.

abilities.name: The Hunt
abilities.description:
Passive: Natalia gains 15/30/45% extra Crit Chance.

Active: Natalia immediately enters Assassin Instinct state. Natalia can store up to 2 charges of her Ultimate and each charge has a recharge time of 30/24/18s. Creep kills will reduce the current remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Natalia's Passive and enhanced Basic Attacks to approach enemies, then use her 2nd Skill to improve her survivability. Follow up with her 1st Skill then Ultimate and end with a Basic Attack to finish off the enemy.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: When ganking, hide in a bush to activate Natalia's Passive, then approach the enemy from behind and blink to them with the enhanced Basic Attack. Follow up with her 2nd Skill to slow the enemy and chase after them using her 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Natalia works best with heroes with high AOE damage such as Yi Sun-shin and Vexana. She can stay hidden while they poke the enemy, then pounce on targets that get low on HP.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Natalia counters squishy heroes who lack CC and burst like as Novaria and Irithel since they can't stop Natalia's burst damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Natalia is countered by heroes who can restrict her mobility like Minsitthar and Kaja since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.

abilities.name: Yin Yang Gathering
abilities.description: Upon retrieving the <highlight>Seimei Umbrella</highlight>, Kagura gains a 450<scaleAP> (+80% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> shield, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5s, and slows them by 60% for 1s. Cooldown: 4.5s.

abilities.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
abilities.description:
Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 365/410/455/500/545/590 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away.
This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.

abilities.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
abilities.description:
Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 315/370/425/480/535/590 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away.
This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.

abilities.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
abilities.description: Kagura removes all debuffs on her and leaps in the target direction, while leaving the <highlight>Seimei Umbrella</highlight> behind.

abilities.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
abilities.description: Kagura teleports to the <highlight>Seimei Umbrella</highlight>'s location and retrieves it, dealing 300/320/340/360/380/400<scaleAP> (+90% Total Magic Power) <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Yin Yang Overturn
abilities.description: Kagura invokes the power of the <highlight>Seimei Umbrella</highlight>, dealing 250/335/420<scaleAP> (+105% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.
abilities.flavor_text: Don't get too close to my Seimei Umbrella.

abilities.name: Yin Yang Overturn
abilities.description: Kagura invokes the power of the <highlight>Seimei Umbrella</highlight>, resetting the cooldown of <highlight>Seimei Umbrella Open</highlight>, dealing 235/295/355<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies around the Umbrella, and slowing them by 60%. After 1.5s, enemy heroes around the Umbrella will be pulled toward it and dealt 480/600/720<scaleAP> (+155% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage>.
abilities.flavor_text: Don't get too close to my Seimei Umbrella.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Kagura should place her Umbrella between the enemies with her 1st Skill, then use her Ultimate to reset the cooldown for her 1st Skill to be able to adjust the Umbrella location before teleporting to the Umbrella location to stun nearby enemies. She should then use her Ultimate + 2nd Skill combo to escape from the fighting zone.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Kagura can use her 1st Skill to poke the enemy with her Umbrella, then her 2nd Skill to teleport to the Umbrella's location, dealing more damage to the enemies and dash back by casting her 2nd Skill again.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Kagura works well with tank heroes with strong CC skills that allow her to deal more damage with her Ultimate, such as Atlas and Tigreal.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kagura's Ultimate can deal high burst damage, making her strong against back-row heroes with no dash or blink, such as Layla and Eudora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Kagura is countered by heroes with more than one control immunity abilities that allow them to escape her various CC skills, heroes like Joy and Martis are good examples.

abilities.name: Only Fast
abilities.description: After traveling 5 units, Chou deals 180% damage on his next Basic Attack (cannot Crit), briefly slows the target by 90% and reduces their Physical Defense by 10(+1*Hero Level) for 3s (up to 2 stacks).

abilities.name: Jeet Kune Do
abilities.description:
Chou strikes in the target direction, dealing 180/200/220/240/260/280 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before it goes on cooldown. On the 3rd cast, Chou also knocks enemies hit airborne.

Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd cast resets the cooldown of Shunpo.
abilities.flavor_text: It only takes three seconds to defeat you. One! Two! Three!

abilities.name: Shunpo
abilities.description: Chou charges in the target direction, gaining Control Immunity and a 200/230/260/290/320/350<scaleAD> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> shield.

abilities.name: The Way of Dragon
abilities.description:
Chou strikes a roundhouse kick at the target enemy hero, dealing them 400/500/600 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back.

Cast the skill again to chase up the target, dealing a total of 480/580/680 (+220% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Chou's 2nd and 1st Skill to get next to a key target, then use his Ultimate to knock them out of position and secure the kill with his team.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Chou's 2nd Skill to get close to the enemy and follow up with his 1st Skill for multiple strikes. After landing the 3rd strike of his 1st Skill, use the refreshed 2nd Skill to stay on the target and finish them with his Ultimate.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Chou works best with Healers that can boost his survivability and speed, such as Angela and Rafaela.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Chou counters slower Fighters like Terizla and Alpha that have a hard time dealing with his quick hit and run tactics.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Chou is countered by heroes with very long-range like Lesley and Pharsa that can take out a chunk of his HP before he can get close.

abilities.name: Simian God
abilities.description:
Enemies hit by Sun and his Doppelgangers will have their Physical Defense reduced by 5% (stacks up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 25% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage.

Sun and his Doppelgangers' Basic Attacks deal 50 extra damage to Creeps.

abilities.name: Endless Variety
abilities.description:
Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 200/240/280/320/360/400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Upon hitting an enemy hero or Creep, or reaching the maximum range, the Golden Staff morphs into a Doppelganger that lasts 5s and inherits 40/43/46/49/52/55% of Sun's attributes (and a portion of his Attack Effects).

Endless Variety and Swift Exchange are learned and upgraded together and share the same cooldown.

abilities.name: Swift Exchange
abilities.description:
Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 200/240/280/320/360/400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.
He conjures a Doppelganger at his location that lasts 5s and inherits 40/43/46/49/52/55% of his attributes (and a portion of Attack Effects). Meanwhile, Sun conceals himself and moves with the Golden Staff.

abilities.name: Instantaneous Move
abilities.description: Sun commands his Doppelgangers to strike at the target enemy with him, dealing 270/280/290/300/310/320<scaleAD> (+40/43/46/49/52/55% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing the target and enemies behind them by 20% (can be stacked) for 1.5s. This counts as Basic Attack damage and can trigger Attack Effects but cannot Crit.

abilities.name: Clone Techniques
abilities.description: Sun summons a Doppelganger that lasts 8s and inherits 70/85/100% of his attributes and a portion of his Attack Effects. The Doppelganger takes increased damage.
abilities.flavor_text: No one can tell what's false and what's real.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Sun can start with his Ultimate to summon a Doppelganger, and approach the enemy with his 2nd Skill. Finally, he can use his 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks to deal damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use Sun's 1st Skill to chip away at enemies, and close the distance once they're low on HP with his 2nd Skill. Then use his 3rd Skill to deal a burst of damage with his Dopplegangers. Sun can start with his Ultimate to summon a Doppleganger, then Blink on the enemy with his 2nd Skill, and finally use his 3rd Skill and Basic Attacks finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Pair Sun with tanks who have strong CC abilities such as Belerick or Tigreal to create opportunities for Sun to deal damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Sun can deal great sustained damage and has armor-busting capabilities, making him a good counter to tanks with low damage output, such as Franco and Gatotkaca.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Fighter heroes with Lifesteal can counter Sun, however. For example, heroes like Ruby can steal a lot of HP by hitting Sun and his Dopplegangers.

abilities.name: Beta, Advance!
abilities.description:
When Alpha uses a skill, Beta will be summoned to attack. Enemies that are hit by Beta 2 time(s) will be Locked On.

Locked On: After Alpha deals damage to the target, Beta will fire a laser at them, dealing 80 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+8*Hero Level) True Damage and briefly applying a powerful slow effect.
This skill only deals 75% damage to Creeps.

abilities.name: Rotary Impact
abilities.description:
Alpha unleashes an energy wave in the target direction, dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

Beta then strafes enemies along the same path, dealing 60/72/84/96/108/120 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage.

abilities.name: Force Swing
abilities.description:
After a short delay, Alpha swings his blade in the target direction, dealing 180/244/318/372/436/500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and restoring 40/72/104/136/178/200 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) HP for each enemy hit.

Beta then strafes enemies in the same area, dealing 60/72/84/96/108/120 (+30% Total Physical Attack) True Damage.

abilities.name: Spear of Alpha
abilities.description:
Beta dives to the target location, dealing 100/150/200 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s. Alpha then leaps towards the same location, knocking enemies in his path airborne and carrying them to the landing location. Alpha then slams down, dealing 250/370/500 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 40% for 1.5s.

Beta then attacks the same area 5 times, dealing 15/22/30 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage each time.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Alpha's Ultimate to charge toward enemy's key target, and use his 2nd Skill, follow up with his 1st Skill to slow them and continuously dish out damage to the locked-on targets with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, slow the enemy with Alpha's 1st Skill, then hit them with his 2nd Skill to have Beta to lock on to them. Finish with Basic Attacks while Beta fires at the locked-on target.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Alpha works well with heroes that can initiate with CC like Vexana and Selena. With their help, he'll have a much easier time landing his skills.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Alpha counters heroes that lack mobility, such as Layla and Ixia, because these heroes have a hard time avoiding his skills.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Alpha is countered by heroes that are very mobile, such as Chou and Gusion, because they have a lot of ways to dodge Alpha's skills.

abilities.name: Let's Dance!
abilities.description:
Ruby's skills have a 75% Spell Vamp Ratio (her Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). For every 1% HP lost, her Spell Vamp Ratio increases by 1%, up to 150%.
After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location and gain 8-25 Physical & Magic Defense (scales with level) for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

abilities.name: Be Good!
abilities.description: Ruby swings her scythe, dealing 280/320/360/400/440/480<scaleAD> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing 140/160/180/200/220/240<scaleAD> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

abilities.name: Don't Run, Wolf King!
abilities.description: Ruby swings her scythe around herself twice, each swing dealing 60/85/110/135/160/185<scaleAD> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5s, and slowly pulling them toward her.

abilities.name: I'm Offended!
abilities.description: Ruby sweeps her scythe in the target direction, dealing 600/900/1200<scaleAD> (+200% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Ruby's 1st Skill to slow the enemy at a distance, and close in with her Passive dash. Then use her 2nd Skill to stun the enemies in range and use her Ultimate to pull back those who try to escape.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Use Ruby's 1st Skill to slow down the enemy, and the dash from her Passive to get closer. Then cast Ruby's Ultimate to pull the enemy into melee range and her 2nd Skill to keep them stunned. Finally, spam her Basic Attacks to finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Ruby works best with heroes who can deal high AOE burst damage. Their skills can deal more damage to enemies who are stunned and pulled by her 2nd and Ultimate skills. Such as Pharsa and Kadita.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Ruby is strong against Fighter heroes with high burst damage. She can easily survive their burst with her excellent Regen and Lifesteal abilities. Such as Aldous and Guinevere.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Ruby is countered by Marksman heroes with good Mobility. Because they can easily dodge her 2nd and Ultimate skills. Like Wanwan and Irithel.

abilities.name: Heavenly Vow
abilities.description:
Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow or glaive according to his distance from the target.
Weapon Mastery: After each weapon switch, the next two Basic Attacks will gain extra Attack Speed, dealing 70% and 55% Crit Damage respectively, and gain 15% Movement Speed for 1s.

abilities.name: Traceless
abilities.description:
Yi Sun-shin dashes forward and slashes with his glaive, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and becoming immune to control effects for 0.4s.

Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces the cooldown of Traceless by 1s.

abilities.name: Blood Floods
abilities.description:
Tap: Yi Sun-shin slashes swiftly with his glaive, dealing 240/260/280/300/320/340 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Hold: Yi Sun-shin shoots a powerful arrow, dealing 240/260/280/300/320/340 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target. The arrow's damage scales with the hold time, up to 200%.
Yi Sun-shin gains Weapon Mastery immediately when this skill is used.

abilities.name: Mountain Shocker
abilities.description:
Yi Sun-shin summons a turtle ship and gains sight of the whole map for 2s. The turtle ship lasts for up to 10s, during which Yi Sun-shin gains 70% burst Movement Speed (decays to 20% over 2s).
When cast again, Yi Sun-shin commands the turtle ship to ram toward the target area, dealing 160/200/240 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning enemy units in the central area for 0.8s. Then Yi Sun-shin commands the naval fleet to launch 3 waves of cannon shots on a larger area, each dealing 160/200/240 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 30%.
Yi Sun-shin gains Weapon Mastery effect immediately when this skill is used.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
