combos.description: In teamfights, start with Yi Sun-shin's Ultimate, then use his enhanced 1st Skill to send his Turtle Ship into the enemy to stun them. Follow up with ranged Basic Attacks, then use his 1st Skill to get close and perform 2 enhanced Basic Attacks. Tap his 2nd Skill to perform another slash, and secure the kill with 2 more enhanced Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Yi Sun-shin should use his enhanced Basic Attacks from a distance, then close in with his 1st Skill and slash the enemy with two enhanced Basic Attacks. Follow up with a slash from his 2nd Skill and finish with 2 more enhanced Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Yi Sun-shin works best with Fighters who can initiate, such as Alpha and Khaleed, so he can follow up and unleash his full damage after they have CC'd the enemy.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Yi Sun-shin counters heroes that lack CC like Uranus and Terizla who are at the mercy of his ability to jump in and out of melee range using his 2 weapons.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Yi Sun-shin is countered by heroes with CC skills, such as Franco and Kaja who can lock him down and stop him from freely swapping weapons.

abilities.name: Spear of Quiescence
abilities.description: Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal <scaleAD> (+68% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD>-<scaleAD> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies behind them (scales with hero level). Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of <highlight>Abyss Walker</highlight> by 0.8s and <highlight>Spear of Misery</highlight> by 0.8s.

abilities.name: Abyss Walker
abilities.description: Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4 times for 3s. Meanwhile, his Basic Attack deals <scaleAD> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> more damage to enemies behind the primary target.

abilities.name: Spear of Misery
abilities.description:
Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 300/330/360/390/420/450 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 2s.

If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take 200/215/230/245/260/275 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and be stunned for 1.2s. If the enemy is knocked into a wall, they will also be stunned for the same duration.

abilities.name: Spear of Destruction
abilities.description:
After a short delay, Moskov throws the Spear of Destruction in the target direction, dealing 340/420/500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and to the first enemy hero hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces them, dealing 10% extra Physical Damage to enemies behind them. The target and enemies hit by the piercing damage will be slowed by 50% for 1s (the slow duration scales with the spear's travel time, up to 3s).

When Spear of Destruction hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of Abyss Walker.

Use Again: Moskov casts Abyss Walker from the shadow's location (shares the same cooldown as the skill).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Moskov's Ultimate to slow a target, then activate it again to blink behind them and use his 2nd Skill to knock them into a stun before finishing them off with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Moskov's 1st Skill to blink to a position to stun the target with his 2nd Skill, then get in as many Basic Attacks as possible to reduce the cooldown of his skills.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Moskov works well with heroes like Atlas and Gatotkaca who can CC groups of enemies so he can focus on maximizing the damage of his piercing AOE.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Moskov's 1st Skill provides a blink effect, making him a threat to fighters with poor mobility like Thamuz and Balmond.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Moskov is countered by heroes with high mobility, such as Lancelot and Natalia, who can quickly close the gap and take him out.

abilities.name: Electro Airbag
abilities.description: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a 300<scaleHP> (+700% Total Physical Defense)</scaleHP> shield for 10s. Cooldown: 100s.

abilities.name: Impact Wrench
abilities.description: Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing 120/140/160/180/200/220<scaleHP> (+220% Total Physical Defense)</scaleHP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8s.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Waves
abilities.description:
Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 120/140/160/180/200/220 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, reducing their Movement Speed and Magic Defense by 10% (stacks up to 3 times) for 2s.
While his shield is raised, Johnson can perform Basic Attacks and cast skills.

abilities.name: Full Throttle
abilities.description:
Passive: Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10/20/30%.
Johnson transforms into a car. An allied hero can use Hop In when near Johnson to board the car (only 1 allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode upon hitting an enemy hero, dealing 300/350/400 (+240% Total Physical Defense)-450/525/600 (+360% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5-1s (scales with driving time), and creating an electrified zone at the location. The zone continuously deals 60/70/80 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies within. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy for 3s when casting this skill.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, cast Johnson's Ultimate and pick up a teammate before engaging the enemy. Then follow up with his 2nd Skill and 1st Skill to CC the enemy again.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Johnson's 1st Skill to stun enemies, then move in and hit them with his 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Johnson works well with heroes that need help initiating like Odette and Kadita since they can just jump into Johnson's Ultimate for a ride.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description:
Johnson counters melee heroes with high burst like Alucard and Zilong
because of Johnson's high Physical Defense and CC ability.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Johnson is countered by agile heroes who deal Magic Damage such as Harith and Kagura because they can easily dodge Johnson's skills while their damage is not affected by his Physical Defense.

abilities.name: Starlit Hourglass
abilities.description: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5s.

abilities.name: Stardust Shock
abilities.description: Cyclops casts two Stardust Disks in the target direction, each dealing 240/272/304/336/368/400<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in its path.

abilities.name: Planets Attack
abilities.description: Cyclops conjures Starlit Spheres around himself while gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s. The spheres will automatically seek and attack nearby enemies (prioritizes enemy heroes), exploding on collision and dealing 200/225/250/275/300/325<scaleAP> (+55% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the enemy. Enemies hit by multiple spheres will take reduced damage after the first hit.

abilities.name: Star Power Lockdown
abilities.description: Cyclops creates a Planetary Sphere and sends it after the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 500<scaleAP> (+120% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and immobilizing them for 0.75-1.5s (increases with travel distance).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Cyclops should control the target enemy with his Ultimate, close in with his 2nd Skill, then finish off the target with his 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Cyclops can use his 2nd Skill to close in on enemy heroes then hit them with both his 1st Skill and the spheres summoned by his 2nd Skill. This combo is very effective against enemy heroes.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Cyclops is best with tanky heroes with strong CC skills, like Belerick and Minsitthar.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Cyclops' short skill cooldown makes him strong against mid-ranged heroes with poor Mobility, such as Terizla and Alpha.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Cyclops lacks Dash or Blink skills, making him the preferred target for heroes with gap closers and CC skills. Such as Lancelot, Alucard and Kagura.

abilities.name: Scripture of the Moon Elf
abilities.description: Scripture of the Moon Elf slowly charges Estes with energy. When the energy reaches 100 stacks, Estes' next Basic Attack will become enhanced, dealing 250<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <scaleAP>(+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the target and 125<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <scaleAP>(+75% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 60% for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Moonlight Immersion
abilities.description:
Estes recovers 200/225/250/275/300/325 (+110% Total Magic Power) HP for the target allied hero immediately and links himself with them for 5s. While linked, both heroes gain 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) Hybrid Defense, and the target slowly recovers 360/405/450/495/540/585 (+90% Total Magic Power) HP. Linking with an allied hero increases Estes' Movement Speed by 15%, as well as the energy charging speed of the Scripture of the Moon Elf.

Being too far from the target will break the link.

abilities.name: Domain of Moon Goddess
abilities.description: Estes drops a flood of moonlight on the target area, dealing 350/400/450/500/550/600<scaleAP> (+70% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemy units within it. Afterwards, it turns to a domain of the Moon Goddess and reveals enemies inside it. Enemies will be slowed by 90% for 1.5s if they touch the edge of the domain area. (The slow effect will decay over time.)

abilities.name: Blessing of Moon Goddess
abilities.description:
Estes casts an enhanced "Moonlight Immersion" on himself and all nearby allied heroes, refreshing "Moonlight Immersion" on them and enhancing it for 8s.

Enhanced "Moonlight Immersion": Doubles the Instant Basic Healing and Hybrid Defense Increase, and heals the target for 1020/1260/1500 (+225% Total Magic Power) HP over time.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Estes should use his 2nd Skill to slow down the enemy team, then heal his teammates with his Ultimate and 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Estes can use his 2nd Skill to slow down and poke enemies, and heal allies with his 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Estes works best with typical Marksman heroes, his healing will allow them to deal more damage. Heroes like Lesley and Hanabi are good examples here.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Estes counters heroes with no burst damage, he can easily heal through minor damages from heroes like Faramis and Alice.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Estes is countered by heroes with high burst damage. Heroes like Saber and Eudora can easily burst down Estes or the hero he protects in a few seconds.

abilities.name: Blessing of Wilderness
abilities.description:
Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances her next Basic Attack, which deals 110 (+130% Total Physical Attack)(+12*Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target, reduces the target's Movement Speed by 40%, and deals 40 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+10*Hero Level) Physical Damage to enemies behind the target. After using the enhanced Basic Attack, this effect enters a 6s cooldown.

Hilda's Basic Attack and skills apply a Wilderness Mark on hit, which lasts up to 4s and stacks up to 6 times. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's Physical Defense and Magic Defense by 3%.

abilities.name: Combat Ritual
abilities.description: Hilda gains 60% Movement Speed for 3s and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10/14/18/22/24/30% Max HP, lasting 3s.

abilities.name: Art of Hunting
abilities.description: Hilda locks onto an enemy target, dealing 200/240/280/320/360/400<scaleAD> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> per hit. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The 2nd attack deals extra damage to nearby enemies. The 3rd attack deals damage to the target and nearby enemies, knocking them back briefly.

abilities.name: Power of Wildness
abilities.description:
Hilda launches a powerful slash at the target enemy, dealing 600/800/1000 (+250% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 0.2s. Nearby enemies take 60% of the damage.

Each stack of Wilderness Mark increases Power of Wildness's damage by 2.5/3.5/4.5% of the target's Max HP. At max stacks, the extra damage increases to 20/28/36% of the target's Max HP.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Hilda should use her Ultimate to dive the back-row heroes, then use her 2nd Skill to deal damage and chase the enemy down with her 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Hilda can use her 1st Skill to close in on a target enemy, and slow them with her Enhanced Basic Attack. She can then follow up with her 2nd Skill to chip away at her target and finish with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Hilda works well with tanky heroes, which can create room for her to dish out more damage. Such as Atlas and Tigreal.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Hilda excels in prolonged battles. She works well against heroes with lower burst damage. Such as Zilong and Layla.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Hilda is countered by heroes with high sustain. Such as Thamuz and Uranus. This is because they can utilize their healing abilities to prevent being executed.

abilities.name: Pride of Ice
abilities.description:
Upon taking fatal damage, Aurora freezes herself for 1.5s, becoming invincible during this time and gradually recovering 30% Max HP. This effect has a 150s cooldown.

Aurora's freeze effects can also affect Turrets.
abilities.flavor_text: Eternal Standing of the Glacier.

abilities.name: Hailstone Blast
abilities.description: Aurora summons an icy meteorite to strike at the target location, dealing 400/460/520/580/640/700<scaleAP> (+90% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1s. Afterward, 5 hailstones fall, each dealing 40<scaleAP> (+10% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage>.
abilities.flavor_text: Howling Blizzard of the North.

abilities.name: Frosty Breeze
abilities.description: Aurora blows Frosty Breeze in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, dealing 225/255/285/315/345/375<scaleAP> (+75% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit, and creating a frozen area at the far-end of the attack that deals a total of 225/255/285/315/345/375<scaleAP> (+75% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in the area and freezes them for 1s. This skill gains 0.06s additional freezing duration for every 100 Magic Power.
abilities.flavor_text: Frigid Frost in the Mountains.

abilities.name: Frigid Glacier
abilities.description: Aurora creates a frost path in the target direction, dealing 100/150/200<scaleAP> (+40% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in the path and reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1.2s. The frost path gradually becomes glaciers that spread until reaching their maximum size and shattering, dealing 600/900/1200<scaleAP> (+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to all enemies in the area and freezing targets for 1s. Every 100 Magic Power that Aurora has will increase the freeze duration by 0.2s.
abilities.flavor_text: Underflow of the Frozen River.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, first cast Aurora's Ultimate when the enemy is grouped, then use her 2nd Skill immediately to freeze them inside the Ultimate's AOE, and finish with her 1st Skill on the CC'ed targets for maximum damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Aurora's 2nd Skill to freeze the enemy, then follow up with her 1st Skill to ensure all the hits connect.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: With her very powerful CC abilities, Aurora works well with heroes who deal high sustained damage, like Ixia, Freya, and Karrie.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Aurora counters heroes who like to charge in, such as Leomord, Thamuz, and Terizla, since her skills can stop them dead in their tracks.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Because most of Aurora's skills have delayed effects, she is countered by high mobility heroes who can dodge them with ease, such as Ling, Kadita, and Guinevere.

abilities.name: Homeland Defender
abilities.description: Lapu-Lapu accumulates 10 <highlight>Bravery Blessing</highlight> each time he deals damage (halved for damage dealt to non-hero units). When <highlight>Bravery Blessing</highlight> is full, Lapu-Lapu's next <highlight>Basic Attack</highlight> will make him dash toward the target, dealing <scaleAD> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> (cannot Crit) and granting him a shield that absorbs 250 (+65*Hero Level) damage for 2.5s.

abilities.name: Justice Blades
abilities.description:
Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction, each boomerang dealing 140/165/190/215/240/265 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit on its way out and back.

Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.
abilities.flavor_text: Enemies have their sharp spears, but we have strong and brave souls.

abilities.name: Land Shaker
abilities.description: Lapu-Lapu channels for 0.7s, slowing enemies in the target direction by 60%. He then slams his heavy sword to the ground, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s. (This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.)
abilities.flavor_text: Enemies have their sharp spears, but we have strong and brave souls.

abilities.name: Jungle Warrior
abilities.description: Lapu-Lapu dashes in the target direction, dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies along the way.

abilities.name: Storm Sword
abilities.description: Lapu-Lapu whirls his heavy sword, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies.</br></br>When hitting an enemy hero, Lapu-Lapu gains 20% Damage Reduction, plus an additional 8% for each extra enemy hero hit, lasting 3s.

abilities.name: Bravest Fighter
abilities.description:
Lapu-Lapu leaps to the target location while combining his twin blades into one, dealing 300/400/500 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies upon landing and slowing them by 60% for 1s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)
Lapu-Lapu gains 3 times the Bravery Blessing from this skill and skills in transformed state.
For the next 10s, Lapu-Lapu enters Great Sword stance and gains enhanced skills, 30/45/60 extra Physical & Magic Defense, and his Basic Attack damage is increased to 120%.

abilities.name: Raging Slash
abilities.description: Lapu-Lapu swings his heavy sword 3 times. The first two attacks deal 345/445/545<scaleAD> (+160% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> each, while the third deals 440/580/720<scaleAD> (+210% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in a large area.</br></br>Lapu-Lapu gains Control Immunity during this process and can change his attack direction and move a short distance on each attack.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description:
In teamfights, use Lapu-Lapu's 1st Skill to wear down the enemies' HP, then follow up with his 2nd Skill to get close and use his Ultimate to initiate. While in Great Sword stance, use his Ultimate again for high burst damage, then use his 2nd Skill to gain Damage Reduction,
and finally CC the enemy with his 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Lapu-Lapu's 1st Skill to poke enemies. When Bravery Blessing is full, use his 2nd Skill and enhanced Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Lapu-Lapu works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, like Tigreal and Atlas, to allow his AOE skills to hit more targets and get more Damage Reduction from his 2nd Skill in Great Sword stance by hitting more heroes.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lapu-Lapu is strong against squishy heroes who lack movement abilities, such as Layla and Eudora, because he has high burst damage and can use his mobility to get on top of them.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Lapu-Lapu is countered by agile Marksmen who can knock him away, such as Lesley and Moskov. They can speed up or blink to avoid Lapu-Lapu's Ultimate, and use knockback effects to interrupt his 1st Skill in Great Sword stance or to keep him away.

abilities.name: Nether Touch
abilities.description: Vexana and the <highlight>Eternal Guard</highlight> inflict <highlight>Nether Curse</highlight> on enemies hit. The Curse lasts 5s and will cause the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing 108-500<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies (base damage scales with level).

abilities.name: Deathly Grasp
abilities.description: Vexana unleashes a <highlight>Deathly Grasp</highlight> in the target direction, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in its path. The projectile stops upon hitting an enemy hero, terrifying them and knocking them back, then it explodes, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and terrifying them for 1s.

abilities.name: Cursed Blast
abilities.description: Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after a 0.8s delay and dealing 580/634/689/743/797/850<scaleAP> (+165% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Eternal Guard
abilities.description: Vexana summons an <highlight>Eternal Guard</highlight> at the target location, dealing 480/600/720<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.6s. The <highlight>Eternal Guard</highlight> then joins Vexana in battle for 15s. Each of the Eternal Guard's attacks deals 200/250/300<scaleAP> (+40% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> plus 5% of the target's Max HP as <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in a large area.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Initiate teamfights with CC or follow up after other CC. Use her Ultimate when enemies are gathered, follow up with 2nd and 1st Skill combo for CC and damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Terrify enemy with 1st Skill and follow up with 2nd Skill for guaranteed damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description:
Heroes with powerful CC such as Atlas or
high damage output like Beatrix to burst down enemies.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Backline DPS heroes such as Layla, Irithel and Xavier.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Mobile Assassins such as Saber, Aamon and Karina.

abilities.name: Full Moon Curse
abilities.description:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.

In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP.

In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP.

This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

abilities.name: Open Fire
abilities.description: Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing 250/300/350/400/450/500<scaleAD> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> in total to the enemy hit. The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s, while the second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 10/14/18/22/26/30 for 5s.
abilities.flavor_text: Even one pure of heart can't escape the Full Moon Curse.

abilities.name: Lycan Punce
abilities.description: Roger lunges at the target enemy, becoming untargetable while dealing 250/300/350/400/450/500<scaleAD> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to up to 3 enemies in the area.</br></br>Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.
abilities.flavor_text: Even one pure of heart can't escape the Full Moon Curse.

abilities.name: Hunter's Steps
abilities.description: Roger gains 20/24/28/32/36/40% Movement Speed and 20/24/28/32/36/40% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Howl
abilities.description: Roger lets out a howl, increasing his Attack Speed by 1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4 times for 5s. Within this duration, he gains 50% Movement Speed if an enemy hero below 40% HP is within his vision.

abilities.name: Wolf Transformation
abilities.description:
Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150/200/250/300 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s.

Passive: In wolf form, Roger gains 20/35/50/65 Physical & Magic Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Restore Human Form
abilities.description: Roger rolls in the target direction and reverts back to human form, gaining a 200/250/300/350<scaleAD> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> shield for 1.5s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Roger's 1st Skill to whittle down enemies from afar while using his 2nd Skill to maintain good positioning. When both sides have engaged, use his Ultimate to go for the enemy's back line. Use his 2nd Skill for extra Attack Speed and his 1st Skill to secure the kill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Roger should poke the enemy while in his Human form. Use his 2nd Skill for extra Movement Speed for an angle to hit with his 1st Skill. Use his Ultimate to close in on the enemy, followed by his 2nd Skill for Attack Speed and tear into them with Basic Attacks before finishing them off with his 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Roger works best with heroes with high AOE damage that can nuke the enemy team to low HP for him to finish off, such as Pharsa and Vexana.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Roger counters squishy heroes that lack mobility such as Hanabi and Odette because they cannot easily escape from him.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Roger is countered by heroes that can restrict his mobility and prevent him from jumping in and out using his two forms, like Minsitthar and Khufra.

abilities.name: Lightwheel Mark
abilities.description: Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <highlight>Lightwheel Mark</highlight> on hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of <highlight>Lightwheel Marks</highlight>, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing <trueDamage>True Damage</trueDamage> equal to 5<scaleAD> (+1% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD>% of the target's Max HP to them (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).

abilities.name: Spinning Lightwheel
abilities.description: Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250/275/300/325/350/375<scaleAD> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150/160/170/180/190/200<scaleAD> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

abilities.name: Phantom Step
abilities.description:
Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150/175/200/225/250/275 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark on them.

When in Dual Wield state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

abilities.name: Speedy Lightwheel
abilities.description: Karrie enters <highlight>Dual Wield</highlight> state for 10s, during which she gains 20% Movement Speed and throws two lightwheels with each Basic Attack, each dealing 40<scaleAD> (+50/58/66% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and inheriting a portion of Attack Effects.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Use her Ultimate to apply extra Lightwheel Marks with Basic Attacks and 1st Skill to slow enemies, and then chase with her 2nd Skill to secure the kill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use her 1st Skill to poke enemies and slow them,  then follow up with Basic Attacks. She can then use her 2nd Skill to chase or reposition herself.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description:
Assassins like Saber and Aamon who can eliminate 
ranged threats so Karrie can focus the frontline.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Tanks such as Tigreal and Fredrinn that take more damage from her HP percent attacks.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Long range heroes such as Xavier, Layla and Nana due to Karrie's medium range.

abilities.name: Steel Bones
abilities.description:
Gatotkaca gains Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 200). For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100).

Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal extra Magic Damage and recover HP. The extra damage scales with his Rage, level, and Magic Power.

abilities.name: Blast Iron Fist
abilities.description: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100/110/120/130/140/150<scaleAP> (+20% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> per second and be slowed by 30%.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.description: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies on the path to attack him and deal 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> for 0.9 - 1.5s. The taunt duration and sprint distance scale with the channel time. Canceling the Skill reduces 50% of the remaining Cooldown.
abilities.flavor_text: Imprenable!

abilities.name: Avatar of the Guardian
abilities.description:
Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500/750/1000 (+300% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1s. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center.

The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.
abilities.flavor_text: A leap holds the world in awe.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Gatotkaca's Ultimate to dive into the enemy team, then use his 2nd Skill to taunt them, and slow them with his 1st Skill before finishing with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Gatotkaca's 2nd Skill to CC the enemy by charging up to extend the range while aiming, then follow up with his 1st Skill and Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Gatotkaca works best with heroes with strong CC and damage, such as Kagura and Vale who can give his Ultimate even more value.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Due to his great CC and high Physical Defense, Gatotkaca counters Marksmen with no mobility skills like Layla and Popol and Kupa..

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Gatotkaca is countered by heroes that can remove CC like Diggie and Wanwan who will greatly reduce his effectiveness.

abilities.name: Magic Master
abilities.description:
Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attacks and skills to reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 and increase his Attack Speed by 5%-10% (scales with hero level) for 3s on hit. This effect stacks up to 10 times.
Harley's Basic Attacks deal 60 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

abilities.name: Poker Trick
abilities.description:
Harley throws 3 waves of cards, 3/3/4/4/5/5 cards per wave. Each card deals 120/132/144/156/168/180 (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.
After the same target is hit 3 time(s), the damage will decay to 50% on subsequent hits.

abilities.name: Space Escape
abilities.description:
Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his starting location. His Movement Speed increases by 60% for 2s, then returns to normal over 4s.

Use Again: Return to the hat's location.

abilities.name: Deadly Magic
abilities.description: Harley casts a magic ring of fire at an enemy hero, dealing 200/300/400<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and a 40% slow effect that decays to 15% after 1.5s. The ring will stay around the target, during which Harley can hit the ring to damage the target. The ring will explode after 4s, dealing <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> equal to 200<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> plus 30/40/50% of the damage taken by the target while the ring was active.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Harley's 2nd Skill to find a good position to land his Ultimate. Then cast his Ultimate at the target, and follow up with his 1st Skill before moving back to safety with his 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, first use Harley's 2nd Skill to get a good angle to cast his 1st Skill, and follow up with Basic Attacks. Then use his 2nd Skill again to get back to safety.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Harley is best with heroes who can disrupt the enemy formation like Akai and Khufra. He can follow them into the fight and burst down the squishy targets.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Harley counters squishy heroes with poor mobility, such as Cecilion and Ixia, since he can deal burst damage while being on the move.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Harley is countered by tanky heroes like Lolita and Uranus, because Harley can't deal enough meaningful damage to them and they can block and tank his Ultimate for their teammates.

abilities.name: Jungle Heart
abilities.description:
Irithel and Leo's immaculate teamwork allows her to shoot while moving. Each Basic Attack will shoot 2 crossbow bolt(s) (but takes longer to refill) that deal (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per bolt (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).
Moving will build up Jungle Heart, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next Basic Attack to unleash 1 additional bolt(s).

abilities.name: Strafe
abilities.description: Irithel launches a volley of arrows on the target area, dealing 330/370/410/450/490/530<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies within and reducing their Physical Defense by 15 for 3s.

abilities.name: Force of The Queen
abilities.description: Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing 200/230/260/290/320/350<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

abilities.name: Heavy Crossbow
abilities.description: Irithel orders Leo to leap in the target direction and empowers her crossbow for 10s. For the duration, she gains 30 Movement Speed and her Basic Attacks shoot enhanced crossbow bolts, dealing 100/130/160<scaleAD> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the target and nearby units. <highlight>Jungle Heart</highlight> also accumulates faster for the duration.
abilities.flavor_text: No arrow is shot in vain.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Irithel's Ultimate at the start to enhance her Basic Attacks, then use her 1st Skill to reduce the enemies' Defense and use her Basic Attacks to hit multiple enemies. Use her 2nd Skill to slow enemies and prevent them from getting close.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Irithel should maintain distance from the enemy and use her 1st Skill to reduce their Defense. Kite the enemy with Basic Attacks to chip away their HP. If the enemy tries to close in, use her 2nd Skill to maintain distance and continue firing Basic Attacks. When the time is right, use her Ultimate to enhance her Basic Attacks and finish off the enemy.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Irithel works best with heroes that can slow or provide hard CC such as Valir and Hylos because they allow her more opportunities to deal damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Irithel counters heroes with a shorter Basic Attack range than her or ones that lack mobility and can be easily kited, such as Miya and Alpha.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Irithel is countered by heroes with strong CC capabilities or can restrict movement, such as Badang and Silvanna. Because Irithel does not have any Blink skills, her advantage vanishes once her mobility is restricted.

abilities.name: Bastion of Stone
abilities.description:
Grock gains a Shield equal to 14% of his Max HP and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal Physical Damage equal to 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of the target's Max HP (capped at 300(+20*Hero Level) against non-hero units). This effect has a 18-12s cooldown (decreases with level), which reduces by 200% when near terrain.

Grock skills cannot be interrupted, and he gains 30(+6*Hero Level)% extra Physical Defense while the Shield is active.

abilities.name: Mighty Swing
abilities.description: Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440<scaleAD> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked back into the obstacle, launched airborne, and take extra <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 4<scaleHP> (+2% Total Physical Defense)</scaleHP>% of their Max HP (capped at 300<trueDamage>(+20*Hero Level)</trueDamage> against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.

abilities.name: Earthen Rampart
abilities.description:
After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies towards him.
Use Again: Cancel the wall early.

abilities.name: Tectonic Charge
abilities.description: Grock charges forward and gains Control Immunity, dealing 100<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1s and deals 650/850/1050<scaleAD> (+300% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.
abilities.flavor_text: The brave fear nothing.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, initiate with Grock's 2nd Skill to trap the enemies, then charge into the wall with his Ultimate. While the enemies are airborne, find a good angle to slam them into the wall with his 1st Skill and send them airborne again, then finish up with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In small skirmishes, use Grock's 2nd Skill to knock the enemy toward him, then use his 1st Skill to slam them into the wall. Use his Ultimate to charge into the wall and knock them airborne again, and finish the job with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Grock's Ultimate is a powerful CC that covers a wide area,so he pairs well with Mages like Odette and Pharsa to maximize their AOE damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Grock works well against heroes who cannot Blink over his wallto escape his CC,such as Gord and Layla.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Grock is countered by Magic Damage heroes with Blink who can kite him with relative ease,such as Kimmy and Harley.

abilities.name: Warmonger
abilities.description:
When Argus' Meteoric Sword reaches 100 Malice Energy, his next Basic Attack unleashes Demonic Slash, dealing 80 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 100 (+10% Total Physical Attack) HP.
This attack ignores 30% of the target's Physical Defense.

Argus's Meteoric Sword gains 5 Malice Energy per second and 25 Energy per Basic Attack (critical strikes grant an additional 25 Energy). The Energy cap is 200. Each Demonic Slash consumes 100 Energy.

abilities.name: Demonic Grip
abilities.description:
First Cast: Argus stretches out a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125/150/175/200/225/250 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero or creep hit, stunning them for 0.7s. Both Argus and the target are pulled toward each other, then the target is slowed by 40% for 2s.
If no enemy is hit, Argus pulls himself toward the hand's destination instead.

Use Again: Argus dashes and performs a wide slash, dealing 175/200/225/250/275/300 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

abilities.name: Meteoric Sword
abilities.description:
After a short charge, Argus thrusts his Meteoric Sword in the target direction, dealing 60/84/108/132/156/180 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. The charge time decreases as Attack Speed increases.
If an enemy hero is hit, he immediately gains 100 Malice Energy and becomes enhanced for 3s.

While enhanced, he gains 30% Attack Speed, and Demonic Slash restores 50 Malice Energy.

Meteoric Sword counts as a Basic Attack, can trigger Attack Effects, and can Crit.

abilities.name: Eternal Evil
abilities.description:
Argus removes all control effects, dealing 150/225/300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Attack to nearby enemies and gaining Death Immunity for 4s. When the state ends, he converts all damage dealt to heroes during this duration into HP.
Passive: If Argus takes fatal damage while Eternal Evil is not on cooldown, Eternal Evil triggers automatically but only grants Death Immunity for 3s.
abilities.flavor_text: Battlefield is my playground and I think nothing of life and death.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Argus's 1st Skill to close in on the opponent and slow them with his 2nd Skill while hitting with Basic Attacks. If the enemy tries to run, use the second cast of his 1st Skill to chase.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Argus's 1st Skill to pull himself towards the enemy formation, then use the skill again to dash into their backline. Next, slow the enemy with his 2nd Skill and use Basic Attacks until his HP is low, then pop his Ultimate and continue the assault with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Argus works well with utility Supports like Angela and Rafaela who can provide extra Movement Speed and CC to allow Argus to stick to his targets and dish out maximum damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Argus counters heroes with poor mobility who cannot escape his attacks once he closes in, such as Gord and Aurora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Argus is countered by Tanks with high Physical Defense, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because a lot of his damage comes from Basic Attacks.

abilities.name: Lakeshore Ambience
abilities.description:
Each skill cast grants extra range on Odette's next Basic Attack within 8s and causes it to bounce between enemies (or an enemy and herself if only one enemy is in range), dealing 144-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per hit.

Odette's skills will also trigger this effect when hitting an enemy. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Avian Authority
abilities.description: Odette releases a magic swan in the target direction, dealing 300/350/400/450/500/550<scaleAP> (+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

abilities.name: Blue Nova
abilities.description: Odette releases a set of magic energy balls in the target direction, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s. After hitting an enemy, another energy ball will split off and attack a nearby enemy (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing them 250/280/310/340/370/400<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Swan Song
abilities.description:
Odette begins to dance, gaining a 1200/1500/1800 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield while dealing up to 2000/2500/3000 (+750% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a large area around her for 5s. The bounce speed and frequency of Lakeshore Ambience's sound wave in the area are also enhanced when the skill is active.
Use again while the skill is active to dash in the target direction.
The skill is a channeling cast and will be interrupted if Odette is hit by high level control effects (knocked airborne, transformed, etc.) or if she performs another action.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, initiate with Odette's 2nd Skill to immobilize the enemy and activate her Ultimate to continuously damage the controlled targets. Activate the dash from her Ultimate to reposition when enemies are about to escape, and finish them off with her 1st Skill after her Ultimate ends.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Odette's 1st Skill to harass the opponent, and immobilize them with her 2nd Skill at the right moment before securing the kill with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Pair Odette with heroes who can relocate their teammates like Johnson and Jawhead to make it easier for her to find the perfect position for her Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Odette's Ultimate is capable of unleashing massive damage and is effective against heroes lacking interruption skills, such as Layla and Irithel.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Odette is countered by heroes with Crowd Control skills, such as Minotaur and Edith, because they can easily interrupt her Ultimate.

abilities.name: Soul Cutter
abilities.description: Each time Lancelot charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4s, up to 30%.

abilities.name: Puncture
abilities.description:
Lancelot charges in the target direction, dealing 150/175/200/225/250/275 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and applying a Sword Mark to the first unmarked enemy hit. The Sword Mark lasts 3s.

If Lancelot successfully applies a Sword Mark to an enemy, the skill's cooldown will be reset.

abilities.name: Thorned Rose
abilities.description: Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing 220/250/280/310/340/370<scaleAD> (+130% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit (damage is reduced when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable and invincible during this process. Enemies in the center of the area take all the 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5s. The slow effect can stack.

abilities.name: Phantom Execution
abilities.description: After a short delay, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing 350/425/500<scaleAD> (+170% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit. He is invincible throughout the process.
abilities.flavor_text: I become one with the sword.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Lancelot's 1st Skill on frontline enemies to springboard into their backline, then unleash his 2nd Skill on the backline for heavy damage. Follow up with his Ultimate to charge through the target and block their escape, and use his 1st Skill to continue to chase or retreat.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, clear Minions by repeatedly using Lancelot's 1st Skill thanks to the cooldown reset, and stack his Passive before approaching the enemy and hitting them with his 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Lancelot works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, like Atlas and Tigreal, because they allow him to hit more enemies with his AOE skills.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lancelot counters long-range Mages, such as Cecilion and Pharsa, because there is a delay to their skills and Lancelot can use his 1st Skill to dodge them while going in for the kill.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Lancelot is weak against heroes who can counter his mobility like Minsitthar and Phoveus, as his 1st Skill and Ultimate will be heavily restricted.

abilities.name: Young Again
abilities.description: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and turns back to egg form, in which he can continue to move around and gains a new set of skills. He cannot be targeted in egg form and will revive after a period of time.

abilities.name: Auto Alarm Bomb
abilities.description:
Diggie flings an owl alarm to the target location that remains stationary for 25s or until it reacts to the first enemy in range, chasing them and exploding upon collision. The explosion deals 350/400/450/500/550/600 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slows them by 30%.

Diggie gains 2 stacks of Dangerous Sparks each time an enemy hero is hit by the explosion (up to 60 stacks), each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. He loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of Dangerous Sparks each time his skill hits an enemy hero when in egg form.

Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

abilities.name: Reverse Time
abilities.description:
Diggie marks the target enemy hero for 4s and pulls them back to their previous location after the duration ends, dealing 150/200/250/300/350/400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 80%.

If the enemy moves out of the circle, the pull will be triggered early.

abilities.name: Time Journey
abilities.description: Diggie removes all debuffs on nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them a 650/765/880<scaleAP> (+300% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> shield and Control Immunity for 2s. He also gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Diggie's 1st Skill to poke the enemy. If an enemy tries to initiate, pull them back with his 2nd Skill. If a teammate gets CC'd or takes too much damage, use Diggie's Ultimate to save them.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Diggie's 2nd Skill to confine the enemy to their location, then toss an owl alarm at them with his 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Diggie works best with Marksmen that lack mobility or survivability like Layla and Miya because his skills can protect them very well.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Diggie counters close range, CC focused heroes like Atlas and Lolita since he can pull them away and remove their CCs with his Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Diggie is countered by agile and bursty Assassins like Ling and Aamon because his own lack of defense makes him an easy target.

abilities.name: Thickened Blood
abilities.description:
Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana he possesses.

When out of Mana, Hylos can use his HP for skill casts.

abilities.name: Law and Order
abilities.description:
Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3s to deal 300/350/400/450/500/550 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target, knocking back and stunning them for 1s.

The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and vanishes after the next Basic Attack.

abilities.name: Ring of Punishment
abilities.description:
Hylos releases the Ring of Punishment, dealing 100/130/160/190/220/250 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4/4/5/5/6/6% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5/15% for 2.5s (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the Ring of Punishment by 5/8/11/14/17/20%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30 Mana per second when it's active.

Use Again: Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.

abilities.name: Glorious Pathway
abilities.description:
Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement Speed by 75% for 1s. The pathway lasts 6s.
When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3/4/5% of his Max HP per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60/65/70% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the pathway will be slowed by 25/35/45%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description:
In teamfights, use Hylos' Ultimate to create a pathway into the enemy team
and then his 1st Skill to get in and stun an enemy. At the same time, use his 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks to deal continuous damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Hylos should use his 1st Skill to get close and stun the enemy, then follow up with his 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks to deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description:
Hylos works best with heroes that need faster Movement Speed to engage,
such as Terizla and Minsitthar.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Hylos is strong against heroes without mobility skills that can't easily escape his 2nd Skill, like Layla and Gord.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Hylos is countered by high mobility heroes like Karrie and Lesley, as they are hard for him to lock down and can also take him out.

abilities.name: Decimation
abilities.description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied <highlight>Nightmaric Spawn</highlight> on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

abilities.name: Nightmaric Spawn
abilities.description:
Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55/70/85/100% of his Attributes (HP, Hybrid Defense, and Magic Power). Nightmaric Spawn will automatically attack nearby enemies by firing a Death Ray at the target, dealing 55 (+20% extra Attack Speed) (+20% Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30%. If Zhask is too far away from Nightmaric Spawn, it will disappear.
Death Ray is considered as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.
Fusion Enhanced: The damage of Nightmaric Spawn is increased to 180%, and it can be repositioned.

abilities.name: Mind Eater
abilities.description:
Zhask fires a penetrating mental missile in the designated direction, dealing 300/380/460/540 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, Nightmaric Spawn will attack enemies hit by Mind Eater for 120 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun them for 0.5s.

Fusion Enhanced: Increases the damage dealt by Mind Eater by 540/685/830/975 (+180% Total Magic Power).

abilities.name: Hive Clones
abilities.description:
Zhask releases a swarm of Hive Clones in the targeted direction. The clones will explode and deal 55/70/85/100 (+18% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on contact, reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s.
If Hive Clones find no target, they will burrow into the ground and ambush enemies passing by.
Fusion Enhanced: Zhask releases several swarms of Hive Clones.
Subsequent damage dealt to the same target decays to 20%.

abilities.name: Dominator's Descent
abilities.description:
Zhask selects a designated position to summon Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra of them. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period.

Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Zhask should start by summoning his Nightmaric Spawn in a suitable location and use his Ultimate to fuse with it, then unleash his enhanced 2nd and 3rd Skill to stun and damage enemies, and follow up with Basic Attacks. If the enemy tries to flee, use his enhanced 1st Skill to blink toward them.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Zhask should start with his 1st Skill to summon a Nightmaric Spawn next to the enemy and follow up with his 2nd Skill to stun the target, then use his 3rd Skill for more damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Zhask works best with heroes that can lock down enemies so he can have more time to deal damage, like Belerick and Lolita.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Zhask is strong against burst damage heroes like Aldous and Paquito because his high HP after fusing with his Nightmaric Spawn, makes him tough to burst down.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Zhask is countered by agile or long range heroes, such as Pharsa and Cecilion, because they can quickly step out of range of his immobile Nightmaric Spawn.

abilities.name: Shadow of Styx
abilities.description:
Helcurt remains in Prowler state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating (+30% Total Physical Attack) HP if he has not dealt any damage.
He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4s upon being spotted and leaves Prowler state 0.75s later.
Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10s. Helcurt Conceals himself while within the dark fog.
abilities.flavor_text: He who hides in the shadow.

abilities.name: Hidden Terror
abilities.description:
Passive: When Helcurt is in Prowler state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and briefly reveals them. Its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast as normal.

Active: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.
abilities.flavor_text: He who patrols the dark.

abilities.name: Deadly Stinger
abilities.description:
Passive: Helcurt gains one Deadly Stinger for every 1.5s spent in Prowler state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored.
Active: Helcurt fires all Deadly Stingers forward, each dealing 180/200/220/240/260/280 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies (Minions and Creeps take only 70% of the damage).
Deadly Stinger counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.
abilities.flavor_text: He who awaks in the slaughter.

abilities.name: Dark Night Falls
abilities.description:
Helcurt summons the Dark Night, reducing all enemies' sight range and making them lose sight of their allies for 3s. During Dark Night, Helcurt gains 40/45/50% extra Movement Speed.

The Dark Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.
abilities.flavor_text: He who resurrects in the night.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, cast Helcurt's Ultimate to obscure the enemies' vision, then blink to their backline with his 1st Skill to hit with his Basic Attacks, and end with his 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, blink to the target using Helcurt's 1st Skill, then stack up stingers with his Basic Attacks and finish the combo with his 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Helcurt's Ultimate is a great tool to obscure the enemy's vision and makes it easier for him and his team to engage. Additionally, heroes with CC like Tigreal, Esmeralda, and Terizla work great with Helcurt to secure kills.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Helcurt can swiftly approach enemies with his mobility and quickly take down heroes like Layla, Chang'e, and Vale with his burst damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Helcurt should avoid tank heroes that he can't burst down, such as Fredrinn, Belerick, and Gatotkaca. Once Helcurt is caught by their CC, they can make short work of him with their teammates.

abilities.name: Spiritual Unity
abilities.description: Every 5 to 8s (varies with <highlight>Feathered Air Strike</highlight> level), Verri enters the Hunting state and assists Pharsa on her next attack against an enemy hero, dealing extra <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> equal to 8% of the target's Max HP (+ 1% for every 200 Magic Power owned) and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

abilities.name: Curse of Crow
abilities.description:
Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300/325/350/375/400/425 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and marking them for 4s.

When Pharsa hits a marked enemy with a Basic Attack or active skill, the mark is consumed to stun them for 1s.
Marked enemies have their position revealed.

abilities.name: Energy Impact
abilities.description: Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 475/520/565/610/655/700<scaleAP> (+145% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Feathered Air Strike
abilities.description:
Passive: Each level-up reduces Spiritual Unity's interval by 1s.
Active: Pharsa takes flight for 8s and bombards the target location, dealing 530/700/870 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within the area. This skill can be cast up to 4 times within the duration.

abilities.name: Wings by Wings
abilities.description: Pharsa turns into mist and wraps herself around Verri, gaining 150% extra Movement Speed (decaying over time) and the ability to fly over terrain. This state lasts up to 5s or until she uses a Basic Attack or skills, or is controlled.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Pharsa can use her 4th Skill to get into an advantageous position to initiate a teamfight, followed by a damage combo with her 1st and 3rd skills and use her 2nd Skill when she wants to deal extra damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Pharsa should start with her 1st Skill to mark the enemy, follow up with her 2nd Skill to apply CC, and then cast her Ultimate to deal an insane amount of Magic Damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Pharsa is best with heroes who can CC the enemy so that her skills can hit them. Atlas and Franco are good examples of this.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Pharsa can deal high burst damage from a very long range. A great counter to enemy back-row heroes with poor Mobility, such as Layla, Hanabi and Xavier.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Pharsa should beware of any displacement ability skill. Heroes like Franco, Zilong and Minsitthar can easily interrupt Pharsa's Ultimate.

abilities.name: Lethal Shot
abilities.description:
If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5s, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) True Damage (20% extra damage against minions).
Each point of fixed Physical Penetration and each 1% Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 1% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%.
Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her Lethal Shot doubles the amount of energy restored. The Lethal Shot effect will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

abilities.name: Master of Camouflage
abilities.description:
Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85/90/95/100/105/110 extra Physical Attack.

The state lasts 3s or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.

abilities.name: Tactical Grenade
abilities.description:
Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and knocking them back.

Lesley can cast this skill during Ultimate Snipe to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

abilities.name: Ultimate Snipe
abilities.description:
Lesley locks onto the target enemy hero and fires 4 Fatal Bullets in succession, each dealing Physical Damage equal to 250/300/350 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) plus 5% of their lost HP and restoring 10 energy on hit. The Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes.

If this skill is interrupted, each remaining Bullet reduces the skill cooldown by 10%.

Passive: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 10%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Lesley can repeatedly use her 1st Skill to deal more damage with her enhanced Basic Attack while moving. When the enemy hero is close, Lesley can use her 2nd Skill and the enhanced Basic Attack for the counterattack, and use his Ultimate to start reaping.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, once Lesley reaches full energy, and her enhanced Basic Attack is activated, wait for the opportunity to use the enhanced Basic Attack to hit the enemy hero. Then use her 1st Skill to reactivate the enhanced Basic Attack and hit the enemy again, and finally, use her Ultimate to finish off the enemy.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Lesley works best with tank heroes who can provide better attacking conditions for her, like Minotaur and Baxia.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lesley is strong against tank heroes who rely heavily on equipment. Because her attacks can deal True Damage that will ignore the defense these heroes get from the equipment. Such as Gatotkaca and Fredrinn.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Lesley is countered by Assassin heroes with multiple movement abilities, which will cause her to lose her range advantage. Such as Ling and Lancelot.

abilities.name: Mecha Suppression
abilities.description: Each time Jawhead deals damage to an enemy hero or a Creep, he inflicts a stack of Mecha Suppression on them for 3s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack of Mecha Suppression increases all damage dealt to the target by 2% (limited to 50% for Creeps).

abilities.name: Smart Missiles
abilities.description: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5s, each missile dealing 135/160/185/210/235/260<scaleAD> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the enemy hit.

abilities.name: Ejector
abilities.description:
Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 500/600/700/800/900/1000 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s.

Use Again: Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300/340/380/420/460/500 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5s. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350/475/600<scaleAD> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and briefly stunning them. Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Jawhead's 2nd Skill for the Movement Speed and start up his 1st Skill then immediately charge into a target using his Ultimate. Finally, use his 2nd Skill to toss the enemy back.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Jawhead's 2nd Skill to get close to the enemy, then follow up with his 1st Skill and Basic Attacks to deal continuous damage. When the enemy tries to run, use his 2nd Skill again to toss them back.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Jawhead works best with heroes that benefit from a quick engage like Odette and Belerick because he can throw them into the enemy for a surprise attack.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Jawhead counters squishy heroes with no defensive skills that he can burst down after connecting with his Ultimate, such as Saber and Eudora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Jawhead is countered by heroes with high sustained damage or high survivability, like Edith and Thamuz, because they can survive Jawhead's burst damage and beat him in a prolonged battle.

abilities.name: Smart Heart
abilities.description: Angela gains 5% extra Movement Speed for 4s each time she casts a skill (up to 30%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.

abilities.name: Love Waves
abilities.description:
Angela sends Love Waves in the target direction, dealing 170/200/230/260/290/320 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly, and applying a stack of Lover's Mark (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3s.

Love Waves also restore 150/160/170/180/190/200 (+75% Total Magic Power) HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill and the recharge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.

When attached to allies, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 60%.

abilities.name: Puppet-on-a-String
abilities.description:
Angela launches a Puppet String at the target enemy, dealing 300/330/360/390/420/450 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gradually slowing them by up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3s, they'll be immobilized for 1.5s and dealt 450/495/540/585/630/675 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the final damage by 20%.

abilities.name: Heartguard
abilities.description:
Angela begins channeling, applying a 600/800/1000 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield to the target allied hero regardless of distance. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 20s, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost.
Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Angela's Ultimate first to attach to a strong ally, and use her 1st Skill to deal damage or heal allies when needed. When enemies try to close in, CC them with her 2nd Skill, and follow up with her 1st Skill for sustained damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Angela's 1st Skill to constantly poke the enemy. When their HP is low, use her 2nd Skill to CC the target, then continue to deal damage with her 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Angela works best with highly mobile Assassins such as Lancelot and Aamon since she can provide CC and heals while increasing their mobility even further.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Angela counters heroes with low mobility, such as Uranus and Belerick, by slowing them even further and speeding up her allies.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Angela is countered by nimble Assassins with burst damage, such as Ling and Harley.

abilities.name: Dagger Specialist
abilities.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's Max HP and restore 50<scaleAP> (+25% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> HP to himself.

abilities.name: Sword Spike
abilities.description:
Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and marking them.

Use Again: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

abilities.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
abilities.description:
Gusion throws a volley of daggers in the target direction, each dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2s (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%).

Use Again: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65/75/85/95/105/115 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

abilities.name: Incandescence
abilities.description:
Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldowns of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaughter was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter cast, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward.

Use Again: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target direction.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Gusion should first use his 2nd Skill for damage, then his Ultimate to reset the cooldown for his 2nd Skill. Follow up with his 2nd and 1st Skill combo for more damage. And use his 2nd Skill again to recall all 10 daggers right after moving behind a target with his 1st Skill for massive damage. He can then finish off any remaining low-HP heroes and escape with his Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Gusion can use his 1st Skill to mark the enemies, then use his 2nd Skill to slow them down. Next, he can use his 1st Skill again to move behind a target enemy and use his 2nd Skill again to deal massive damage. And finally, use his Basic Attacks to finish off the target.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Gusion works well with heroes with strong opening CC, which will allow him to hit the target more easily with his 1st Skill, such as Vexana and Pharsa.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Gusion is strong against squishy heroes who lack movement abilities, so that Gusion can easily chase them down. Like Layla and Hanabi.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Gusion is countered by tank heroes with good single-target CC. Once controlled by them, Gusion will have a hard time escaping. Such as Franco and Kaja.

abilities.name: Ashing
abilities.description:
Valir's skills apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, dealing them Magic Damage equal to 1 (+0.2% Total Magic Power)% of their Max HP per second for 3s.
At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing Magic Damage equal to 5 (+1% Total Magic Power)% of the target's Max HP to the enemy and stunning them for 1s (the same target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.)

abilities.name: Burst Fireball
abilities.description:
Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235/270/305/340/375/410 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The lingering flame on the ground will explode after 1s, dealing 118/135/153/170/188/205 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9/8.6/8.2/7.8/7.4/7s and can hold up to 2 fireball charges. Hitting an enemy hero or Legend Creep with this skill will immediately restore a fireball charge, while hitting a Minion will restore 4 of the recharge time.
Once enhanced by Vengeance Flame, the cast range of Burst Fireball increases by 30%.

abilities.name: Searing Torrent
abilities.description:
Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them to the end of its path.
Vengeance Flame: The torrent forms a firewall at the end of its path that lasts 4s and deals 100/110/120/130/140/150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second.
Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

abilities.name: Vengeance Flame
abilities.description: Valir removes all existing debuffs on him, gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3s, and conjures 4 <highlight>Vengeance Flames</highlight>, enhancing <highlight>Burst Fireball</highlight> and <highlight>Searing Torrent</highlight> for 9s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, activate Valir's Ultimate to enhance his skills, then blast the enemy with his 1st Skill. If the enemy tries to get close, use his 2nd Skill to push them away, and hit them with his 1st Skill for high damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description:
In the laning phase, harass enemies with Valir's 1st Skill
until their HP is low, then cast his 2nd Skill to push them back and follow up immediately with his 1st Skill for burst damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Teaming up with Fighters with strong initiation like Khaleed and Yu Zhong can simultaneously enhance the entire team's combat potential.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Valir excels in both sustained damage and Crowd Control. He counters heroes lacking mobility like Balmond and Fredrinn.

relationships.title: weak
