relationships.description: Valir is countered by agile Assassins like Lancelot and Fanny because they can easily evade his 1st Skill.

abilities.name: Asura's Wrath
abilities.description: Each time Martis uses a skill, his Attack Speed will be increased by 30%, 120% maximum. Lasts 4s. He gains (+8*Hero Level) extra Attack at full stacks.

abilities.name: Asura Aura
abilities.description: Martis draws enemies to a fan-shaped area in front of him and deals 350/410/470/530/590/650<scaleAD> (+130% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, slowing them by 40% for 2s.

abilities.name: Mortal Coil
abilities.description:
Martis strikes in the target direction three times, each time dealing 225/240/255/270/285/300 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the first and third strike are also knocked back. The attack direction can be changed once using the Joystick.

Use Again: Martis leaps in the target direction, dealing 300/320/340/360/380/400 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne.
Martis gains Control Immunity and 60% Damage Reduction when casting this skill.

abilities.name: Decimation
abilities.description:
Martis lunges at a designated enemy hero, dealing 700/900/1100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (deals True Damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%).
If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can cast the skill again within 10s and gains 100% extra Movement Speed that gradually decays over 5s. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, engage using Martis' 1st Skill to gather enemies and slow them, then use his 2nd Skill to deal damage and knock them airborne, and continue with Basic Attacks. Finish enemies at low HP with his Ultimate, then chain more kills with the Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, initiate with Martis' 1st Skill to gather enemies and slow them, then follow up with his 2nd Skill. Use his 2nd Skill again to stay on the enemy and knock them airborne, and continue attacking with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Martis works best with Fighters that initiate teamfights like Alpha and Khaleed who he can follow up to secure a kill and chain more kills with his Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Martis counters squishy heroes with no mobility skills, such as Layla and Odette, who have a hard time avoiding his 1st Skill - 2nd Skill combo. Their relatively low HP also makes it easier for Martis to put them into execute range for his Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Martis is countered by Fighters with high combat sustainability, such as Thamuz and Fredrinn, because they can survive Martis' burst damage and defeat him in prolonged battles.

abilities.name: Radiance
abilities.description:
Each time Uranus takes damage, he gains a stack of Radiance. Each stack recovers 1.2-11.2 HP (increases with level) every 0.8s for 10s, up to 20 stacks.
Uranus's Basic Attacks deal (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+ 4-8 × Radiance stacks) Magic Damage (increases with level).

abilities.name: Ionic Edge
abilities.description:
Uranus releases 2 energy blades that orbit around him, dealing 155/175/195/215/235/255 (+30% Total Magic Power) (+6/7.6/9.2/10.8/12.4/14 × Radiance stacks) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.
Each blade can only damage the same target once.

abilities.name: Transcendent Ward
abilities.description:
Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80/104/128/152/176/200 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, and 160/208/256/304/352/400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300/390/480/570/660/750 (+200% Total Magic Power) shield for 4s.

The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300/390/480/570/660/750 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.description:
Uranus unleashes the energy stored within his body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200/300/400 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time).

Uranus directly gains 5/10/15 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Uranus should use his 2nd Skill to enter the fight, then his Ultimate to survive under enemy attacks while spamming his 1st Skill for sustained damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Uranus can use his 1st Skill to poke the enemy, then use the 2nd Skill - 1st Skill combo when their HP is low to finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Uranus becomes much more powerful when working with high-damage heroes like Beatrix and Hanabi.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Uranus has great sustainability, making him strong against heroes with low-damage abilities, such as Tigreal and Franco.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Uranus lacks Mobility and CC abilities which makes him an easy target for ranged heroes, such as Layla and Lesley.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
abilities.description: Hanabi's Basic Attacks and skills will launch Petal Blades after hitting a target, dealing 30% damage, and bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies. Bounces from her Basic Attacks inherit her Attack Effects.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Equinox
abilities.description:
Passive: The secret Ninjutsu of the Scarlet Shadow makes Hanabi immune to control effects when she has a shield from any source.

Active: Hanabi gains a 300/360/420/480/540/600 (+40% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s. When the shield is active, Hanabi gains 20% Movement Speed and 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of her damage dealt to enemy heroes will be added to this shield (only adds 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units). This shield cannot exceed 50% of Hanabi's max HP.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
abilities.description: Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing 350/400/450/500/550/600<scaleAD> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1s. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal 30/60/90/120/150/180<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> on them with no damage decay.

abilities.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
abilities.description: Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing 300/400/500<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s. After 1s, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing 300/400/500<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decay to 30% damage.
abilities.flavor_text: A sprout without flowers. A blossom without leaves.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, start with Hanabi's 2nd Skill to slow the enemies, then follow up with her Ultimate to immobilize them and let loose with Basic Attacks. During this time, use her 1st Skill accordingly for more damage and survivability, and keep up the damage with her bouncing Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Hanabi's 2nd Skill to poke the enemy and mark them, and continue to chip away their HP with Basic Attack bounces before using her 1st Skill and engaging them head-on.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Hanabi works well with heroes who can initiate with CC, such as Carmilla and Atlas, so she can focus on maximizing her bounce and Ultimate damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Hanabi counters heroes that rely heavily on CC abilities, such as Tigreal and Belerick, since Hanabi can use her 1st Skill to ignore CC.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Hanabi is weak against heroes with high burst damage, such as Lancelot and Zilong, because they can quickly take down her shield.

abilities.name: Trouble Maker
abilities.description: Each time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them. Each mark reduces the target's Movement Speed by 1%, stacking up to 20%.

abilities.name: Starmoon Shockwave
abilities.description:
Chang'e sends an energy sphere in the target direction, dealing 350/380/410/440/470/500 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5s.

Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon sends 4 extra energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% damage and slowing enemies hit. The slow effect can stack (up to 20%).

abilities.name: Crescent Moon
abilities.description:
Chang'e summons the Crescent Moon, gaining a permanent 300/340/380/420/460/500 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 10% Movement Speed (that lasts until the shield is destroyed). Each time Chang'e casts a skill, she also gains 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s. Crescent Moon also allows Chang'e's Basic Attacks to deal 20 (+35% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage 2 times.

Each time Chang'e deals Magic Damage with her Basic Attack and skills, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 0.2s.

abilities.name: Meteor Shower
abilities.description:
Chang'e fires 30 meteors in the target direction over 4s, each dealing 60/75/90 (+21% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% extra damage to Minions and Creeps. Chang'e also gains 10% Movement Speed for the duration.

Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon also fires meteors along with Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, get the shield from Chang'e's 2nd Skill, then use her 1st Skill to poke enemies, and follow up with her Ultimate if the 1st Skill was on target. Chang'e needs to move around during her Ultimate to keep herself safe and make sure the meteors can hit the target.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, get the buff from Chang'e's 2nd Skill first, then mark the enemy with her Basic Attacks. Cast her 1st Skill to slow down low HP enemy, and finish them off with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Chang'e works well with Tanks who can pull enemies together, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because Chang'e can follow them into teamfights to deal massive damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Chang'e is strong against squishy heroes who have low mobility and short damage range, such as Eudora and Odette. Chang'e can easily hit them with her long-range skills while dodging their attacks.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Chang'e is countered by agile Assassins with high burst like Hanzo and Harley, as they can avoid Chang'e's skills and use their high burst damage to kill her since she lacks self-protection.

abilities.name: Wrath Sanction
abilities.description:
Kaja achieves Wrath Sanction every 6s. His next Basic Attack will send lightning at enemies, dealing Magic Damage equal to 100 (+100% Total Magic Power) plus 4% of targets' Max HP and paralyzing them. The lightning will jump to enemies nearby as well (up to 3 times).

Increases damage by 200% of targets' Max HP on Minions and Creeps.

Paralyze: Slows enemy heroes and summons while reducing their damage by 2.5% (up to 6 stacks) for 5s.

abilities.name: Ring of Order
abilities.description:
Kaja releases a Ringed Electric Blade that quickly expands and contracts, dealing 135/165/195/225/255/285 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit on its way out and back and paralyzing them. Enemies hit will also have their positions revealed briefly.
Each time Electric Blade deals damage, Kaja restores 100 HP (decays to 30% after multiple hits).

abilities.name: Lightning Bomb
abilities.description: Kaja dashes in the target direction while leaving 3 Lightning Bombs along the way. The Bombs will explode upon enemy contact, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300<scaleAP> (+35% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the enemies and <highlight>paralyzing</highlight> them.

abilities.name: Divine Judgment
abilities.description:
Kaja deals 200/350/500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to a designated enemy hero, suppresses and paralyzes them for 1.5s.

During the suppression, Kaja can drag the enemy hero along with him.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, look for opportunities to use Kaja's Ultimate to suppress an important target, then use his 2nd Skill to pull them into his team and finish them off with his 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Kaja's enhanced Basic Attacks and 1st Skill to wear down the enemy while stacking paralyze. Look for a chance to grab the enemy with Kaja's Ultimate then use his 2nd Skill to pull them out of position and into the bombs left by the 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Kaja works best with high burst damage heroes like Eudora and Aamon that can quickly kill a target suppressed by his Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kaja counters Assassins that rely on constant movement, such as Fanny and Lancelot, as his Ultimate will instantly shutdown their mobility.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Kaja is countered by Marksmen or Mages with long range like Layla and Pharsa because the short range of his Ultimate will put him at the mercy of their attacks.

abilities.name: Symbiosis
abilities.description:
Selena can switch freely between her two forms.

Elven Form: Selena applies Abyssal Mark when her skills deal damage. Marks last 8s and can stack up to 2 times.

Abyssal Form: Selena's Basic Attacks become melee and deal (+25% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage. Her skills deal 240-450 (+40% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage to enemies with Abyssal Mark and consume their mark stacks by 1. This damage is increased to 250% against Creeps.

abilities.name: Abyssal Trap
abilities.description:
Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk underground. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches, inflicting a stack of Abyssal Mark and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. The Abyssal Devil then explodes, dealing 350/390/430/470/510/550 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s.

Each additional Abyssal Devil on an enemy increases the final damage by 50%.

Each Abyssal Devil can lurk up to 60s and up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time.
abilities.flavor_text: The iron will of the Abyss befalls.

abilities.name: Soul Eater
abilities.description: Selena strengthens her claws with the power of the Abyss, causing the next Basic Attack to dash to a target and deal an additional 200/230/260/290/320/350<scaleAP> (+130% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> while granting her a 300/320/340/360/380/400<scaleAP> (+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> shield.</br></br>If this damage detonates an <highlight>Abyssal Mark</highlight>, <highlight>Garotte's</highlight> cooldown will reset.
abilities.flavor_text: The iron will of the Abyss befalls.

abilities.name: Abyssal Arrow
abilities.description:
Selena fires an abyssal wraith in the target direction that stops when it hits an enemy hero, Creep, or Summon, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+20% Total Magic Power) to 500/560/620/680/740/800 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target hit and stunning them for 0.5s to 2.5s while revealing their locations (the damage and stun duration increase with the wraith's travel distance).

The wraith will pick up Abyssal Trap as it travels over it and will apply the trap to the enemy target upon stunning them.

If the wraith stuns an enemy for 0.9s or longer, Selena will gain 60% Movement Speed for 2s.

abilities.name: Garotte
abilities.description: Selena charges in the target direction, dealing 150/190/230/270/310/350<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in her path.</br></br>If this skill's damage detonates an <highlight>Abyssal Mark</highlight>, its cooldown will reset.

abilities.name: Primal Darkness
abilities.description:
Passive: Selena gains 5 Magic Power.

Active: Selena enters Abyssal Form and gains 20/30/40/50% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Soul Eater and Garotte.

abilities.name: Blessing of the Moon Goddess
abilities.description:
Passive: Selena gains 5 Magic Power.

Active: Selena enters Abyssal Form and gains 20/30/40/50% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Abyssal Trap and Abyssal Arrow.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Stay in Elven Form to cast her 1st and 2nd skill combo to catch the enemy hero in distance. Then cast her Ultimate to enter her Abyssal Form. Follow with her 2nd and 1st skill combo to close in and finish off the target, then cast her 2nd Skill to dash away.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Elven Form Selena can use her 2nd Skill to stun the enemy, then use her 1st Skill to poke enemies and deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Selena works well with ranged heroes that can deal high burst damage, such as Xavier and Beatrix.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Selena is strong against squishy heroes with poor Mobility, simply because it's hard for them to dodge her 2nd Skill. Such as Gord and Layla.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: But Selena is weak against heroes that can resist or remove her CC abilities, such as Hanabi and Wanwan.

abilities.name: Contract: Transform
abilities.description:
After every 2 Basic Attacks, Aldous gains a 500 (+3 times the number of Soul Steal stacks) shield for 3s on his next Basic Attack.
This effect can only be triggered once every 5s.

abilities.name: Contract: Soul Steal
abilities.description:
Aldous unleashes his inner energy to enhance his next Basic Attack to deal Physical Damage equal to 200/250/300/350/400/450 (+100% Total Physical Attack) plus 5 times the number of Soul Steal stacks.

If this attack kills an enemy hero/Siege Minion/other non-hero unit, Aldous will gain 10/10/4 stacks of Soul Steal (up to 650 stacks).

The enhanced Basic Attack deals 300% extra Base Damage to Minions or Creeps. Aldous gets an extra 5/2 stack(s) of Soul Steal when a nearby enemy Siege Minion/other non-hero unit dies.

abilities.name: Contract: Explosion
abilities.description: Aldous assumes a defensive stance, gaining 30% Damage Reduction and 20% extra Movement Speed for 2s or until manual cancellation. He then deals 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAD> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD>-200/240/280/320/360/400<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5-1s (scales with defensive stance duration).

abilities.name: Contract: Chase Fate
abilities.description: Aldous gains vision of all enemy heroes for 5s. During this time, if Aldous uses this skill again, he can dash toward an enemy hero. When Aldous hits that enemy hero, he will deal <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 250/325/400 plus 8% of the target's Max HP and knock back the target for 1s. (Aldous can interrupt target's Recall during the dash.)

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Aldous' Ultimate to gain vision on the enemy team, then use his Ultimate again to dash to the most vulnerable target. After the dash, use Aldous' 1st and 2nd skill combo to hit the enemy with his enhanced Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Aldous' 1st Skill to enhance his next Basic Attack, then his 2nd Skill to close in on the enemy to hit them with his enhanced attack. Follow with another 1st Skill to hit the enemy with another enhanced Basic Attack.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Aldous works well with heroes that are strong in the early game so that he can farm efficiently, such as Balmond and Bruno.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Aldous is strong against heroes who cannot pressure him in the early game, so that he can easily build up the damage buff for his 1st Skill. Such as Zilong and Leomord.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Aldous is countered by heroes who are strong in the early game. They would make it very difficult for Aldous to build up the damage buff he needs. Heroes like Martis and Dyrroth are good examples here.

abilities.name: Battle Side-by-side
abilities.description: <highlight>Dexter</highlight> assists Claude on each of his Basic Attacks, dealing 25<scaleAD> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the same target (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).

abilities.name: Art of Thievery
abilities.description:
Claude emits a disruption wave in the target direction, dealing 250/270/290/310/330/350 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and reducing their Movement Speed by 20/20/25/25/30/30% and Attack Speed by 10/12/14/16/18/20%.

For each enemy hit, Claude gains 4/4.6/5.2/5.8/6.4/7% Movement & Attack Speed (doubled for enemy heroes hit) for 6s (up to 5 stacks).

abilities.name: Battle Mirror Image
abilities.description:
Claude conjures a mirror image of Dexter at the target location that automatically attacks nearby enemies for 5.5s. The mirror image's Basic Attack deals 25 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and can trigger Claude's attack effects.

Use Again: Claude switches places with the mirror image.

abilities.name: Blazing Duet
abilities.description: Claude and <highlight>Dexter</highlight> rapidly fire at nearby enemies for 3s, dealing 40/50/60<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to up to two enemies with each shot (these attacks count as Basic Attacks). Claude also gains a 20<scaleAD> (+3% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> shield each time the Ultimate deals damage to an enemy.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Claude should use his 1st Skill to stack up his buff first, and look for the best opportunities to get close to enemies with his 2nd Skill, and then use his Ultimate to finish them off.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Claude can use his 1st Skill to poke the enemy, and use his 2nd Skill to close in on them when their HP is low, then use his Ultimate to kill them.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Claude works best with heroes who can buff him, like Angela and Faramis.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Claude is strong against heroes with weak CC abilities and poor Mobility, so he can easily dodge their attacks with his 2nd Skill, such as Vexana and Luo Yi.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Claude is countered by heroes with powerful CC abilities. Their CC abilities will cause Claude to lose his Mobility advantage. Like Eudora and Franco.

abilities.name: Windtalk
abilities.description: Vale gains 1 stack of <highlight>Windtalk</highlight> each time he gets a kill or an assist that increases his Movement Speed by 8. This effect can stack up to 10 times.

abilities.name: Wind Blade
abilities.description: Vale unleashes two wind blades toward the left and right of a target area, each dealing 250/290/320/370/410/450<scaleAP> (+80% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Windblow
abilities.description: Vale sends a whirlwind in the target direction, dealing 350/420/490/560/630/700<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s (each enemy can only be knocked airborne 1 time). When the whirlwind reaches its destination, it will remain for 1.6s while continuously dealing a total of 150<scaleAP> (+30% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in range.

abilities.name: Windstorm
abilities.description:
Vale summons a windstorm at the target location, dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 20% while continuously pulling them into its center. After 1s, the windstorm will explode, dealing 900/1150/1400 (+240% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

The remaining whirlwinds will also be pulled into the center.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Vale's 2nd Skill to knock a line of enemies airborne, then follow up with his Ultimate and 1st Skill for a devastating combo.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Vale's 2nd Skill to knock the opponent airborne, then follow up with his 1st Skill for damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Vale works well with frontline Tanks like Lolita and Belerick who can protect him while he continuously pokes the enemy.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Vale counters slow Fighters like Terizla and Hilda because he can chip away their HP with his skills from afar while using his high Movement Speed to dodge their skills.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Vale is countered by agile Assassins that can become untargetable like Hayabusa and Ling, as it will be difficult to catch them with his CC while they can eliminate Vale easily with their high damage.

abilities.name: The Oath Keeper
abilities.description:
Leomord's Basic Attacks and skills grant him 25 Oath Keeper energy each time they deal damage to targets. When the energy reaches 100, his next Basic Attack deals 200% Crit Damage and restores 100(+10*Heo Level) 15(+15% Extra Max HP).

Leomord's Basic Attacks cannot normally Crit, and every 1% Crit Chance is converted into 1% Crit Damage.

Mounted State: Each Oath Keeper energy gain is increased by 200%.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description:
Leomord begins channeling, slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to 500/560/620/680/740/800 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (scales with channeling time; increased to 140% against creeps except for the Turtle and Lord) and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

Use Again: Cast the skill again to cancel the channeling and immediately perform the thrust.

abilities.name: Phantom Stomp
abilities.description: Barbiel leaps forward, dealing 325/380/435/490/545/600 <scaleAD> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in the landing area and in front of him, while slowing them by 40% for 1s.

abilities.name: Decimation Assault
abilities.description: Leomord charges in a designated direction, dealing 300/320/340/360/380/400<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

abilities.name: Phantom Charge
abilities.description: Barbiel charges forward in a designated direction, and knocks back all enemies on the path, dealing 300/340/380/420/460/500<scaleAD> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>.

abilities.name: Phantom Steed
abilities.description:
Leomord summons Barbiel to rush to him, knocking back and dealing 100/200/300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path.
If Barbiel comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s.
Mounted State: Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains 70 Movement Speed and 30/60/90 Physical & Magic Defense.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Leomord can cast his Ultimate, then his 1st and 2nd Skills while Barbiel is moving towards him. After mounting, Leomord can use his mounted 1st Skill, 2nd Skill, and Basic Attacks to continue dishing out damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Poke and zone out enemies with his 1st Skill while clearing minions. When the enemy's HP is close to his Passive's threshold, charge in with his 2nd Skill and finish them off with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Heroes with AOE or CC like Pharsa and Vexana that can follow up after Leomord breaks the enemy formation.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Mages without mobility such as Odette, Pharsa, Yve and Cecilion will fall to Leomord's high movement speed and burst damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Heroes with CC like Phoveus, Franco, Akai and Nana.

abilities.name: Dreamland Twist
abilities.description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.
When Lunox uses Power of Order, she gains 0.5% of Spell Vamp for every 1% of Magic Penetration.
When Lunox uses Power of Chaos, she gains 0.5% of Magic Penetration for every 1% of Spell Vamp.

abilities.name: Starlight Pulse
abilities.description:
Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing 200/230/260/290/320/350 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The starlight then returns to Lunox, each restoring 75/80/85/90/95/100 (+30% Total Magic Power) HP to her. The HP restored is doubled when hitting enemy heroes.

This skill shares cooldown with Chaos Assault. Grants one stack of Power of Order after use and ends the Power of Chaos enhanced state.

abilities.name: Chaos Assault
abilities.description:
Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at an enemy, dealing Magic Damage equal to 250/270/290/310/330/350 (+120% Total Magic Power) plus 2.5/3/3.5/4/4.5/5% of the target's Max HP (1.5/1.8/2.1/2.4/2.7/3% of Max HP against Creeps).

This skill shares cooldown with Starlight Pulse. Grants one stack of Power of Chaos after use.

abilities.name: Cosmic Fission
abilities.description: When Lunox uses the power of Order and Chaos, she will deal 300/340/380/420/460/500<scaleAP> (+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the targets along the way and slow them by 40% for 2s.

abilities.name: Order & Chaos
abilities.description:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.

When Lunox uses Power of Order, she gains Brilliance and becomes invincible while dealing continuous damage to nearby enemies.

When Lunox uses Power of Chaos, she gains Darkening and can blink in a target direction and greatly reduces the cooldown of Chaos Assault for a brief period.

abilities.name: Power of Order: Brilliance
abilities.description: Lunox extends the Light Barrier, becomes invincible for 2.5s, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed while dealing 100/120/140<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Damage)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> every 0.5s to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Power of Order: Darkening
abilities.description: Lunox blinks in the target direction, dealing 250/350/450<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Damage)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies, slowing them by 30% for 4s.</br></br>For the next 4s, Lunox enhances her <highlight>Power of Chaos</highlight> to greatly reduce the cooldown of <highlight>Chaos Assault</highlight> (unaffected by CD Reduction), but using <highlight>Starlight Pulse</highlight> will end this enhanced state.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Lunox's 3rd Skill to slow the opponent and her 2nd Skill to poke. When she takes damage, use her 1st Skill to heal back up.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Lunox's 3rd Skill to slow enemies first and follow up with her 2nd Skill to gain the Power of Chaos, then activate her Darkening Ultimate and spam her 2nd Skill for a lot of damage. Afterwards, use her 1st Skill to gain the Power of Order, then activate her Brilliance Ultimate to become invincible and deal damage to nearby enemies.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Lunox is best paired with heroes with strong CC abilities like Franco and Minotaur. While Lunox lacks hard CC, if she can spam her skills on a stationary target, she can deal a ton of damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lunox counters heroes that lack burst damage and healing, such as Yve and Lylia, because Lunox can use her self-healing to get the upper hand in a trade.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Lunox is countered by heroes with high mobility since her 2nd Skill has limited range and she lacks CC. Nimble heroes like Nolan and Ling can get in and out of her range all too easily.

abilities.name: Ame no Habakiri
abilities.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of <highlight>Dark Ninjutsu</highlight> on the target, up to 5 stacks. <highlight>Ninjutsu: Demon Feast</highlight> can only be cast on targets with full stacks of <highlight>Dark Ninjutsu</highlight>.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
abilities.description:
The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP.
When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, recovers 10% HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

abilities.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Soul Snatch
abilities.description:
Hanekage dashes to an enemy hero, dealing 300/320/340/360/380/400 (+60/64/68/72/76/80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target after a brief delay. Each stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target increases the damage by 20% (surrounding units are not affected by this bonus). When the target has max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu, it deals additional damage equal to 15 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's Max HP (this damage ignores 30% of the target's Physical Defense) and recovers 20% HP for Hanzo.

This skill can be cast on the Turtle or the Lord (deals up to 1000 damage).

abilities.name: Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
abilities.description:
Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals 90/100/110/120/130/140 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Black Mist
abilities.description:
Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path airborne for 0.4s and dealing 405/450/495/540/585/630 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage (recovers 200 Energy if hitting an enemy hero), leaving a Dark Mist in the area he passes through.

The mist deals 135/150/165/180/195/210 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s (up to 4 times). It also slows enemies in the area by 40%.

This damage is considered Basic Attack Damage, but cannot Crit.

abilities.name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
abilities.description:
Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's position.

While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, while Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed.

Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 16% HP and becoming untargetable during the return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6s, and the skill's cooldown will be doubled.

abilities.name: Ninjutsu Flee: Return
abilities.description: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and exits the Hanekage form.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Hanzo should activate his Ultimate from a safe position and engage as Hanekage. Use his 2nd Skill to dash in and knock enemies Airborne, then use his Black Mist and Basic Attacks to quickly stack his Passive and use his 1st Skill for maximum damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: When ganking, Hanzo can use his 2nd Skill to close the distance, then stack his Passive with Basic Attacks and unleash his 1st Skill at max stacks for hefty damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Hanzo has high burst potential but needs time to stack his Passive, so he works best with heroes who can keep the enemy CC'd, like Aurora, Belerick, and Tigreal.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Hanzo's Ultimate enables him to poke or dive with relative safety, making him a serious threat to squishy heroes without mobility, like Layla, Ixia, and Zhuxin, while also disrupting the enemy in teamfights.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Hanzo fares less favorably against heroes with lots of mobility, such as Fanny, Lancelot, and Arlott, since it's difficult to build stacks on them, thus limiting Hanzo's damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Thorns
abilities.description:
For every 50 damage inflicted upon Belerick, he has a 25% chance to shoot the nearest enemy unit, dealing Magic Damage equal to 55(+5*Hero Level) plus 1.8% of his Max HP (scales with level). This attack can be triggered once every 0.4s.
His HP obtained from Equipment and Emblems is increased by 30%.

abilities.name: Ancient Seed
abilities.description:
Belerick releases vines in a designated direction, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the path and slowing them by 25%. Ancient Seeds left by the vines will erupt into thorns after 1s, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on the path and taunting them for 0.8s.

Deals 80% extra damage against Minions.

abilities.name: Nature's Strike
abilities.description:
Belerick increases his Movement Speed by 80% and enhances his next Basic Attack. (The Movement Speed gained will decrease in 2s.)
This enhanced Basic Attack deals 300/330/360/390/420/450 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows the target by 60% for 1.4s. Belerick also recovers HP equal to 240/288/336/384/432/480 plus 10% of his lost HP.
Each time Deadly Thorns is triggered, reduce the cooldown of this skill by 1s.

abilities.name: Wrath of Dryad
abilities.description: Belerick conjures spreading vines around him, dealing 100/150/200<scaleAP> (+30% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in the area 4 times, taunting and slowing them for 1.5s.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Belerick's 2nd Skill to close the distance with the opponent and slow them with his enhanced Basic Attack, then follow up with his 1st Skill to CC them.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, charge into the enemy formation with Belerick's 2nd Skill and taunt as many targets as possible with his Ultimate, then follow up with his 1st Skill to keep them taunted.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Belerick works well with heroes who can dish out a lot of damage against enemies CC'd by his taunt, such as Miya and Natan.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Belerick excels at controlling enemies at close range, making him a great counter against squishy Assassins who need to get close to deal damage, like Lancelot and Ling.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Belerick is countered by heroes with long-range attacks like Valir and Xavier.

abilities.name: Aerial Dominance
abilities.description:
Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her Spray Gun, but cannot lock on to a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun attack deals (+18% Total Physical Attack) (+24% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Hitting enemy heroes/non-hero units restores 6/3 Starlium respectively. At max Starlium, Kimmy continuously consumes Starlium to enhance her Basic Attacks, making them deal (+22.5% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) damage and pierce through targets (enhanced Basic Attacks only benefit from 50% of Lifesteal Ratio).
Kimmy doesn't stop moving while shooting and no longer benefits from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed she gains is converted to 1 Magic Power.
Kimmy's Basic Attacks only deal 60% damage to Turrets.

abilities.name: Anti-Grav Thruster
abilities.description:
Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to Slow Effects. She can pass through terrain and gains 120% Movement Speed that decays over 1s. During the flight, she fires 4 Chemical Bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing 20/25/30/35/40/45 (+25% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.
Kimmy does not consume Starlium during flight.

abilities.name: Starlium Beam
abilities.description:
Kimmy fires a Starlium Beam in the target direction that immobilizes enemies in its path and deals 300/360/420/480/540/600 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 1s.
Gain 20/24/28/32/36/40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

abilities.name: Traction Pulse
abilities.description:
Kimmy charges and fires a Traction Pulse in a target direction. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes to deal 150/225/300 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+54% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and creates a force field that slows enemies within by 50%.
After 1s, the field contracts, pulling all enemy heroes to its center and dealing 15/22.5/30% of their current HP as Magic Damage while slowing them by 50% for 2s. Gain 40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Kimmy can initiate with her Ultimate to group up enemies, then follow up with her 2nd Skill to immobilize them, and finish with her enhanced Basic Attacks for lots of damage. If enemies try to counter by closing in on Kimmy, use her 1st Skill to retreat.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Build up Starlium before engaging. Use her 1st Skill to quickly close in on the opponent, then use her 2nd Skill to immobilize them before unleashing her enhanced Basic Attacks for great damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Kimmy excels at controlling and grouping enemies while dealing substantial damage, so she works well with heroes who have AOE CC like Badang and Ruby.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kimmy's ability to Basic Attack while moving makes her effective against heroes who rely on skillshots like Granger and Cecilion.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: As a Marksman who cannot lock onto targets with Basic Attacks, Kimmy can be countered by heroes with high burst damage and mobility, such as Saber and Lancelot.

abilities.name: Grand Lord Lava
abilities.description:
Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a 10%–60% chance (based on Lava's Rage) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing 55 (+60% Total Physical Attack)(+8*Hero Level) True Damage. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy will increase Thamuz's Lava's Rage.
When without Scythes, Thamuz gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his Scythes, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy.

abilities.name: Molten Scythes
abilities.description:
Thamuz tosses Scythes in the target direction. After travelling for a certain distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal 120/150/180/210/240/270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. The Scythes will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and deal 45/52/59/66/73/80 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s.
After leaving Thamuz for a period of time or a certain distance, the Scythes will return to Thamuz and drag enemies in their path to him. Thamuz can approach the Scythes or cast the skill again to retrieve them.

abilities.name: Chasm Trample
abilities.description:
Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal 230/255/280/305/330/355 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2s upon landing.
If the Scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will reset its CD instantly.

abilities.name: Cauterant Inferno
abilities.description:
Thamuz spouts the lava stored in his body, dealing 300/390/480 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and creating a Cauterant Inferno around him. The Cauterant Inferno lasts 9s and deals 30/45/60 (+10% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s to enemies in the area.
Meanwhile, Thamuz gains 800/1000/1200 (+50% Extra Max HP) extra Max HP, heals himself by the same amount, and increases his Attack Speed by 60/80/100%. He also recovers 1.5% Max HP each time he deals damage with Basic Attacks or his Scythes.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Thamuz's 1st Skill to speed up and adjust positioning, then jump into the crowd using his 2nd Skill. Activate his Ultimate followed by a Basic Attack and his 1st Skill, and retrieve the Scythes before continuing with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Thamuz's 1st Skill, then leap to enemy using his 2nd Skill, causing his Scythes to return and resetting the CD of his 1st Skill. Follow up with a Basic Attack and then his 1st Skill, and tap the skill again to retrieve the Scythes and end with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Thamuz can play to his strength when working with Supports who provide Movement Speed or CC, such as Angela and Rafaela, because they enable him to stay on his targets.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Thamuz is good against other sustained damage Fighters like Zilong and Sun because he has the top notch laning power.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Thamuz is countered by agile Marksmen, such as Karrie and Irithel, since he lacks CC and relies on Basic Attacks, making him an easy target to kite.

abilities.name: Key Insight
abilities.description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

abilities.name: Synchro Fission
abilities.description:
Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom will then release Synchro Fission toward each other, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemy units on the path.

When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, dealing 450/540/630/720/810/900 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area.
This skill deals 60% extra damage to creeps (up to 1500 damage).

abilities.name: Chrono Dash
abilities.description:
Harith dashes towards the target direction, gaining a 120/150/180/210/240/270 (+120% Total Magic Power) shield and enhancing his next Basic Attack. Harith's enhanced Basic Attack deals 200/230/260/290/320/350 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's enhanced Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3s. This shield can stack up to 3 times.

The enhanced Basic Attack deals 50/60/70/80/90/100 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to Turrets.

abilities.name: Zaman Force
abilities.description:
Harith uses his Key to summon the Zaman Force, creating a multidimensional rift. Upon appearance, it reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 4s. The rift continuously slows enemy heroes in the area by 40%.

When Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he absorbs its energy, reducing the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1s and Chrono Dash by 3s. Harith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.
abilities.flavor_text: "They say geniuses recognize one another!", a quote from Harley.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, first use Harith's 2nd Skill to get close to the enemy, then follow up with the Ultimate, and start spamming his 1st and 2nd Skill. Dashing through the Ultimate not only reduces his skill cooldowns, but also allows Harith to get multiple enhanced Basic Attacks from his 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, approach the enemy with Harith's 2nd Skill, hit them with an enhanced Basic Attack, then use his 1st Skill to chip away their HP.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Harith pairs well with heroes who have AOE CC and can make it harder for enemies to escape his Ultimate's range, such as Minsitthar and Minotaur.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Harith is a very agile hero and his Ultimate reduces the duration of control effects, so he is excellent at countering heroes who rely on CC and have relatively long casting animations, like Belerick and Johnson.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Harith is countered by heroes who can quickly escape from his Ultimate, such as Novaria and Pharsa.

abilities.name: Mark of the King
abilities.description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <highlight>Mark of the King</highlight>, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all <highlight>Mark of the King</highlight> stacks, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 400<scaleHP> (+6% Total HP)</scaleHP> of Minsitthar's Max HP and stunning the target for 0.8s while healing Minsitthar for 400<scaleHP> (+6% Total HP)</scaleHP> HP. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.

abilities.name: Spear of Glory
abilities.description: Minsitthar thrusts forward with the Spear of Glory, dealing 175/200/225/250/275/300<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the tip of the spear will be stunned for 0.6s. After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls back the spear, dealing 175<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to all enemies along the way and dragging enemy heroes hit to him.

abilities.name: Shield Assault
abilities.description: Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAD> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters <highlight>Phalanx</highlight> state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25/30/35/40/45/50% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAD> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> per hit.

abilities.name: King's Calling
abilities.description:
Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field and deal (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 20% and cannot use movement skills.
abilities.flavor_text: Where will I be?

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Minsitthar should use his 1st Skill to pull in multiple enemies before using his Ultimate to restrict their movement, and then use his 2nd Skill's enhanced Basic Attacks to deal AOE damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Minsitthar should use his 1st Skill to pull the enemy to him and slow them with his 2nd Skill, before unleashing his enhanced Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Minsitthar works best with high damage Marksmen, such as Melissa and Hanabi, because he can create more opportunities for them to deal damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Minsitthar is strong against heroes that rely on mobility skills since his Ultimate disables them. Minsitthar can instantly negate the advantages of heroes like Lancelot, Benedetta and Arlott.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Minsitthar is countered by heroes with high Movement Speed, such as Zilong and Aulus, who can easily dodge his 1st Skill and run out of his Ultimate.

abilities.name: Thalassophobia
abilities.description: Kadita gains the <highlight>Blessing of the Ocean</highlight> every 30s. The Blessing is triggered when she takes damage from enemy heroes and lasts 4s, allowing her to recover 65% of the HP lost within the duration afterward.

abilities.name: Ocean Ode
abilities.description:
Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250/290/330/370/410/450 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain.

Use Again: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

abilities.name: Breath of the Ocean
abilities.description:
After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350/380/410/440/470/500 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s.

Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

abilities.name: Rough Waves
abilities.description:
Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), each dealing 270/300/330 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180/200/220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

When underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.
abilities.flavor_text: Seas and oceans take orders from me!

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, target the enemy's backline with Kadita's 1st Skill, and use her 2nd Skill when passing through enemies to knock them airborne. Follow up with her Ultimate for massive damage and avoid all incoming damage while being untargetable.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Kadita's 1st Skill to constantly harass enemies, and look for opportunities to use her 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Kadita works well with heroes who possess strong CC abilities, such as Atlas and Tigreal, as their CC will make it easier for Kadita to hit more enemies with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kadita excels at countering heroes that lack mobility, such as Aurora and Eudora, because it's difficult for them to escape Kadita's 2nd Skill, and knocking them airborne sets them up for her Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Kadita is countered by heroes with long range and high mobility, such as Clint and Beatrix, since it's difficult for Kadita to close in on them or hit them with her 2nd Skill.

abilities.name: Vicious Retrieval
abilities.description: Every 4s, Faramis' next skill against enemy heroes and summoned objects generates a soul fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore 100<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> HP and gain 2 extra Magic Power (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed soul fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop soul fragments.

abilities.name: Shadow Stampede
abilities.description:
Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% extra Movement Speed, 25/30/35/40/45/50 extra Physical & Magic Defense, 20% cooldown reduction of this skill, and the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes that come into contact with Faramis in this state are dealt 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applied with a Nether Mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Use again to leave the Shadow state early and drag marked enemies toward him.
The range of soul fragment absorption is increased while this skill is active.

abilities.name: Ghost Bursters
abilities.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330/360/390/420/450/480<scaleAP> (+144% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+86% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

abilities.name: Nether Realm
abilities.description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the <highlight>Nether Realm</highlight> for 6s, making affected allied heroes (including himself) enter the <highlight>Specter</highlight> state and granting them 400/600/800 plus 10<scaleAP> (+5% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP>% extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the <highlight>Specter</highlight> state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. An allied hero's <highlight>Specter</highlight> state ends when they leave the <highlight>Nether Realm</highlight>.
abilities.flavor_text: Pain, destruction, death, rebirth! Enjoy the process!

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Faramis' Ultimate to protect his allies, then get close to the enemy and apply Nether Marks with his 1st Skill. Activate the 1st Skill again to pull them over and follow up with his 2nd Skill for additional damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Faramis' 1st Skill to get close to the enemy and hit them with his 2nd Skill while applying a Nether Mark with the 1st Skill. Then, use his 1st Skill again to pull the enemy back to him.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Faramis works well with heroes that are designed to dive into the enemy, such as Leomord and Martis, as he'll be able to maximize the life-saving effect of his Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Faramis' ability to temporarily prevent teammates from being killed makes him a good pick against heroes that go all-in to burst down a target, like Saber and Eudora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Faramis is countered by high mobility heroes that are difficult for him to catch with his 1st Skill, such as Novaria and Pharsa.

abilities.name: Chivalry Fist
abilities.description:
Every time Badang's Basic Attack hits a target, he gains a stack of Chivalry Fist. After gaining 4 stacks, his next Basic Attack deals 50 (+30% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (Minions and Creeps are stunned directly).
Fist Wind generated by Badang's skills will trigger this effect directly, and Fist Wind from his Ultimate increases the stun duration to 1s.

abilities.name: Fist Wind
abilities.description:
Badang unleashes a gust of Fist Wind in the target direction, dealing 125/145/175/185/205/225 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The Fist Wind will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100/115/130/145/160/175 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Fist Wind can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 Chivalry Fist stack upon cast.
Badang stores up to 2 Fist Wind charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4/9.8/9.2/8.6/8/7.2s.

abilities.name: Fist Break
abilities.description:
Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230/250/270/290/310/330 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path while gaining a 350/420/490/560/630/700 (+150% Total Physical Attack) shield that lasts 5s. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knocking them back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4s behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130/140/150/160/170/180 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Use Again: Badang removes the obstacle he created.

abilities.name: Fist Crack
abilities.description:
Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60/90/120 (+54% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit multiple times (can trigger attack effects). The Fist Wind generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30/45/60 (+27% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.
Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.
abilities.flavor_text: Fight to protect and persist for benevolence.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Badang's 2nd Skill when the enemy is grouped up to trap multiple targets in the barrier, and unleash his Ultimate to repeatedly knock them into it for massive damage. Then use his 1st Skill and Basic Attacks to continue the onslaught.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Badang's 1st Skill to whittle down the enemy's HP. Use his 2nd Skill to trap the enemy, then use his 1st Skill to knock them into the barrier to stun them, and finish with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Badang works best with heroes that can pull enemies together to make it easier for him to land his 2nd Skill and Ultimate combo, such as Tigreal and Luo Yi.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Badang counters squishy heroes with low mobility like Layla and Odette who have a hard time escaping from his 2nd Skill into Ultimate combo.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Badang is countered by agile heroes such as Wanwan and Ling who can dodge or escape his 2nd Skill, greatly diminishing his damage and CC.

abilities.name: Spell Curse
abilities.description:
Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals Magic Damage equal to 100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) plus 6% of the target's Max HP. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and heals 8% of his Max HP on hit.
Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4s.

abilities.name: Tyrant's Revenge
abilities.description: Khufra pulls the bandage on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 50/60/70/80/90/100 plus 7<scaleAD> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD>% of his Max HP to all enemy units on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering a first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 50/60/70/80/90/100 plus 7<scaleAD> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD>% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and then knocking them in the air for up to 1s.

abilities.name: Bouncing Ball
abilities.description:
Khufra uses bandage to wrap himself into a magic bouncing ball, increasing his own Physical & Magic Defense by 30/44/58/72/86/100%. Enemies trying to use blink skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.
Each time the magic bouncing ball hits the ground, it will deal Magic Damage equal to 50/60/70/80/90/100 plus 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and slow them by 80% for 0.2s.

abilities.name: Tyrant's Rage
abilities.description: Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300/450/600<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing them down for 1.25/1.5/1.75s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.
abilities.flavor_text: Let those who comply with me thrive and those who resist me perish.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Khufra should open with his 1st Skill, then his Ultimate for area control, follow up with his 2nd Skill to prevent the enemy from escaping with their dash or blink skills.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Khufra uses his 1st Skill to aim while charging before launching himself to CC the enemy target. He then deals damage and slows the target with his enhanced Basic Attack and follows up with his 2nd Skill to keep the target slowed.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Khufra works best with heroes with strong CC abilities that make it easier for his 1st Skill to hit, such as Eudora and Pharsa.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Khufra's 2nd Skill can be used to interrupt movement abilities, making him strong against heroes who fight with movement abilities, such as Joy and Lancelot.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Khufra is countered by resilient tank heroes, as his CC abilities pose no threat to these heroes. Heroes like Fredrinn and Gloo are good examples here.

abilities.name: Capriccio
abilities.description:
Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons have a starting Energy cap of 800. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Each Minion / Creep kill will permanently increase the Energy cap of Granger's Gun and Cannon by 6 / 6, and instantly restore their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Every kill or assist on an enemy hero will permanently increase their Energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% Energy.
Every 1% CD Reduction Granger gains is converted into 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy cost is not affected by Energy Cost Reductions.

abilities.name: Rhapsody
abilities.description:
Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing 60/68/76/84/92/100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last bullet is guaranteed to Crit. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

Granger stops firing when he runs out of Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.

abilities.name: Rondo
abilities.description:
Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15/17/19/21/23/25% Energy for his Gun.

Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.

abilities.name: Death Sonata
abilities.description:
Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150/200/250 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be briefly slowed. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot.
Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Granger's 1st Skill to poke the enemy. When his energy gets low, use his 2nd Skill to replenish it and continue to poke with his 1st Skill.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Granger's Ultimate to poke from a safe distance and continue the attack with his 1st Skill. When the 1st Skill ends, use his Ultimate again for more damage and to reposition. If enemies get close, use his 2nd Skill to create distance and continue dealing damage with his 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Granger pairs well with heroes that have strong CC abilities, such as Franco and Kaja, who can hold enemies in place for Granger's entire 1st Skill.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Granger counters squishy heroes who lack mobility, such as Chang'e and Cecilion, who have a hard time dodging his 1st Skill and are vulnerable to the high damage of his Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Granger is countered by heroes with strong single target killing power. Despite having good mobility, Granger lacks other defensive measures. Heroes like Saber and Hayabusa can quickly get the jump on Granger and finish him off.

abilities.name: Super Magic
abilities.description:
Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies and deals (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks.
Guinevere builds Super Magic each time she deals damage. Once fully charged, her next Basic Attack becomes guided, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic damage on hit and restoring 80 plus 8% of her lost HP.
Enemies hit by Guinevere's skills or enhanced Basic Attack will be marked for 5s. Those with 3 marks will be knocked airborne when hit by her Violet Requiem.

abilities.name: Energy Wave
abilities.description:
Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300/345/390/435/480/525 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.2s.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1s.

abilities.name: Spatial Migration
abilities.description:
Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1s and take 125/140/155/170/185/200 (+50% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage.
Use Again: Guinevere blinks toward the target direction and leaves an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage by hero, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and explodes after 1.5s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Violet Requiem
abilities.description:
Guinevere creates a force field around her, gaining Control Immunity while attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2s, dealing 880/1100/1320 (+385% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in total.
Airborne enemies hit will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times.
abilities.flavor_text: Violet Requiem, where is my dear friend?

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Guinevere can use her 2nd Skill to knock the enemy team airborne and follow with her Ultimate to deal damage while keeping them airborne. She can then use the dash of her 2nd Skill to dodge the incoming damage, or she can choose to use her 1st Skill to deal more damage for a full damage combo.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Guinevere should use her 1st Skill and her enhanced Basic Attacks to clear out the Minions and poke enemy heroes. When enemy heroes' HP is low, user Guinevere's 2nd Skill to close in on them and knock them airborne. Follow up with her Ultimate to try to finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Guinevere works best with heroes with good single-target CC that will give her a better environment to farm and deal damage, such as Franco and Hylos.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Guinevere is strong against heroes with poor sustainability or who are simply weak in the early game. This is because Guinevere can easily deliver her poking combo and escape. Heroes like Zilong and Silvanna are good examples here.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: But Guinevere is countered by heroes with CC immunities or strong CC skills. Since she needs to chain her CC to unleash her full damage potential, such as Badang and Chou.

abilities.name: Starmoon Casket
abilities.description:
Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 100 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.

abilities.name: Frostmoon Shield
abilities.description: Esmeralda gains 400/500/600/700/800/900<scaleAP> (+150% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> Shield and 40% Movement Speed which rapidly decays over its duration for 4s. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of her nearby enemies into her own shield, capped at 50% of her Max HP.

abilities.name: Stardust Dance
abilities.description: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and 300/350/400/450/500/550<scaleAP> (+120% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of <highlight>Frostmoon Shield</highlight> is reduced by 1.5s (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5s reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 10% for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Falling Starmoon
abilities.description:
Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range.

Use Again: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing 350/500/650 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and then blinks to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing 350/500/650 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, enter the fight using Esmeralda's Ultimate, then use her 1st Skill to gain Movement Speed and steal the shields of nearby enemies, before finishing them off with her 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Esmeralda's 1st Skill to approach the enemy and hit them with her 2nd Skill followed by Basic Attacks. Her 1st Skill should be up again soon thanks to the CD reduction from her 2nd Skill, so use her 1st Skill again for Movement Speed and shields, and continue using her 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Esmeralda works best with heroes that can pull enemies together like Atlas and Tigreal to allow her to hit more targets with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Esmeralda works well against heroes with shields, like Akai and Lolita, because her skills not only ignore their shields, but she also converts them into her own.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Esmeralda is countered by highly mobile Marksmen, such as Karrie and Lesley, because she lacks the burst damage to finish them off quickly and can't keep up with their mobility.

abilities.name: Body of Smith
abilities.description:
Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to 20 (+1*Hero Level)%) for every 2.5% HP lost.
He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed he's supposed to receive into 1 extra Physical Attack.

abilities.name: Revenge Strike
abilities.description: Terizla cracks the ground with his hammer and the fissure will spread out, dealing 300/330/360/390/420/450<scaleAD> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. After the fissure hits the first target, it will drill into the target and slow them by 15%. At the same time, Terizla's Movement Speed will be increased by 15/20/25/30/35/40% for 3.5s. The fissure on target will then explode, dealing 300/330/360/390/420/450<scaleAD> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> plus 20% of the enemy's lost HP <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>.

abilities.name: Execution Strike
abilities.description:
Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal 90/135/180/225/270/315 (+135% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third deals 225/270/315/360/405/450 (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.25s (the Slowing Effect can stack).
Deals only 80/84/88/92/96/100% damage to Minions.

abilities.name: Penalty Zone
abilities.description: Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing 300/450/600<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25/35/45%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing 150/200/250<scaleAD> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> each time.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Terizla can open with his Ultimate and his 1st Skill to control the enemy team, then use his 2nd Skill to repeatedly hit the targets pulled by the Scaffold.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Terizla can use his 1st Skill to slow the enemy, then his 2nd Skill to repeatedly deal damage to them.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Terizla works best with heroes who have strong initiation skills that allow him to deal more damage with his skills, heroes like Gatotkaca and Atlas are good examples here.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Terizla is strong against light melee fighters cause they'll have a hard time surviving his heavy skill damage, such as Zilong and Sun.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Terizla is countered by heroes with good Mobility or long attack range, because it will be diffcult to hit them with his skills. Such as Arlott and Lesley.

abilities.name: Firaga Armor
abilities.description:
Firaga Armor inherits 160% of X.Borg's Max HP and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When destroyed, X.Borg rolls in the direction of the Joystick (he is invincible during this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restores it to 30% HP.
