X.Borg's attacks cause enemies to enter Overheated state. Enemies in Overheated state will drop Firaga Supplies when they take damage from X.Borg. Picking up supplies restores 10% of the Armor's HP (or 10 energy while in the Armorless State).
X.Borg's skills deal True Damage to enemies in Overheated state.

abilities.name: Fire Missiles
abilities.description:
X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 25/40/55/70/85/100 (+60% Total Physical Attack) (+40% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 7 times over 2s to enemies in front of him (75/80/85/90/95/100% damage to minions).

Armorless State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

abilities.name: Fire Stake
abilities.description:
X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes forward and recalls them after 1.7s. Each stake deals 50/60/70/80/90/100 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and pulls enemies and Firaga Supplies along its path back to him.

Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake launcher, making the stakes travel farther and closer together.

abilities.name: Last Insanity
abilities.description:
X.Borg charges in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire (cannot pick up Firaga Supplies during this time), dealing 90/100/110 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) (+45% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 12 times and slowing enemies hit by 25%. He stops upon touching an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. After 3s, his mecha suit detonates, dealing 300/500/700 plus 15% of the target's Max HP as True Damage. If his armor is destroyed, it will immediately explode but damage drops to 50%. The detonation destroys his Armor, removes all debuffs, and collects all nearby Firaga Supplies. Cannot be used in Armorless State.

Use Again: Immediately stop spraying fire and detonate early.
abilities.flavor_text: My hometown is once a beautiful place.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, cast X.Borg's 1st Skill, then activate his Ultimate when enemies are clustered, and uses his 2nd Skill to pull them back to him.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, cast X.Borg's 1st Skill then use his 2nd Skill to pull enemies toward him.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: X.Borg pairs well with heroes who excel in burst damage, such as Karina and Martis. X.Borg's AOE damage will leave enemies low enough for his teammate to finishing off.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: X.Borg counters Fighters that lack mobility, such as Terizla and Aulus. His 1st Skill has a large range and can be cast while moving, making it easy for him to kite.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: X.Borg is countered by Fighters with burst damage like Martis and Dyrroth. They can quickly burst down X.Borg when he is Armorless.

abilities.name: Cloud Walker
abilities.description:
Ling's superb Lightness Skill allows him to leap among walls. He gains 4 extra Lightness Points per second when he's on a wall and 5 extra Lightness Points each time he deals damage.

Ling gains 1.6 times Crit Chance from all sources but only has 140% Crit Damage.

abilities.name: Finch Poise
abilities.description:
Passive: Ling’s Critical Chance is permanently increased by 2.5/4.5/6/8.5/10/12.5%.

Active: Ling casts his Lightness Skill, leaping onto the designated wall, entering half-stealth state, restoring Lightness Points more quickly and gaining 30% Movement Speed. If Ling receives damage, he will leave the half-stealth state. If he is controlled, he will fall onto the ground and be slowed by 30% for 2s. When using this skill to jump from a wall to another, it will reset the Cooldown and refresh the half-stealth state.

abilities.name: Defiant Sword
abilities.description:
Ling charges in the target direction and stabs nearby enemies, dealing them 300/320/340/360/380/400 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If Ling casts this skill when he's on the wall (no energy cost), he'll dash to the target location on the ground, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.
Defiant Sword is regarded as Basic Attack.

abilities.name: Tempest of Blades
abilities.description:
Ling leaps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% extra Movement Speed for 1.5s. He ignores obstacles when in the air. He then lands on the ground, dealing 250/350/450 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, knocking those in the center airborne for 1s, and creating a Sword Field for 8s.

Four Tempest of Blades will also appear on the edge of the Sword Field. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of Finch Poise by 4s, reset the cooldown of Defiant Sword, and gain 25 Lightness Points.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Ling should move onto the wall with his 1st Skill, then use his 2nd Skill to land on enemy back-row heroes. Once landed, Ling should attack the target heroes with his Basic Attacks, and then cast his Ultimate to avoid incoming damage. He should then follow his targets when in the air to deal damage and knock them airborne. He can then dash with his 2nd Skill between the Tempest Blades to reset its cooldown and restore Lightness Points.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Ling should use his 1st Skill to leap onto the wall, and strike down with his 2nd Skill to deal damage to the target enemy and slow them. Follow up with Ling's Basic Attacks and his 2nd Skill to chase down the enemy hero.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Ling works best with support heroes with CC abilities, that make Ling more flexible in different situations. Such as Angela and Khufra.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Ling's excellent pursuit abilities and high burst damage make him strong against squishy heroes, like Layla and Hanabi.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Ling is countered by heroes with strong single-target CC and high burst damage, as they can easily control Ling and burst him down. Such as Eudora and Jawhead.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Abyss
abilities.description:
When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he will enhance Burst Strike and Spectre Step.

After every 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth will release Circle Strike, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) - (+180% Total Physical Attack) (scales with level) Physical Damage to enemies in the circle and recovering 7% - 10% Max HP (scales with level) (halved against Minions) This strike does not trigger Attack Effect. Each time he damages an enemy, the cooldown of Burst Strike and Spectre Step will be reduced by 1s.

Dyrroth recovers 2% - 5% Rage per second (scales with level).

abilities.name: Burst Strike
abilities.description:
Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals 240/296/352/408/464/520 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5s. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only 75% on minions.)

Abyss Enhanced: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage, and its Slowing Effect is doubled.

abilities.name: Spectre Step
abilities.description:
Dyrroth dashes in the designated direction. He will stop when he has traveled the max distance or hits one enemy hero or a Creep, dealing 230/255/280/305/330/355 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and slightly knocking them back. When he uses this skill again, he will lock onto a target and release a Fatal Strike, dealing 345/390/435/480/525/570 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing the target's Physical Defense by 40% for 4s.
Abyss Enhanced: Fatal Strike will reach further and deal 150% of the original damage, slow the target by an extra 90% and reduce the target's Physical Defense by 60% for 4s.

abilities.name: Abysm Strike
abilities.description: After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 650/950/1250<scaleAD> (+250% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> plus 20% of the target's lost HP as <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 55% for 0.8s. This skill deals up to 1500/2000/2500 damage to non-hero enemies.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Dyrroth should use his 2nd Skill to close the gap with the enemy, then use his Basic Attacks and 1st Skill to deal damage, and finish off the low HP heroes with his Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Dyrroth can use his 2nd Skill to close in on the enemy and cast it again to lower their Physical Defense. He can then follow up with his Basic Attacks and 1st Skill to poke them.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Dyrroth's high melee burst damage works best with heroes with single-target CC, such as Franco and Kaja.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Dyrroth has good chasing abilities and good melee burst damage, he is strong against heroes with poor Mobility, such as Gord and Hanabi.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Being a melee hero makes Dyrroth weak against heroes with Slow and kiting abilities, such as Vexana and Belerick.

abilities.name: Angry Gloom
abilities.description:
Lylia gets power from Gloom, increasing her Movement Speed by 15%. Each Gloom upgrade further increases this bonus by 5%.
Gloom gains an upgrade every time he devours Shadow Energy, up to 5 times. Gloom upgrade increases the detonation damage of Shadow Energy.

abilities.name: Magic Shockwave
abilities.description:
Lylia sends out Gloom with a shockwave, dealing 250/300/350/400/450/500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.
If Gloom touches Shadow Energy, he will devour and detonate it.

abilities.name: Shadow Energy
abilities.description:
Lylia condenses Shadow Energy at the target location, dealing 90/100/110/120/130/140/150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 80%.
Shadow Energy can be detonated by Gloom's devour, dealing 220/255/290/325/360/395/430 (+115% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemies nearby. Each Gloom upgrade increases the detonation damage by 20%, up to 80%.
Gloom will restore 20% of Shadow Energy's Recharge Time when it hits an enemy hero.
Lylia starts with the Shadow Energy skill, storing one charge every 6s.

abilities.name: Black Shoes
abilities.description: Lylia returns to the Black Shoes' location 4s ago and restores her HP and Mana to the previous state, and an extra 10/15/20% Max HP. She also gains 20% extra Movement Speed for 2/3/4s.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use Lylia's 2nd Skill to hit the opponent, then use her 1st Skill to detonate the Shadow Energy for a significant burst of damage. Continue to throw her 2nd Skill at the enemy and detonate it with Gloom.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Use Lylia's 2nd Skill multiple times to cover a large area with Shadow Energy, then detonate a chain reaction with her 1st Skill. Continue to spam Lylia's 2nd Skill and detonate with Gloom to quickly set off multiple explosions at once. When in danger, use Lylia's Ultimate to return to safety and recover.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Lylia excels in prolonged battles, and works well with heroes with strong CC, like Franco and Minotaur.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lylia counters Tank heroes without Blink skills, such as Carmilla and Hylos, who cannot easily escape Gloom's AOE range and are more susceptible to Lylia's high sustained damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Since most of Lylia's damage comes from detonating her 2nd Skill, but setting up Gloom can be quite slow, nimble Assassins like Nolan and Ling counter Lylia as she'll have a tough time hitting them.

abilities.name: Baxia Mark
abilities.description:
Baxia activates the "Baxia Mark" permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15(+1*Hero Level).
At the same time, Baxia will reduce the Shield and HP Regen of enemies hit by his skills by 40% for 4s.

abilities.name: Baxia-Shield Unity
abilities.description:
Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal 300/320/340/360/380/400 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8s and slightly knocking other nearby enemies back.
During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike this hero, dealing 375/400/425/450/475/500 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the target hit for 1.5s, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.

abilities.name: Shield of Spirit
abilities.description:
Baxia throws out his shield, dealing Magic Damage equal to 180/195/210/225/240/255 (+120% Total Magic Power) plus 6% of the target's Max HP to the enemies along the way, marking them for 5s, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep.
Baxia can cast the skill again in a short while. If an enemy hero or creep is hit by the skill, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 15%.

abilities.name: Tortoise’s Puissance
abilities.description:
Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10/12/14s while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take 40/45/50 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and be slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s.
For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from Baxia Mark is increased to 200/230/260%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, first activate Baxia's 1st Skill, then use his Ultimate to speed up. After running into an enemy, use his 2nd Skill followed by Basic Attacks to deal damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, roll into the enemy with Baxia's 1st Skill and follow up with his 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Baxia can utilize his AOE damage and slow effect to help sustained damage heroes like Thamuz and Alpha stay on their targets.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Baxia counters heroes with multi-hit skills or those who rely on shields or HP Regen, such as Chang'e and Silvanna, thanks to his Passive.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Baxia is countered by agile Marksmen who deal True Damage like Karrie and Lesley because they can easily stay out of Baxia's range while dealing massive damage to him.

abilities.name: Ancient Strength
abilities.description: Blessed by the Bear King, Masha has 3 HP bars and won't die until all of them are depleted. She can ignore an instance of damage and remove all Control effects on herself each time she loses an HP bar. When Masha only has two HP bars left, skills will only require 50% of their original HP Cost to cast. When Masha only has one HP bar left, she doesn't need to spend HP to cast skills.

abilities.name: Wild Power
abilities.description:
Passive: Masha gains Power of the Wild which causes her Basic Attacks to deal extra Physical Damage equal to 2 (+1% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's Max HP (up to 60/72/84/96/108/120 against Creeps and doesn't take effect on Turrets or Base).
Active: Masha spends 24/22.4/20.8/19.2/17.6/16% HP to increase her Movement Speed by 60% for 1.5s. She also increases the extra Physical Damage from Power of the Wild by 3/3.6/4.2/4.8/5.4/6 (+1% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's Max HP and gains 50% extra Attack Speed for her next two Basic Attacks.

abilities.name: Howl Shock
abilities.description: Masha spends 24/22.2/20.8/19.2/17.6/16% HP to roar at enemies, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and reducing their Attack Speed by 50% for 2s.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Masha spends 34/29/24% HP to lunge at an enemy hero (immune to control effects during the lunge), dealing 400/450/500<scaleAD> (+220% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, slowing them by 25% for 2s, and knocking back nearby enemies. The cooldown of this skill will be reset each time Masha loses an HP bar.

abilities.name: Life Recovery
abilities.description:
Masha gains Energy when dealing damage to enemies and extra Energy when dealing damage with Wild Power.

After leaving combat for 3s, Masha can activate this skill to spend half a full bar of Energy to recover a full HP bar. Masha is invincible while casting this skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Masha's 1st Skill to close the gap with the enemy and slow them with her 2nd Skill to engage. Follow up with Basic Attacks for more damage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, charge into an enemy with Masha's Ultimate, then use her 1st Skill followed by Basic Attacks to deal more damage. Whenever she loses an HP bar, use her Ultimate again to charge at the target and slow them with her 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Masha can maximize her effectiveness and damage when paired with utility Supports that provide extra Movement Speed and CC, such as Angela and Rafaela.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Masha works well against Marksmen with low mobility, such as Ixia and Layla, as she can easily chase them down using her Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Masha is countered by Fighters with strong Regen capabilities like Cici and Thamuz, because they can outlast Masha in a prolonged fight due to her comparatively lower Regen.

abilities.name: Tiger Pace
abilities.description:
Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses and positions exposed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67(+3*Hero Level) extra True Damage and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s.
Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Swallow’s Path
abilities.description: Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering <highlight>Tiger Pace</highlight> while dealing 120/140/160/180/200/220<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 120/140/160/180/200/220<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.

abilities.name: Needles in Flowers
abilities.description: Wanwan removes all control effects on herself and triggers <highlight>Tiger Pace</highlight>. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150/170/190/210/230/250<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Crossbow of Tang
abilities.description:
Wanwan leaps into the air and fires arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60/75/90 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan is untargetable and invincible for the duration and can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration.
Crossbow of Tang can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Basic Attacks to dash with her Passive and adjust position for damage, and then land as many hits as possible with her 1st Skill. After hitting all Weaknesses, reap kills with her Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Wanwan can poke enemies with her 1st Skill and then use Basic Attacks to dash with her Passive and adjust Swallow Daggers' paths to control enemies. After hitting an enemy's three Weaknesses, she can finish them off with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: She's best with Supporting Tanks with powerful crowd control, like Franco and Belerick. They can help Wanwan hit more Weaknesses and unlock her Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Wanwan is exceptional in dashing and powerful against heroes with short ranges or heavy weight, such as Fredrinn and Luo Yi.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: However, due to her lack of durability and short attack range, Mages with longer ranges like Gord can poke her easily. She also lacks survival abilities when taking Burst damage and can be weak against Burst Assassins like Lancelot.

abilities.name: Knightess' Resolve
abilities.description:
Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5s on hit, each mark reducing their Physical & Magic Defense by 3-6 (up to 5 stacks).
Silvanna's skills and Basic Attacks deal 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.

abilities.name: Cometic Lance
abilities.description: Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-Minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing 250/280/310/340/370/400<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1s.

abilities.name: Spiral Strangling
abilities.description:
Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining a 350/380/410/440/470/500 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield. Each spin deals 165/183/201/219/237/255 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slightly pulls targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% of extra Attack Speed she possesses.

The skill deals only 50% damage against Minions.

Spiral Strangling counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

abilities.name: Imperial Justice
abilities.description:
Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350/500/650 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)

Silvanna gains 100% Attack Speed and 40% Lifesteal when in the Circle.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description:
In teamfights, Silvanna can control back-row enemies with her Ultimate
and then stun them with her 1st Skill. Finally, she can deal damage with her 2nd Skill and Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Silvanna can poke enemies with her 2nd Skill and use her 1st Skill to close the distance once they're low on HP. Then, she can control them and finish them off with her Ultimate.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description:
Pairing Silvanna with Tanks gives her sufficient space to dish out damage.
For example, Atlas and Tigreal.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Silvanna has a long attack range and powerful crowd control abilities,which makes her stronger against back-row Mages and Marksmen,such as Layla and Valir.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description:
But she can be weak against Fighters with multiple CCs
like Martis because they can easily interrupt her 2nd Skill.

abilities.name: Overflowing
abilities.description:
Cecilion gains 10 extra Max Mana and recovers 10 Mana each time his skill hits an enemy. Cooldown: 1s.

Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.

abilities.name: Bat Impact
abilities.description:
Cecilion commands a giant bat to dive at the target location, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 85/102/119/136/153/170 (+70% Total Magic Power) (+7% Total Mana) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. The bat also deals 170/204/238/272/306/340 (+140% Total Magic Power) (+14% Total Mana) extra Magic Damage to those near the landing point, and applies Overflowing effect once.

Each subsequent cast within 6s increases this skill's Mana cost by 1.5/1.56/1.62/1.68/1.74/1.8 times (up to 4 stacks).

abilities.name: Sanguine Claws
abilities.description: Cecilion summons a pair of opposing claws at the target location that will clasp together after a short delay, pulling enemies in their paths to the center while dealing them 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+45% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <highlight>(+1.2% Total Mana)</highlight> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and immobilizing them for 1s.

abilities.name: Bats Feast
abilities.description:
Cecilion unleashes his Blood Demon power, gaining 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over the duration) and Slow Immunity for 1.5s. Meanwhile, he fires 36 bolts of blood energy at nearby enemies, each dealing 35/40/45 (+8% Total Magic Power) (+0.3% Total Mana) Magic Damage to the enemy hit and slowing them by 3% (up to 30%) for 1s.

Each bolt also restores 10/12.5/15 plus 1% of Cecilion's lost HP for him on hit.

abilities.name: Moonlit Waltz
abilities.description:
When Carmilla is nearby, Cecilion can summon her to become a Vermil Shadow around him, granting him a 520-800 shield (scales with Carmilla's level).
Carmilla can choose to leave Cecilion and charge at the target location, gaining an equal shield while dealing 520-800 Magic Damage (scales with level) to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, initiate with Cecilion's Ultimate to slow the enemy, then hit them with his 1st Skill. When the time is right, pull the enemies together using his 2nd Skill and spam his 1st Skill for damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Cecilion's 2nd Skill to pull enemies together, then repeatedly hit them with his 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Cecilion works well with Tanks with sustained CC abilities, such as Carmilla and Minotaur, since their CC can help Cecilion land his skills.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Cecilion counters less mobile Fighters like Balmond and Terizla because these heroes have a hard time getting close to Cecilion while Cecilion can more easily hit them with his skills.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Cecilion is countered by Assassins who can quickly close the gap like Ling and Fanny because Cecilion lacks defensive tools and his normal skills cannot hit enemies in melee range.

abilities.name: Vampire Pact
abilities.description: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 6-13 Physical & Magic Defense (scales with level) from them. The stolen Physical & Magic Defense can stack up to 5 times and lasts 5s. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 3s.

abilities.name: Crimson Flower
abilities.description:
Carmilla summons three Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5s, dealing 85/95/105/115/125/135 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 6% for 0.8s (the slow effect stacks up to 30%).

Carmilla recovers 45/54/63/72/81/90 (+21% Total Magic Power) HP each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting minions).

abilities.name: Bloodbath
abilities.description:
Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5s.

Use Again: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.6s. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).

abilities.name: Curse of Blood
abilities.description:
Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8s, enemies still within the area will take 450/600/750 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and will be immobilized for 1s, slowed by 30% and linked for 5s.

When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Carmilla's 2nd Skill to get close to the opponent, then use her 1st Skill and stick to them to deal continuous damage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Carmilla's Ultimate to engage and slow enemies, then use her 2nd Skill to get close and CC a target, and follow up with her 1st Skill for continuous AOE damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Carmilla is best paired with sustained damage Mages with CC abilities like Cecilion and Aurora, as her Ultimate can greatly amplify their strengths.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Carmilla counters melee Fighters with low durability, such as Dyrroth and Lapu-Lapu, because she can rapidly steal their Defenses with her 1st Skill and Passive while healing herself.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Carmilla is countered by heroes that can ignore or remove her CC, such as Hanabi and Wanwan, since they can't be locked down by Carmilla's 2nd Skill or Ultimate.

abilities.name: Frigid Breath
abilities.description:
Atlas generates Frigid Breath around him for 5s each time he casts a skill. Enemies affected by Frigid Breath will have their Movement Speed gradually reduced over 2s, after which they'll be frozen for 0.5s.

Atlas gains 20 (+0.5% Extra Max HP)- extra Physical & Magic Defense when Frigid Breath is present.

abilities.name: Annihilate
abilities.description:
Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions. Each explosion deals 400/440/480/520/560/600 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.
Ejected State: If Atlas is ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both he and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.

abilities.name: Perfect Match
abilities.description:
Atlas enters Ejected State, gaining 40% Movement Speed and immunity to Slowing Effects. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by Suppression). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing 320/340/360/380/400/420 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby and stunning them for 0.8s.
Ejected State: Atlas and his Mecha share the same HP bar and reduce 50% of the damage taken in this state.

abilities.name: Fatal Links
abilities.description:
Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by suppression), dealing 225/350/475 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3s.
Use this skill again while channeling: Atlas will drag the targets toward him and plunk them down on the designated location, dealing 360/560/760 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Use this skill in Ejected State: The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% Slowing Effect.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Atlas's 2nd Skill to approach the enemy and unleash his Ultimate when multiple enemies are in range. Aim while channeling and release to slam them down near your team, then continue to deal damage with his 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Atlas's 2nd Skill to eject and then get close to the enemy. Right before the Mecha Sentry reaches Atlas, use his 1st Skill to double the effect.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Atlas works well with heroes with high AOE damage like Vale and Ixia because Atlas can pull enemies together and keep them CC'd.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Atlas counters squishy heroes without mobility skills like Vexana and Eudora because they cannot reliably escape his CC.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Atlas is countered by heroes who can knock him away, such as Valir and Moskov, since they can easily stop his 2nd Skill which Atlas relies on to land his other skills.

abilities.name: We Are Friends
abilities.description:
Kupa recovers 10% Max HP per second after not taking damage for 5s. When Kupa is killed, Popol can Pray for 3s to bring Kupa back to the battlefield. Cooldown: 30s.
Every 3 consecutive attacks from Kupa will enhance Popol's next Basic Attack to deal (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa has 2500 (+1200% Total Physical Attack) Max HP and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and passive equipment effects (excluding Jungling and Roaming equipment effects).
Kupa deals an additional 120% damage against Creeps.
abilities.flavor_text: Popol and Kupa always fight alongside each other.

abilities.name: Bite 'em, Kupa!
abilities.description:
Popol throws a spear at the target enemy, dealing 80/110/140/170 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while simultaneously commanding Kupa to lunge at the target, dealing an additional 70/100/130/160 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa will continue to attack the target for 3s.
Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1s and bites them 3 times in quick succession.

abilities.name: Bite 'em, Kupa!
abilities.description: Popol throws a spear at the target enemy, dealing 80/110/140/170<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> while simultaneously commanding Kupa to lunge at the target, dealing an additional 70/100/130/160<scaleAD> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. Kupa will continue to attack the target for 3s.</br></br><higlight>Alpha Wolf Form</highlight>: Kupa stuns the enemy for 1s and bites them 3 times in quick succession.

abilities.name: Kupa, Help!
abilities.description:
Popol summons Kupa back to his side, gaining a 240/270/300/330 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield while dealing 240/270/300/330 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Kupa will then assist Popol to attack nearby enemies for 3s.
Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa darts back to Popol, knocking nearby enemies airborne for 0.2s. The shield and damage are increased to 125%.

abilities.name: Kupa, Help!
abilities.description: Popol summons Kupa back to his side, gaining a 240/270/300/330<scaleAD> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> shield while dealing 240/270/300/330<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Kupa will then assist Popol to attack nearby enemies for 3s.</br></br><highlight>Alpha Wolf Form</highlight>: Kupa darts back to Popol, knocking nearby enemies airborne for 0.2s. The shield and damage are increased to 125%.

abilities.name: Popol's Surprise
abilities.description:
Popol sets a trap at the target location that will detonate after a short delay once triggered, dealing 70/80/90/100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy that steps on it, immobilizing them for 1s, and creating a frost zone for 4s. Enemies in the frost zone will have their Movement Speed reduced by 20%.
Popol gains a trap charge every 22/20/18/16s (up to 3). Up to 3 traps can exist at the same time on the battlefield, each lasting up to 60s.

abilities.name: We Are Angry!
abilities.description:
Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state for 12s, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed and increasing their Attack Speed to 1.3/1.5/1.7 times.
Kupa turns into Alpha Wolf Form, gaining 1500/2500/3500 extra Max HP, fully restoring its HP, while enhancing its other skills.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, boost Attack Speed with their Ultimate and control enemies with the enhanced 1st Skill for heavy damage. When enemies are close, use the enhanced 2nd Skill for protection.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, poke enemies with the 1st Skill and get more Attack Speed with their Ultimate when enemies are low on HP. Then control and kill the enemies with the enhanced 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Popol and Kupa are best with Fighters that can charge into enemies' midst and ensure the survival of Popol and Kupa after controlling and killing enemies. For example, Alpha and Khaleed.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kupa is powerful in combat, especially against Marksmen with lower sustainability such as Lesley and Brody.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description:
But since Popol and Kupa don't have any Blink skills
and Popol is quite squishy, they are at the mercy of more agile Assassins like Gusion and Karina.

abilities.name: Cursing Touch
abilities.description: Yu Zhong applies <highlight>Sha Residue</highlight> to enemy heroes every time he deals damage to them. <highlight>Sha Residue</highlight> erupts upon reaching 5 stacks on a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4s to deal <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 20<scaleAD> (+20% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> plus 2.5% of the target's lost HP to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When <highlight>Sha Residue</highlight> erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed for 3s.

abilities.name: Dragon Tail
abilities.description: Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220/280/340/400<scaleAD> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of <highlight>Sha Residue</highlight>.

abilities.name: Soul Grip
abilities.description:
Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150/200/250/300 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

Upon hitting an enemy, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 108/144/180/216 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting multiple enemies, the enhanced Basic Attack will apply multiple stacks of Sha Residue and deal up to 200% damage.

abilities.name: Furious Dive
abilities.description:
Yu Zhong leaps towards the designated area with his full strength, dealing 180/210/240/270 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He is able to dash one more time in the movement direction.
After a short delay, enemies within the area of effect will be knocked airborne for 0.6s and take 180/210/240/270 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) additional Physical Damage.
abilities.flavor_text: I once passed on this technique to a girl.

abilities.name: Black Dragon Form
abilities.description:
After channeling for 0.6s, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7s, he cannot use any skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in his path while dealing 180/245/310 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He also gains 1000/1500/2000 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Max HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form.
Upon exiting the Black Dragon Form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid Form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, open with Yu Zhong's Ultimate and run into the enemy's formation while knocking them around. When the enemy's backline heroes are exposed, use his Ultimate again to enter Dragonoid Form, and unleash his combo starting with his 2nd Skill then 3rd Skill, then 1st Skill to deal tons of damage. Finally, use the enhanced Basic Attack from his 2nd Skill to finish off the enemy.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Yu Zhong's 2nd Skill to slow the enemy and leap on them using his 3rd Skill. When repositioning with the dash of his 3rd Skill, cast his 1st Skill to hit the enemy with the outer edge, and follow up with the enhanced Basic Attack from his 2nd Skill and finish the combo with a Sha Residue eruption.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Yu Zhong works well with Mages that can initiate with CC such as Vexana and Xavier. Their control effects allow Yu Zhong to land his skills more easily.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Yu Zhong counters squishy Fighter heroes such as Aulus and Zilong, because they can't easily dodge Yu Zhong's skills and have a hard time with him in the early game.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Yu Zhong is countered by nimble Marksman heroes such as Lesley and Karrie, since it's hard for Yu Zhong to land his skills, making him a vulnerable and easy target.

abilities.name: Duality
abilities.description:
Luo Yi's skills can create Sigils of Yin/Yang on the battlefield. Each Sigil lasts up to 6s.
Sigils of opposite attributes will trigger Yin-Yang Reaction when they are within a certain distance, dealing 300 (+25*Hero Level) (+190% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the marked enemies, stunning them for 0.3s, and pulling them toward each other.
Each time Luo Yi applies a new Sigil to a marked enemy, she gains a 300 (+10*Hero Level) (+150% Total Magic Power) shield (up to 3 stacks) and 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2s.

abilities.name: Dispersion
abilities.description:
Luo Yi casts the energy of Yin/Yang in the target direction, dealing 285/330/375/420/465/510 (+135% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and those behind them in a fan-shaped area. Enemy heroes hit are marked with a Sigil of Yin/Yang.
Luo Yi stores up to 4 Dispersion charges and gains 1 charge every 8/7.7/7.4/7.1/6.8/6.5s. She also immediately gains 1 charge each time Yin-Yang Reaction is triggered.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.

abilities.name: Rotation
abilities.description:
Luo Yi summons Fire of Yang/Aqua of Yin at the target location, dealing 250/270/290/310/330/350 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.
Fire of Yan/Aqua of Yin then remains at the location for 6s, dealing 50/54/58/62/66/70 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.7s to nearby enemies. It can also trigger Yin-Yang Reaction with Sigils of opposite attributes.
The state of this skill changes on each cast.

abilities.name: Diversion
abilities.description:
Luo Yi creates a Teleport Circle around herself and marks the target location (within 28/32/38 units) as its destination. After a 3s delay, allied heroes (including herself) within the Circle will be teleported to the location.

Passive: Luo Yi's Cooldown Reduction is increased by 6/8/10%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Luo Yi's 1st Skill to mark the enemy with a Yin/Yang Sigil and use it again on another nearby enemy to apply the opposite Sigil and trigger a Yin-Yang Reaction. Then repeat the process. If there is only one enemy, use Luo Yi's 2nd Skill to trigger Yin-Yang Reactions.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Luo Yi's 1st Skill to mark the enemy with a Yin/Yang Sigil, then use her 2nd Skill to summon Fire of Yang or Aqua of Yin in range of the target to trigger a Yin-Yang Reaction.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Luo Yi works best with Junglers who are often looking for fights around the map, such as Aamon and Karina, because she can use her Ultimate to cut down their travel time.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Luo Yi counters heroes with low mobility such as Eudora and Gord because they are easy targets for her Sigils and Yin-Yang Reactions.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Luo Yi is countered by Fighters or Tanks with high HP recovery like Uranus and Fredrinn because she can't deal enough damage to finish them off quickly.

abilities.name: Elapsed Daytime
abilities.description:
When holding down the Basic Attack button, Benedetta enters the Swordout state and charges up Sword Intent. If the Basic Attack button is released after the Sword Intent is fully charged, Benedetta will use Swordout Slash in the direction she's facing and dash forward, dealing (+215% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on the path (counts as Skill Damage and is reduced to 50% on Minions and Creeps).

Benedetta can only use Swordout Slash when her Sword Intent is fully charged and she is in Swordout state by holding down the Basic Attack button.

Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with her Basic Attacks and skills.

abilities.name: Phantom Slash
abilities.description:
Benedetta withdraws swiftly and leaves a shadow in front. After a short delay, her shadow slashes forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing 200/240/280/320/360/400 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 60% for 0.5s.

Meanwhile, Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing 75/100/125/150/185/200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. (If the target is hit by her shadow, damage caused by Benedetta herself will increase to 200%.)

abilities.name: An Eye for An Eye
abilities.description:
Benedetta raises her weapon to defend, gaining Control Immunity and blocking damage from any source for 0.8s. After this, she stabs in the designated direction, dealing 300/330/360/390/420/450 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

If Benedetta successfully fends off any damage while defending, she will gain full Sword Intent. If she fends off any control effects, her subsequent stab stuns the target for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Alecto: Final Blow
abilities.description: Benedetta clenches Alecto, dashes forward (Benedetta is untargetable during the dash), and performs a slash after a short delay, detonating the Sword Intent along the path. For 2.5s, the Sword Intent deals up to a total of 1560/1820/2080<scaleAD> (+1105% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies within and slows them by 50%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Swordout Slash to get close to the enemy, then use Benedetta's Ultimate where the enemy is clustered, and follow up with her 1st Skill for additional damage and 2nd Skill to block incoming CC.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, gather Sword Intent by holding Benedetta's Basic Attack button, then use Swordout Slash after Sword Intent is maxed to strike the enemy. Follow up with her 1st Skill and try to max out Sword Intent again by blocking the enemy's attack with her 2nd Skill, then end the combo with another Swordout Slash.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Benedetta works well with strong CC initiators, like Johnson and Gatotkaca, because they allow her to maximize the effects of her Ultimate.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Benedetta's 2nd Skill can effectively block enemy CC, making her a great counter to heroes with predictable CC skills, such as Jawhead and Guinevere.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Benedetta is countered by heroes with skills that shutdown mobility skills, such as Minsitthar and Phoveus, since all of Benedetta's skills are considered mobility.

abilities.name: Sand Walk
abilities.description: Khaleed accumulates <highlight>Desert Power</highlight> while moving. After <highlight>Desert Power</highlight> is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal 50<scaleAD> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the target (cannot Crit), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Desert Tornado
abilities.description:
Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 175/220/265/310/355/400 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row.

This skill deals 60/65/70/75/80/85% damage to Minions and Creeps.

abilities.name: Quicksand Guard
abilities.description:
Khaleed protects himself with the power of the quicksand, restoring 60/75/90/105/120/135 plus 5% of his lost HP and 10 Desert Power every 0.5s, reducing damage taken by 25/28/31/34/37/40% for up to 4s.

While channeling, quicksand appears under his feet, slowing the enemy by 60%.
This skill is a Focused Cast. Any other controls will interrupt this skill.

abilities.name: Raging Sandstorm
abilities.description:
Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing 100/175/250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process.

Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing 450/600/750 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1s, and fully charge his Desert Power.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, move around to fill up Khaleed's Desert Power first, then hit the opponent with the enhanced Basic Attack to slow them and follow up with 3 hits from his 1st Skill. This should fill up his Desert Power again, allowing for another enhanced Basic Attack.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Khaleed's Ultimate to initiate, then hit a target with his enhanced Basic Attack and continue the attack with his 1st Skill. Once Desert Power is full again, use another Basic Attack. Then use Khaleed's 2nd Skill to recover HP and reduce incoming damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Because Khaleed can deal a lot of AOE damage, he works well with heroes like Roger and Karina who excel at finishing off multiple low HP targets.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Khaleed counters heroes who lack mobility like Cyclops and Xavier since they will have difficult time avoiding his combo.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Khaleed is countered by heroes who have the ability to knock him back or airborne to interrupt his 2nd Skill, such as X.Borg and Chou.

abilities.name: Big Guy
abilities.description: Detona gains a stack of <highlight>Big Guy</highlight> for 12s each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 20% stacks). Each stack of <highlight>Big Guy</highlight> increases Detona's size, and grants 4-10 extra Hybrid Defense (scales with the level of <highlight>Detona's Welcome</highlight>) and 10 extra Resilience. At max stacks, Detona's Basic Attacks will be replaced with <highlight>Trample</highlight>, which deals <scaleAD> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <scaleHP>(+3.5% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2s, and refreshes the duration of <highlight>Big Guy</highlight> with each hit.

abilities.name: So-Called Teamwork
abilities.description:
Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing 60/80/100/120/140/160 (+7% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing 120/160/200/240/280/320 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area (only 50% damage to Creeps).

The area of effect of So-Called Teamwork increases with the number of Big Guy stacks.

abilities.name: Missile "Expert"
abilities.description: Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing 100/115/130/145/160/175<scaleAD> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing enemies by 40% for 1s. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon landing, dealing 100<scaleAD> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.

abilities.name: Detona's Welcome
abilities.description:
After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120/160/200 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+1.2% Total HP) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2s before spitting them out. If the spat-out target hits an enemy hero or a wall, it triggers an explosion. The target and nearby enemies will take an additional 180/240/300 (+105% Total Physical Attack) (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage and are stunned for 1s.

During the skill, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the cast is canceled on the skill misses, 50% of the skill cooldown is refunded.
If Detona successfully devours an enemy, he immediately gains max stacks of Big Guy.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Barats' 1st Skill to maintain Big Guy stacks. Approach the enemy and use his 2nd Skill to push them close before using his Ultimate to minimize their chance of escape, then finish them off with Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, spam Barats' low Mana cost 1st Skill to build Big Guy stacks while slowing and poking the enemy. Use his 2nd Skill to push the enemy to him and hit them with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Barats works best with Supports who can give him Movement Speed to make up for his lack of mobility, such as Mathilda and Angela.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Barats counters Tank heroes that rely on CC skills, such as Belerick and Lolita, since the extra Resilience provided by his Passive will greatly reduce the duration of their CC.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Barats is countered by agile Marksmen who can deal high damage to Tanks, such as Karrie and Moskov, because Barats lacks mobility and his skills can be avoided, making these heroes very difficult to kill.

abilities.name: Abyss Corrosion
abilities.description:
With his Basic Attacks resonated with the Abyss Power within his body, Brody is able to move while winding up his Basic Attacks (which will be interrupted when casting skills), at the cost of having longer Basic Attack Animation and lower Attack Speed Bonus. Each Basic Attack deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+45*Hero Level) Physical Damage (of which the damage scaling with level cannot be critical), increases Movement Speed by 30% (which will decay rapidly in 1.2s), and applies 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the enemy, capped at 4 stacks.
Each stack of Abyss Mark increases Brody's damage against the target by 5% and his Movement Speed by 5%.

abilities.name: Abyss Impact
abilities.description:
Brody launches a shock wave in the target direction, dealing 200/260/320/380/440/500 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing the enemies by 30% for 1.2s while applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark.

For each enemy hit by the shockwave, they take an extra 5% slow and one extra Abyss Mark stack (capped at 45% slow and 4 stack).

abilities.name: Corrosive Strike
abilities.description:
Brody dashes to an enemy, dealing 200/230/260/290/320/350 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, stunning the target for 0.8s, and applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the target.
Upon hitting the target, he is able to move one more time in the movement direction, gaining 45% Movement Speed that will decay rapidly in 1.2s.

abilities.name: Torn-Apart Memory
abilities.description: Brody locks on all the targets within 8 unit(s), dealing 216/378/540<scaleAD> (+165% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to them. If the target has an <highlight>Abyss Mark</highlight>, all <highlight>Abyss Marks</highlight> will be reset, dealing <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> equal to 94/163/232<scaleAD> (+72% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> plus 4/7/10% of the target's lost HP for each stack the target has.
abilities.flavor_text: Memories are nowhere to be placed. Everything is for me to protect

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Brody should prioritize using his 1st Skill and Basic Attack, to apply Abyss Marks on enemy heroes outside of the battle area. He can then use his Ultimate and Basic Attack to deal heavy damage and his 2nd Skill and Basic Attack to chase down enemies on the run.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Brody can regularly use his 1st Skill and Basic Attacks to clear lanes and poke the enemy heroes. Once enemy heroes are low on HP, Brody can use his 2nd Skill to close in and stun them, then cast his Ultimate to try to finish them off.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Brody works best with heroes who can perform lock-on attacks or heroes with area CC abilities, as they can give Brody more room to deal damage and farm better. Such as Hylos and Minsitthar.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Brody is strong against heroes with poor survivability in the early game and heroes without dash, because he can easily lock on them and attack beyond their reach. Like Aamon and Yin.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Brody is countered by heroes with CC immunity and multiple movement abilities, because they can quickly close in on Brody, giving him no chance to stack the Abyss Mark. Such as Martis and Wanwan.

abilities.name: Galactic Power
abilities.description: When Yve deals damage to enemy heroes with her skills, she gains Galactic Power (cooldown: 0.5s), up to 3 stacks. Each stack provides Yve with a 120(+10*Hero Level)<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> shield for 3s.

abilities.name: Void Blast
abilities.description:
Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 290/340/390/440/490/540 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area.
Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decreases over 1s.

abilities.name: Void Crystal
abilities.description:
Yve summons a Void Crystal at the target location, dealing 220/260/300/340/380/420 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Use Again: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 75/85/95/105/115/125 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 20%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 6% for each hit after the first hit (up to 40%).

abilities.name: Real World Manipulation
abilities.description:
Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 20 times.
Tap: Deals 340/440/540 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the target area.
Swipe: Deals 85/105/125 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 40%.
Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target).
Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Yve's Ultimate to cover as many enemies as possible and unleash multiple attacks on them. When the enemies run out of Yve's Ultimate, cancel it and use her 2nd Skill to slow them, then finish them off with her 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Yve's 2nd Skill to first slow the enemy from afar, then hit them with the center of her 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Yve's works best with Tanks and Supports with strong CC to lockdown enemies for her Ultimate, like Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and Atlas.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Yve counters Tanks and Fighters with low mobility like Fredrinn, Barats, and Aulus due to her long range skills.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Yve's low survivability makes her a target for divers and burst damage heroes like Yin, Saber, and Karina.

abilities.name: Ancestral Guidance
abilities.description: Mathilda gains <highlight>Ancestral Guidance</highlight> while moving. When it's fully charged, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 200<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <scaleAP>(+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the target and granting her 80 extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

abilities.name: Soul Bloom
abilities.description:
Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4s, attracting wisps as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps).

At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda casts this skill again, the wisps will seek and attack nearby enemies, each dealing 275/320/365/410/455/500 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and revealing the enemies' positions briefly. Subsequent damage dealt by wisps to the same target decays to 40%.

abilities.name: Guiding Wind
abilities.description:
Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a 350/400/450/500/550/600 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield and 25% extra Movement Speed for 3s. Allied heroes who come into contact with the field will receive a 50% shield and Guiding Wind. The first allied hero that triggers Guiding Wind will be guided to Mathilda, and both of them will gain the same Movement Speed boost.

When casting this skill during Circling Eagle, Mathilda won't change her position.
Guiding Wind expires 2s after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.

abilities.name: Circling Eagle
abilities.description:
Mathilda applies a Soul Mark to the target enemy hero and circles around them for up to 3.5s, during which her wisps will fly into nearby enemies, each dealing 40/50/60 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The Soul Mark will also slow the target by 15% and Soul Bloom will prioritize the target with Soul Mark.
Within the duration, Mathilda can select an area to dash to. At the end of the duration, she'll dash at the target with Soul Mark, dealing 320/400/480 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while knocking enemies in her path airborne for 0.6s, transferring the Soul Mark to the first enemy hero that she knocks airborne, and reducing the skill cooldown by 40%.
Mathilda gains Control Immunity and a 400/500/600 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield for the skill duration.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, first activate Mathilda's 1st skill, then immediately use her 2nd Skill to get to a good position to initiate from and unleash her Ultimate on the primary target. This combo allows Mathilda to quickly CC a key enemy hero, and lets an ally follow up by using Guiding Wind from her 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Mathilda's 1st Skill in advance and keep moving to gather wisps, then use her 2nd Skill to get close to the enemy and unleash all her wisps at the target before ending with an enhanced Basic Attack. Use her Ultimate to secure the kill if the enemy is low on HP.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Mathilda works well with high burst damage heroes who can use Guiding Wind and follow up her Ultimate to secure kills, such as Saber and Eudora.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Mathilda excels in harassment and single-target CC, making her a great counter to squishy heroes with no escape skills, like Gord and Vale.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Mathilda is countered by Tanks with multiple CC skills, such as Franco and Minsitthar.

abilities.name: Champ Stance
abilities.description:
Paquito gains a stack each time he casts a skill. At 3 stacks, he enters the Champ Stance and enhances his next skill.
Paquito's enhanced skills have no cooldown and deal (+2*Hero Level)% extra damage to minions.

After casting any enhanced skill, Paquito gains 60% Movement Speed and (+2*Hero Level)% Damage Reduction for 1.2s.
abilities.flavor_text: I had no one to depend on except myself.

abilities.name: Heavy Left Punch
abilities.description:
Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing 210/240/270/300/330/360 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and gaining a 150/250/350/450/550/650 (+135% Total Physical Attack) shield.

Champ Stance: The damage is increased to 350/400/450/500/550/600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and the shield value is increased to 140% for 2.5s (normal and enhanced shields can stack).

abilities.name: Jab
abilities.description:
Paquito dashes in the target direction and throws a jab, dealing 200/250/300/350/400/450 (+165% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Paquito will stop and throw the jab immediately upon colliding with an enemy hero or Creep during the dash.

Champ Stance: The damage is increased to 350/430/510/590/670/750 (+230% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

abilities.name: Knockout Strike
abilities.description:
Paquito launches an elbow strike in the target direction, dealing 250/300/350 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocking them back. He then throws a haymaker, dealing 300/375/450 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 75% for 1s, as he darts backward.

Champ Stance: Instead of a haymaker, Paquito launches an uppercut after the elbow strike, dealing 400/500/600 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Paquito can use his 2nd Skill to approach the enemy team, then his 1st Skill to deal damage. He should follow up with his Ultimate to knock the enemy back and enter the Champ Stance. He can finish with his enhanced 2nd Skill to deal heavy damage to the enemies.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Paquito can use his 1st Skill to gain a stack for the Champ Stance before using his 2nd Skill to close in on the enemy hero. He can use his 1st Skill again to deal damage and enter the Champ Stance. He should then hit the enemy hero with the enhanced 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Paquito works best with support heroes who can buff him, like Angela and Rafaela.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Paquito is a hero with dash and high burst damage, making him strong against squishy heroes without defensive abilities, such as Gord and Layla.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Paquito is an agile hero, but he is also kind of squishy, which makes him weak against heroes with strong CC abilities. Such as Franco and Kaja.

abilities.name: Stick, Stick
abilities.description:
Enemies gain a stack of Sticky each time they're hit by Gloo's skills, decreasing their Movement Speed by 3% for 6s. Stacks up to 5.
Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.

abilities.name: Slam, Slam
abilities.description:
Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy.
At the final location, a Goo is left behind that explodes after 3s to deal 250/280/310/340/370/400 (+12% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1s. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will explode immediately, reset the skill's cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5/3.2/3.9/4.6/5.3/6% of Max HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).

abilities.name: Spread, Spread
abilities.description:
Gloo splits into Goos, dealing 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5s. While split, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25s to enemies it touches, lasting 4s.
If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge over to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a distance.

abilities.name: Grab, Grab
abilities.description: Unlocked when any enemy hero has full <highlight>Sticky</highlight> stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target enemy hero for up to 9s, recovering 20/25/30% of its Max HP. For the duration, its Basic Attacks are converted to deal 30<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <scaleHP> (+6% Extra Max HP)</scaleHP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage>, and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding damage from turrets) to its host. If the target dies while attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5s.
abilities.flavor_text: One is all. (All is one.)

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Gloo can use his 1st + 2nd skill combo to close in on the enemy and immobilize them. Then his 1st Skill and Ultimate to add more Sticky stacks to enemy heroes, and attach himself with his Ultimate to the enemy hero with max Sticky stacks. Once ready, Gloo can use the combo to deal damage and move the host out of position. Finally, he can use the refreshed 1st Skill and his Basic Attacks to finish off the host.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Gloo should use his 1st Skill to attack the target enemy and create a Goo, then he can use his 2nd Skill to target the Goo to bring the target to its location and trigger an explosion. Touching the Goo will also reset Gloo's 1st Skill, allowing him to use it again to deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Gloo works best with high burst damage heroes, as they can quickly take down the enemy hero that he brings back with his Ultimate. Like Eudora and Saber.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Gloo is strong against Mage heroes without good CC. Because he can easily attach himself to them, and take them where he wants them to go. Such as Cecilion and Chang'e.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Gloo is countered by Marksman heroes with good mobility. It's difficult for Gloo to attach himself to them, and he can easily be killed if he tries. Such as Karrie and Lesley.

abilities.name: Mechanical Genius
abilities.description:
Her extraordinary talent in the field of mechanics allowed Beatrix to produce 4 weapon(s) of truly awe-inspiring firepower.
Renner Basic Attack - Longshot: Fire a powerful shot in the enemy's current direction, dealing (+365% Total Physical Attack) - (+400% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first target hit (this shot can be dodged, and blocked by others). Deals 75% damage to Creeps.Bennett Basic Attack - Area Bombing: Bombard an area, dealing (+230% Total Physical Attack) - (+300% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in range and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s. Deals 75% damage to Creeps.Wesker Basic Attack - Proximity Advantage: Fire 5 shots at the target, each dealing (+178% Total Physical Attack) - (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (inherits a portion of Attack Effects). Damage dealt to targets hit multiple times will decay to 25%. Deals 75% damage to Creeps.Nibiru Basic Attack - Rapid Fire: Fires a volley of 4 shots at the target, each dealing (+51% Total Physical Attack) - (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inheriting a portion of Attack Effects. Deals 75% damage to Creeps.
Beatrix cannot Crit, and converts every 1% Critical Chance gained into 2 Physical Attack.
Beatrix gains Spell Vamp equal to 100% of her Lifesteal

abilities.name: Masterful Gunner
abilities.description:
Passive: Beatrix can carry 2 weapons at once, and increase her Physical Attack by 5/10/15/20/25/30.
Active: Beatrix takes 0.5s to swap her primary weapon with the secondary she has slung over her back, gaining an all-new way to attack and Ultimate.

abilities.name: Tactical Reposition
abilities.description: Beatrix rolls forward while fully reloading her current weapon.

abilities.name: Renner's Apathy
abilities.description:
Beatrix calmly sets up Renner on the battlefield and takes aim. When releasing the skill, she deals 700/950/1200 (+280% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit.

Beatrix can aim for up to 8s, and she can cancel it early to reduce the cooldown by 50%.

This shot can penetrate Minions and only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

abilities.name: Bennett's Rage
abilities.description:
Beatrix focuses her rage and has Bennett rain down a bombardment on the target area 5 time(s). Each bombardment slows enemies by 40% and deals 580/780/980 (+225% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (this damage decays to 20% when hitting the same target multiple times), lasting 1s.

This skill only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

abilities.name: Wesker's Elation
abilities.description:
Beatrix raises Wesker and fires off ultra bullets that deal 350/450/550 (+155% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time they hit an enemy (the damage of subsequent hits on the same enemy will decay to 25%).

This skill only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

abilities.name: Nibiru's Passion
abilities.description:
Beatrix unleashes 10 volleys of bullets using Nibiru, each dealing 130 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

This skill only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

abilities.name: Need Backup
abilities.description:
Having escaped battle for 3s, Beatrix can call for her butler Morgan to provide her with a backup weapons crate.
Beatrix must then choose two from the crate to serve as her primary and secondary weapons.
Her weapon selection is interrupted if she commits any action or is controlled during this period.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: For teamfights, we recommend using Bennett as Beatrix's primary weapon and Nibiru as her secondary weapon. During a teamfight, Beatrix can use Bennett's Ultimate to strike the enemy team. Then she can use her 1st Skill to switch to Nibiru, and cast Nibiru's Ultimate to attack the enemy. She can finish off the enemy heroes with her Basic Attacks and her 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, we recommend using Renner as Beatrix's primary weapon and Wesker as her secondary weapon. She can use Renner's ranged Basic Attack to poke the enemy, and her 2nd Skill to reload and fire again. She can then switch to Wesker to finish off the target enemy.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Beatrix is strong against heroes without movement abilities, as they can be easily hit by her skills, such as Hylos and Belerick.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Beatrix works best with tank heroes with good CC abilities, as they can help improve the accuracy of Beatrix's skills. Like Khufra and Atlas.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Beatrix is countered by high burst damage heroes with strong single-target CC, as they can catch her with a CC and burst her down. Such as Eudora and Ling.

abilities.name: Demonic Force
abilities.description:
Phoveus's next Basic Attack allows him to charge at the enemy, knocking them back, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 4%-6% of the enemy's Max HP, and gaining a Shield equal to 8%-12% of his Max HP. This effect has a 26-14s cooldown (based on Infernal Pursuit level).
Astaros' Gaze: Whenever an enemy hero blinks, dashes, or is displaced within 8 units of Phoveus, the cooldown of Demonic Force will be reduced by 20% and the cooldown of his other skills will be reduced by 0.5s.

abilities.name: Demonic Impact
abilities.description:
Phoveus slams his monolith into the ground, dealing 200/260/320/380/440/500 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 70% for 0.5s. If this skill hits an enemy, Phoveus's next Demonic Impact will leave behind an Astaros Eye.

Astaros Eye: Implodes after a short delay, dealing 100/130/160/190/220/250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Magic Damage to the enemies.

abilities.name: Dark Wave
abilities.description: Phoveus lowers his monolith and releases his demonic power in the target direction, knocking enemies airborne, dragging them along, and dealing 250/300/350/400/450/500<scaleAD> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage>.

abilities.name: Infernal Pursuit
abilities.description:
Sinner: Demonic Force, Astaros Eye, and Dark Wave can apply Sinner's Mark to the enemy hero hit.

Judgment: Phoveus leaps into the air and smashes down with his monolith at the enemy hero with Sinner's Mark, dealing 250/375/500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) plus extra Physical Damage equal to 5/7.5/10% of the target's Max HP to enemies in the area while Phoveus recovers 50 plus 6% of his Lost HP.

The HP recovered is reduced by 80% when hitting multiple enemies.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Phoveus should use his enhanced Basic Attack to charge at the enemy while knocking them back and marking them. Then immediately follow up with his Ultimate. Next, hit the target with his 1st Skill, then use his 2nd skill and his Ultimate again. Finally, use the enhanced 1st Skill to mark the enemy once more, and use his Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Phoveus should first use his enhanced Basic Attack to hit the enemy hero and gain a shield. Follow up with his 1st Skill to chip away their HP, then use his enhanced 1st Skill for additional damage and to slow the target, and end with his 2nd Skill for more damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Tanks with good initiation like Gatotkaca, Minotaur, and Tigreal can create opportunities for Phoveus to maximize his damage while they take some of the incoming damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Enemies with multiple mobility abilities can greatly reduce Phoveus's cooldowns, so he can use his enhanced Basic Attacks and skills more often when facing heroes like Wanwan, Arlott, and Chou.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Phoveus will struggle against ranged heroes with strong CC, such as Aurora, Valir, and Vexana.

abilities.name: Theory of Everything
abilities.description:
Natan gains a stack of Entanglement each time he or his Reverse-Clone hits an enemy with a skill (up to 6 stacks). Each stack lasts 2.5s and grants 7.5% Attack Speed and 5% Movement Speed.
