Natan's Basic Attack projectiles will return to Natan after reaching the maximum range, dealing an extra 30 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).
abilities.flavor_text: Time is nothing more than a descriptor of space...

abilities.name: Superposition
abilities.description: Natan shoots a dense mass of energy in the target direction, dealing 225/260/295/330/365/400<scaleAD> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <scaleAP>(+120% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in its path.
abilities.flavor_text: There is no "collapse."

abilities.name: Interference!
abilities.description:
Natan launches a Gravitational Attractor in the target direction, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+600% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and knocking them back.
The Attractor detonates upon reaching the maximum range, dealing 30/35/40/45/50/55 (+10% Total Physical Attack) (+12% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back.
abilities.flavor_text: There is only "decoherence."

abilities.name: Entropy?
abilities.description:
Natan summons a Reverse-Clone that lasts 10s at 6 units away. The Reverse-Clone copies his moves and attacks in reverse and inherits 35/37.5/40% of his Basic Attack and skill damage.
Use Again: Natan switches places with the Reverse-Clone.

Each cast reduces other skills' remaining cooldowns by 50%. The Reverse-Clone will disappear if Natan is too far away.
abilities.flavor_text: Entropy can decrease.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, summon a Reverse-Clone with Natan's Ultimate, then use his 2nd Skill followed by his 1st Skill to knockback and damage enemies, and finish with a barrage of Basic Attacks. Depending on the situation, Natan's Ultimate can also be used to chase or escape.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Natan's 1st Skill and Basic Attacks to chip away at the enemy. When their HP is low enough, use his 2nd Skill to knockback the enemy and finish them off with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Natan's Ultimate allows him to blink a great distance, so he works best with initiator heroes such as Johnson and Alpha because he can dive with them and unleash a lot of damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Natan is strong against Tanks with low mobility such as Tigreal and Gatotkaca because he can easily avoid their control abilities with his UIltimate and get more hits in with his Basic Attacks on slower targets.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Natan is countered by heroes with targeted control and high burst like Saber and Eudora that can lock him down and finish him off.

abilities.name: Fighting Spirit
abilities.description:
After dealing damage, Aulus adds a stack of Fighting Spirit to his axe per second for 4s (up to 4 stacks). Each stack grants 7.5 (+0.5*Hero Level)% Attack Speed. At max Fighting Spirit stacks, Aulus's Basic Attack is enhanced and gains Attack Range.

Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus slams his axe into the ground, dealing 160 (+20*Hero Level) (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Aulus, Charge!
abilities.description:
Aulus starts accumulatingFighting Spirit, removes all slow effects, and gains 30/34/38/42/46/50% extra Movement Speed for 5s.

If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2s, he will enter the Enraged state and gain Control Immunity.

abilities.name: The Power of Axe
abilities.description:
Aulus swings his axe, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Upon hitting an enemy, Aulus can cast this skill again to dash forward and smash the ground, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Cleaving Axe
abilities.description:
Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing 150/210/270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing 450/630/810 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a large area.

During this skill, Aulus gains 20/30/40% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Aulus's 1st Skill to gain Movement Speed and Control Immunity to quickly enter the fray. Use his 2nd Skill's second cast to get onto key targets, then activate his Ultimate and stay on them for continuous damage. Finally, use his enhanced Basic Attacks to clean up the battlefield.

combos.name: JUNGLER COMBOS
combos.description: When ganking in the early game, use Aulus's 1st Skill for Movement Speed and Control Immunity to quickly close in on the target. Then, use his 2nd Skill to slow them while weaving in Basic Attacks. Use his 2nd Skill again to stay on the target, and activate his Ultimate to chase while dealing damage, then finish them off with his enhanced Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Aulus is a dive Fighter and he thrives with reliable ranged Support, such as Angela and Floryn.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Aulus's strong engage and sustained combat capabilities, along with his Control Immunity, makes him a good counter to squishy, low-mobility heroes like Hanabi, Miya, and Gord.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Since Aulus's damage relies on landing his enhanced Basic Attacks, heroes who can keep him at bay and avoid them are a tough matchup, such as Franco, Melissa, and Karina.

abilities.name: Invisible Armor
abilities.description:
Aamon enters the Camouflage state each time he hits an enemy with a skill, during which he cannot be targeted, recovers 25 (+15% Total Magic Power) plus 3% of his lost HP every 0.5s, and gains 80% extra Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3s.
Upon leaving the Camouflage state, Aamon immediately resets his Basic Attack's cooldown and enhances his Basic Attacks within the next 3s. Each enhanced Basic Attack deals 70 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+115% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The first attack after actively leaving Camouflage is enhanced to deal 84 (+120% Total Physical Attack) (+138% Total Magic Power) damage and reduces all skill cooldowns by 1s.
abilities.flavor_text: For generations, the Invisible Armor has been used as the symbol of the greatest power in House Paxley.

abilities.name: Soul Shards
abilities.description:
Passive: Aamon charges his armor through enhanced Basic Attacks or while camouflaged. At 5 charges, Aamon throws 6 shards at the target on his next attack, each shard dealing 50/60/70/80/90/100 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The shards will then scatter around the target.

Active: Aamon throws a shard at a nearby enemy, dealing 175/200/225/250/275/300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

abilities.name: Slayer Shards
abilities.description:
Aamon throws a shard forward, dealing 120/140/160/180/200/220 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way. The shard will return to Aamon after a short delay and allow him to enter the Camouflage state.
If the shard hits a non-minion enemy, it'll slow them by 50% for 2s and return to Aamon immediately.

abilities.name: Endless Shards
abilities.description:
Aamon throws all shards at a designated enemy and slows them by 30% for 1.5s. After a short delay, the shards will fly to the enemy's location again, each dealing 35/40/45 (+10% Total Magic Power)-70/80/90 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

The number of shards increases with Aamon's armor charges and the shards on the ground (8-25).
The damage dealt increases with the target's lost HP, to the max when the target's HP is below 30%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Use 2nd Skill to Camouflage and flank the enemy. Deal damage with his 1st Skill and Basic Attacks, and Ultimate to take out backline heroes.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use his skills and Enhanced Basic Attacks for very high jungling efficiency.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Support heroes that can provide buffs such as Rafaela and Floryn.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Squishy heroes with low mobility such as Layla and Hanabi.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Tanky heroes or those that deal damage over time such as Balmond and Fredrinn.

abilities.name: Primal Force
abilities.description:
Valentina gains 8-50 extra EXP each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2s.
If the enemy hero's level isn't higher than Valentina's, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP. The EXP scales with Valentina's level.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.description:
Valentina casts Shadow Strike in the target direction, dealing 475/520/565/610/655/700 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.
Enemy heroes hit by Shadow Strike are marked with a Shadow Sigil for 4s and will be terrified for 1s when hit by Shadow Strike again within the duration (a unit can only be terrified once within 4s).

abilities.name: Arcane Shade
abilities.description:
Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal 90/108/126/144/162/180 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each. Valentina can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana).

The cooldown of Shadow Strike is reduced by 1s each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy.

abilities.name: I Am You
abilities.description:
Valentina slows the target enemy hero by 70% for 0.5s and gains the ability to cast their Ultimate. Casting the enemy's Ultimate turns Valentina into the enemy hero's form and allows her to inherit their Basic Attack type for up to 12s. Her skills remain unchanged unless the enemy's Ultimate has a Morph effect.
The stolen Ultimate's level will be equal to Valentina's Ultimate level and the Ultimate cooldown will be 120% of the target's Ultimate cooldown (but no lower than 10s). Valentina gains (+100% Total Magic Power) Physical Attack for the duration if the enemy is a Physical Damage hero. This cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Copy an Ultimate or use 2nd Skill for better positioning. Use 1st Skill and reset its cooldown with 2nd Skill, then Terrify the target and use her copied Ultimate to secure the kill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Use 1st Skill to poke, then 2nd Skill to refresh its CD, and 1st Skill on the same enemy again to cause Terrify.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Heroes that can buff or CC such as Carmilla and Atlas to give her more opportunities to deal damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Heroes that lack mobility or burst such as Hanabi and Faramis are suspectible to Valentina's low cooldown skills that provide soft CC and sustained damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Heroes with gap closers or high burst like Hayabusa, Natalia, and Hanzo.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.description:
After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3s, during which all Basic Attacks will trigger chain lightning, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to (+20% Total Magic Power) plus 3(+0.2*Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to up to 4 enemies.
Chain lightning damage against Minions is increased to 150%.

abilities.name: Earth Shatter
abilities.description:
After a 0.75s delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing 225/270/315/360/405/450 (+10% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies hit (deals 120% damage to minions) and knocking them airborne for 0.8s.
This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

abilities.name: Divine Retribution
abilities.description: Edith exacts Divine Retribution on a target area, dealing 170/200/230/260/290/320<scaleAP> (+40% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. She then continues to deal 68/80/92/104/116/128<scaleAP> (+16% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies in the area every 0.5s over the next 1.5s.

abilities.name: Onward
abilities.description:
Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing 90/100/110/120/130/140 (+3% Total HP) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.

If Phylax hits an enemy hero during the charge, it will stop immediately and throw them over its shoulder, dealing 108 (+5% Total HP) Physical Damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.description: Edith fires a Lightning Bolt in a designated direction, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s.

abilities.name: Primal Wrath
abilities.description:
Passive: When inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath according to the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction).

Active: Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing 35/50/65 (+75% Total Physical Attack) (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Edith also gains new skills in this state. When in flight, Edith gains 350/500/650 (+5% Total HP)-350 (+20% Total HP) extra Shield, 50%-150% extra Attack Speed and 5%-20% Hybrid Lifesteal based on the Wrath she accumulated, and converts each point of Extra Physical Defense and Extra Magic Defense into 3.5 Magic Power. The flight state lasts up to 8/10/12s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Edith's 2nd Skill to toss the enemy behind her, followed by her 1st Skill to knock them airborne then immediately use her Ultimate. Now use Edith's 2nd Skill in human form to immobilize the target, followed by her 1st Skill for more damage, and secure the kill with enhanced Basic Attacks.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Edith's 2nd Skill to toss the enemy behind her, then use her 1st Skill to knock them airborne and finish them off with enhanced Basic Attacks from her Passive.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Edith works best with heroes like Minotaur and Atlas that can more reliably CC a target first, allowing her to follow up with her own CC.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Edith is strong against heroes that are not very agile and on the fragile side, such as Zilong and Aulus, because her skills deal enough burst damage to eliminate them after connecting with her 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Edith is countered by Marksmen that can negate CC like Hanabi and Wanwan, since she will have a hard time locking them down.

abilities.name: Dew
abilities.description:
Dew's Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount.

After leaving combat for 5s, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30s cooldown), which will grant them a 100 (+70% Total Magic Power) shield each time they are healed by Floryn.

Floryn will never sell the Lantern.

abilities.name: Sow
abilities.description: Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at the target enemy, dealing 180/210/240/270/300/330<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage>. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their <scaleHP>HP</scaleHP> by 175/185/195/205/215/225<scaleAP> (+90% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP>.

abilities.name: Sprout
abilities.description: Floryn casts a blob of energy ahead that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 175/210/245/280/315/350<scaleAP> (+90% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.7s (and revealing their positions briefly).

abilities.name: Bloom
abilities.description: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, recovering 250<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <scaleHP>HP</scaleHP> for all allied heroes 2 times no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regen effects by 12% for 2s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Floryn's 2nd Skill to CC enemies, and her 1st Skill for damage and healing. When a teammate is in bad shape, use Floryn's Ultimate to save them.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Floryn's 2nd Skill to stun enemies, then follow up with her 1st Skill for damage and healing.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Floryn works well with tanky Fighters, such as Terizla and Thamuz, because they are easier to keep alive with heals and can peel enemies off of her.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Floryn excels at sustained healing and counters Tanks with low damage output, such as Uranus and Lolita.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Floryn is countered by high mobility and burst damage Assassins, like Karina and Saber.

abilities.name: Leave It to Me
abilities.description: If there are no allied heroes within 4 units of Yin, his damage is increased to 120% and he gains 8% Spell Vamp.

abilities.name: Charged Punch
abilities.description:
Yin gains 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3s).
During this time, his next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 25/40/55/70/85/100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the enhanced Basic Attack hits an enemy, Yin throws a charged punch forward, dealing 360/400/440/480/520/560 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path.
Successfully throwing the charged punch reduces the skill's cooldown by 35%.

abilities.name: Frenzy Strike
abilities.description:
Lieh smashes enemies forward 9 times. During this time, he is immune to control effects, and his smashing speed gradually increases. Each smash deals 120/130/140/150/160/170 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies by 75% for 0.2s.
After 0.8s, Lieh can move or cast skills to cancel the skill early.

abilities.name: Instant Blast
abilities.description:
Yin dashes forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind while dealing 75/90/105/120/135/150 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4s if an enemy hero is hit.
After 1s, the Golden Ring will catch up with Yin, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1s.

abilities.name: Instant Blast
abilities.description:
Lieh strikes a flying kick forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind while dealing 75/90/105/120/135/150 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. Enemies hit will also be knocked back slightly. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4s if an enemy hero is hit.
After 1s, the Golden Ring will catch up with Lieh, dealing 150/180/210/240/270/300 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1s.

abilities.name: My Turn
abilities.description:
After a short delay, Yin locks onto an enemy hero (cannot lock onto pets or clones) and pulls them into a domain for up to 8s and turns into Lieh. When in the domain, the two cannot be affected by other heroes' skills.
Lieh has stronger skills and 50/65/80 extra Physical & Magic Defense that last 8s.
The domain will end early if either of the two is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he'll recover 20% of his Max HP, leave the domain with the cooldowns of Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast reset, and continue to fight as Lieh for 8s.
If Yin fails to pull his target into the domain, the skill will enter a 3s cooldown.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Yin should use his 1st Skill to gain Movement Speed and then his 2nd Skill to get close to a key enemy and hit them with his enhanced Basic Attack before trapping them in his Ultimate. In Lieh form, use his 2nd Skill to stun the enemy and finish them off with his 1st Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Yin should use his 1st Skill to gain Movement Speed, then use his 2nd Skill to dash behind the enemy so the Golden Rings will stun them on their return, and end with his enhanced Basic Attack.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Yin works best with Supports that can enhance his mobility, such as Mathilda and Rafaela to help him get to the enemy and eliminate key targets.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Yin counters squishy heroes without Blink skills like Layla and Cecilion because they will have a hard time dodging his Golden Rings. Once they are stunned or trapped in his Ultimate, Yin can easily finish them off.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Yin is countered by Fighters that can interrupt skills, such as Fredrinn and Badang, because they can easily interrupt his Ultimate during the initial delay. These heroes can also hold their own in a duel, making them risky targets for Yin's Ultimate.

abilities.name: Doll Buster
abilities.description:
"My tailor shop excels at fixing and 'fixing' dolls. Am I right, Muddles?"

(Melissa deals 125% damage to Minions, Creeps, and Summoned Units.)
abilities.flavor_text: Uh-oh, Melissa's taken apart another bunch of dolls!

abilities.name: Falling!
abilities.description:
"Watch me slide forward and increase my Attack Speed by 50/55/60/65/70/75% for 3 seconds— Ah, that was just boring…"

"Muddles, go that way!"
"Cuddles, come here!"
abilities.flavor_text: Melissa is falling... In your dreams!

abilities.name: Eyes on You!
abilities.description:
The plan's like this: Throw Muddles out to hold down the bad guys, and then… I come on stage!
"I puncture the bad guys, while Giggles hit Muddles to punish them as well! Hee, fantastic!"

(Muddles deals 175/200/225/250/275/300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on the first hit and links nearby enemies for up to 6s. Linked enemies are slowed by 60% that decays over 1.5s and can break the link by moving out of the range. Muddles will return to Melissa early when there are no enemies around and immediately if she's too far away. When Muddles is present, you can tap the Attack Minion button to directly attack Muddles, though it cannot trigger the multi-hit damage. Giggles only hits Muddles when Melissa has a target for her Basic Attack.)
abilities.flavor_text: Go, Muddles!

abilities.name: Go Away!
abilities.description:
Cuddles, protect me! For 4 seconds, let no bad guys come close. Unless I say otherwise!

(Upon activation, Melissa gains a 300/500/700 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield and knocks back enemies in the area, dealing 500/700/900 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemies attempting to enter the field are knocked back, taking 50/70/90 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowed briefly.
Movement skills are interrupted unless the target has Control Immunity.
The field will move with Melissa once, when she's about to move out of the boundary.)
abilities.flavor_text: Did you know? Hugs will give you the courage to face the darkness.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Link enemies with her 2nd Skill for increased damage. Use 1st Skill to keep them linked and her Ultimate to stop enemies from getting close.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Link the enemy with her 2nd Skill and use Basic Attacks to deal extra damage. Chase enemies trying to flee with her 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description:
Tanks that can chain CC such as Tigreal and Minotaur,
allowing her to keep enemies linked.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Fighters like Sun and Zilong that can't get past her Ultimate.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Long range Mages such as Xavier and Nana.

abilities.name: Transcendence
abilities.description:
When Xavier's skills hit enemy heroes, he gains 50% Movement Speed for 1.2s (decays over time) and 1 energy charge. At 3 charges, his next skill triggers the Transcendence state.
Transcendence:: In this state, Xavier's Skills 1 and 2 have their cooldowns reduced by 4s, and his Ultimate by 36s. Transcendence lasts 5s and can be extended by 1s each time his skills hit enemies.

abilities.name: Infinite Extension
abilities.description:
Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 480/514/548/582/616/650 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it passes through.

The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the Mystic Barrier (up to 5 times).

abilities.name: Mystic Field
abilities.description:
Xavier conjures a Mystic Barrier that lasts 5s. Enemies that come into contact with the Barrier will take 220/244/268/292/316/340 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and be slowed by 50%, while allies will gain 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s.
When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a Mystic Field for 3s, dealing 220/244/268/292/316/340 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

abilities.name: Dawning Light
abilities.description:
Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 600/850/1100 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies along its path.

Once cast, he also directly enters the Transcendence state and resets the state's duration.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Cast Xavier's Ultimate to enter or refresh Transcendence, then try to hit as many enemies as possible with his 2nd Skill, and follow up with his 1st Skill to create a forbidden field to immobilize enemies. Continue casting his 1st Skill to extend Transcendence's duration while going for kills.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Xavier possesses great poke with his 1st Skill and can utilize the slow from his 2nd Skill to make targets easier to hit. This combination allows him to quickly reach Transcendence. When the opportunity arises, use his Ultimate to finish off an enemy and while in Transcendence state.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: He works well alongside heroes that can buff or provide CC to give him more opportunities to deal damage, such as Carmilla and Atlas.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Xavier possesses short cooldowns, a soft CC, good sustainability and performs well against heroes without Blink or burst damage, such as Hanabi and Faramis.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Xavier is countered by heroes with high mobility that can quickly close a gap such as Benedetta, Hayabusa, and Natalia.

abilities.name: Smith's Legacy
abilities.description:
After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9-6s Cooldown (decreases with his level).
After casting any skill, his Basic Attacks for the next 2s will deal 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and pull the target toward him (deals 85% damage to Creeps). Casting another skill extends the duration.
Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5s each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).

abilities.name: Scythe
abilities.description:
Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 420/490/560/630/700 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.
The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.

abilities.name: Enhanced Scythe
abilities.description: Julian hurls enhanced scythes in the target direction, dealing 420/490/560/630/700<scaleAP> (+140% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies along the way and slowing them by 50% for 1s.</br>Upon hitting a non-minion enemy or reaching the maximum distance, the scythes will continue to fly at a lower speed, dealing 80/105/130/155/180<scaleAP> (+30% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> every 0.3s to nearby enemies (up to 8 times).

abilities.name: Sword
abilities.description: Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing 400/435/470/505/540<scaleAP> (+80% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies along the way.

abilities.name: Enhanced Sword
abilities.description: Julian summons a large number of flying swords and dashes in the target direction, dealing 75/85/95/105/115<scaleAP> (+15% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> every 0.1s to enemies along the way (up to 9 times).</br>Julian's untargetable and invisible during the dash.

abilities.name: Chain
abilities.description: Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 300/335/370/405/440<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

abilities.name: Enhanced Chain
abilities.description: Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 40/45/50/55/60<scaleAP> (+10% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> every 0.2s to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%.</br>Enemies that are still in the area at the end of the skill duration will take 250/280/310/340/370 (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> extra <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and be knocked airborne for 0.8s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Julian can slow the enemy with his 1st Skill before dashing into the enemy battle formation with his 2nd Skill. Then use his enhanced 3rd Skill for area CC.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Julian can use his 2nd Skill to close in on the enemy, and his 3rd Skill to immobilize them. Then he can use his enhanced 1st Skill to deal damage. Follow up with his enhanced Basic Attacks to prevent the enemy from escaping.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Julian works best with powerful support heroes who can buff him, like Angela and Diggie.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Julian is a hero who can constantly grow his own advantage, so he is strong against heroes who are weak in the early game, like Cecilion and Aldous.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Julian needs to hit enemy heroes with his skills to bring out his potential, so he is countered by heroes with good Mobility. Such as Joy and Harith.

abilities.name: Crystalline Armor
abilities.description:
Fredrinn gains 1 Combo Point that lasts 5s each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 Combo Points. His Ultimates cost different numbers of Combo Points.

Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy, which decays after 5s at a rate of 10% Max HP per second.
Fredrinn can convert the stored Crystal Energy into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a Combo Point resets the decaying timer.

abilities.name: Piercing Strike
abilities.description:
Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125/150/175/200/225/250 (+7% Total HP) (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85/95/105/115/125/135 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.

abilities.name: Brave Assault
abilities.description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140/155/170/185/200/215<scaleAD> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3s.

abilities.name: Energy Eruption
abilities.description:
Fredrinn deals 210/270/300 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25/35/45 Physical & Magic Defense for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Brave Assault by 75%.
This skill costs 1 Combo Point.

abilities.name: Appraiser's Wrath
abilities.description:
Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600/800/1000 plus 21/28/35% of his Crystal Energy as Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion ratio based on damage dealt to enemy heroes from stored Crystal Energy to HP.
This skill costs 3 Combo Points.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Fredrinn should use his 2nd Skill to close in on the enemy hero and knock them airborne, then use his 1st Skill and 1st Ultimate for CC and cooldown reset. Use his enhanced Basic Attacks, 1st and 2nd skills sequentially to deal heavy damage, and finish with his 2nd Ultimate after knocking the enemy airborne for the kill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Fredrinn can dash to the enemy hero with his 2nd Skill, and knock that hero airborne with the enhanced Basic Attack. Then follow up with his 1st Skill to deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Fredrinn works best with support heroes, who can further improve his survivability, like Angela and Floryn.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Fredrinn is strong against Mage heroes who rely on skill bursts, as it is difficult for them to one-shot him with their bursts. Instead, once Fredrinn has enough Combo Points, he can use his 2nd Ultimate to easily finish them off. Such as Vale and Eudora.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Fredrinn is countered by Marksman heroes who can deal True Damage, as they can take him down very easily. Heroes like Kerrie and Lesley are good examples here.

abilities.name: Humph, Joy's Angry!
abilities.description:
Joy becomes Angry! each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the Leonin Crystal will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target.

Joy's Basic Attack will deal 65 (+65% Total Physical Attack) (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

abilities.name: Look, Leonin Crystal!
abilities.description: Joy summons a <highlight>Leonin Crystal</highlight> at the target location, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAP> (+40% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The <highlight>Leonin Crystal</highlight> lasts up to 2s.

abilities.name: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!
abilities.description:
Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120/138/156/174/192/210 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8s and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80/90/100/110/120/130 (+60% Total Magic Power) shield that lasts 3s.

This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

abilities.name: Ha, Electrifying Beats!
abilities.description:
Joy increases her Physical & Magic Defense by 15/20/25 (+10% Total Magic Power) and gains 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 3s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120/160/200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time to nearby enemies.
Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy! cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active.
This skill unlocks when Joy acquires Beat Energy. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy will remove all debuffs on Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Joy should summon a Leonin Crystal with her 1st Skill and use it as a springboard for her 2nd Skill to enter the battle. Continue to chain her 2nd Skill on the beat to unlock her Ultimate. Finally, use her Ultimate to finish off the enemy.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, Joy should place her 1st Skill on top of the enemy, then use her 2nd Skill to dash through both targets and continue to chain her 2nd Skill on the beat for damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Joy works best with heroes with that can provide powerful support or have strong initiation, like Angela and Hylos.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Joy is strong against heroes that lack mobility or rely on CC, like Xavier and Vexana, because she has an easier time hitting them with her 2nd Skill while being immune to their CC's.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Joy is countered by heroes that can restrict mobility skills, such as Minsitthar and Khufra, due to her kit's heavy reliance on her 2nd Skill.

abilities.name: Star Trail
abilities.description: <highlight>Astral Spheres</highlight> summoned by Novaria will continuously slow nearby enemies by 20% and grant vision of them.

abilities.name: Astral Meteor
abilities.description: Novaria summons an <highlight>Astral Sphere</highlight> at the target location, continuously dealing 75/90/105/120/135/150<scaleAP> (+25% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> every 0.33s and applying a continuously increasing slow effect (up to 2.5 times the original). After 2s, the <highlight>Astral Sphere</highlight> explodes, dealing <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> equal to 260/285/310/335/360/385<scaleAP> (+50% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> (+4% target's Max HP) <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and applying 2.5 times the slow effect.

abilities.name: Astral Recall
abilities.description:
Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at a distance and draws it towards her. At the same time, Novaria gains 20% Movement Speed and can pass through terrain. Passing through a wall will increase the Movement Speed bonus to 60%.

When the Astral Sphere reaches Novaria, she can cast Star Shatter to launch it in a target direction within 5s. The sphere will explode when hitting an enemy hero, dealing Magic Damage equal to 230/260/290/320/350/380 (+70% Total Magic Power) plus 4% of the target's Max HP. The damage will increase based on the Astral Sphere's travel distance (starting from when the sphere is summoned), up to 2.5 times the original damage.

abilities.name: Astral Echo
abilities.description: Novaria scatters <highlight>Astral Echo</highlight> in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% while applying <highlight>Astral Ring</highlight> on them, increasing their hitbox by 2.5 times and revealing their surrounding area. This effect lasts 5s.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Novaria's Ultimate to gain vision of the battlefield, then summon an Astral Sphere with her 2nd Skill. After catching the Astral Sphere, launch it to damage the enemy and use her 1st Skill to thwart enemy heroes that try to get close.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, initiate by using Novaria's 2nd Skill to gain extra Movement Speed and summon an Astral Sphere. Then, slow the enemy with her 1st Skill and use her 2nd Skill again to launch the Astral Sphere to deal damage.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Novaria works well with other long-range heroes like Beatrix and Layla because her Ultimate makes any target a sitting duck for her team to pick off.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Novaria counters Mages with shorter range and low mobility, such as Eudora and Odette, because these heroes can't reach Novaria while Novaria can hit them with her 2nd Skill.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Novaria is countered by Assassins with strong targeted burst damage, such as Saber and Hayabusa, because they can easily close in on Novaria and burst her down.

abilities.name: Demon Gaze
abilities.description:
Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will Mark enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 7s.
The eye will also automatically Mark a nearby enemy hero in vision every 7s.

abilities.name: Dauntless Strike
abilities.description: Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing 200/240/280/320/360/400<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and briefly stunning targets in an area. Targets hit by the farther part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

abilities.name: Vengeance
abilities.description:
Arlott charges at an enemy, dealing 135/165/195/225/255/285 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement).
If Arlott's target is Marked, he gains a brief burst of Movement Speed, and this skill will deal double damage, immediately refresh its cooldown, and recover 70/110/150/192/230/270 (+60% Total Physical Attack) HP to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit).

abilities.name: Final Slash
abilities.description:
Passive: Each level-up reduces Demon Gaze's interval by 1s.
Active: Arlott cleaves in front of him, dealing 400/600/800 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to targets in the area while pushing them to the end of the AOE and briefly revealing their location (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression).

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, start by hitting a marked enemy hero with Arlott's 2nd Skill, then get into position to unleash his Ultimate on the enemy team to CC and mark them. Use Arlott's 2nd Skill to cut through the enemy from target to target. When all marks have been used up, use his 1st Skill to CC and mark enemies again, and continue to chain his 2nd Skill.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, after Arlott's Passive marks an enemy hero, use his 2nd Skill to dash through them and get a cooldown reset. Follow up with his 1st Skill to CC the enemy and mark them again, then hit them with his 2nd Skill while resetting its cooldown.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Arlott works well with Tanks who can initiate with CC, such as Gatotkaca and Atlas. Their CC will also mark enemies for Arlott, allowing him to use his 2nd Skill even more for tons of damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Arlott counters Fighters with relatively lower HP, such as Sun and Zilong. Arlott can deal high burst damage and has excellent chasing and control abilities, allowing him to quickly eliminate more fragile Fighters.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Arlott is countered by tanky Fighters that can withstand lots of damage, like Thamuz and Fredrinn, because he lacks the burst to take them out quickly and will lose in a prolonged battle.

abilities.name: Siphon Starlium
abilities.description:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the stacks and be replaced with Siphon Starlium, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) (+200 Lifesteal) plus (+10*Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only 10(+150 Lifesteal)% against non-hero units).
Siphon Starlium can trigger on all enemies in front of Ixia that are within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot Crit.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

abilities.name: Dual Beam
abilities.description:
Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 100/130/160/190/220/250 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and slowing enemy heroes by 50%. Upon hitting an enemy hero, Ixia also gains 2 Movement Speed for s.

Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

abilities.name: Star Helix
abilities.description: Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies, and pulling enemies in range to the center line after a short delay and dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAD> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>.

abilities.name: Full Barrage
abilities.description: Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the <highlight>Barrage</highlight> state for 4s. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in the large fan-shaped area in front of her but not outside it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and <highlight>Siphon Starlium</highlight> will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Choose the perfect location that can secure herself and cast the Ultimate to rain down her attacks on as many enemies as possible. Keep tapping Basic Attack while using her 2nd Skill and 1st Skill to control enemies and deal extra damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Ixia can pull enemies to the center line with her 2nd Skill and follow up with her 1st Skill to deal damage. Use the Movement Speed boost provided by her 1st Skill to chase down enemies.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: With her Ultimate, Ixia is capable of dealing impressive sustained damage. So she works best with heroes with area CC abilities, like Atlas and Vexana.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Ixia's skills make her a nice kiter. She works well against heroes with short ranges or poor Slow abilities, such as Fredrinn and Bane.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Ixia lacks survivability, that's why she can be countered by heroes with high burst damage or strong control abilities such as Saber and Aamon.

abilities.name: Dimensional Rift
abilities.description:
Nolan's skills will leave a Rift. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will activate and pull enemies to their center and deal 240 (+140% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a short delay. Each time a rift activation hits an enemy, Nolan will gain 20 Energy. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced by 40%.
Cosmic Leap: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5s, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a Rift. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)
abilities.flavor_text: The father who swore to protect the shining star.

abilities.name: Expansion
abilities.description: Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230/280/330/380/430/480<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and leaving a <highlight>Rift</highlight> at the first enemy hit.
abilities.flavor_text: The scholar that explored the edge of universe.

abilities.name: Gauge
abilities.description: Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70/100/130/160/190/220<scaleAD> (+13% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies in his path and leaving a <highlight>Rift</highlight>.
abilities.flavor_text: The wayfinder that measured the distance of the stars.

abilities.name: Fracture
abilities.description: Nolan slashes at the target location 3 times, dealing 120/150/180<scaleAD> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> with each slash while leaving 3 rifts and slowing the target hit by 30% for 0.5s. The rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan dashes backward.
abilities.flavor_text: The hero that finally returned home.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, approach the enemy using Nolan's 2nd Skill and enhanced Basic Attack, then activate the rift with his 1st Skill. Use Nolan's 2nd Skill to dash through the enemy, and unleash his Ultimate to activate all the rifts while dashing back to safety.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Nolan's 2nd Skill and enhanced Basic Attack to catch the enemy, then use his 1st Skill to activate the rift. Follow up with his 2nd Skill into his 1st Skill to activate another rift explosion.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Nolan works well with Tanks that can initiate and CC the enemy so Nolan to focus on dealing as much damage as possible, such as Tigreal and Gatotkaca.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Nolan counters squishy heroes that lack mobility skills like Hanabi and Eudora because they have a hard time avoiding his rifts while Nolan's own mobility makes them easy targets.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Nolan is countered by tanky heroes with high sustained damage, such as Thamuz and Fredrinn, who can survive Nolan's burst and kill him afterwards.

abilities.name: Performer's Delight
abilities.description: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 0.75% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects at full stacks.

abilities.name: Yo-Yo Blitz
abilities.description:
Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the nearest enemy within range (prioritizing heroes) for 3.5s, hitting them up to 10 times, and dealing Physical Damage equal to 65/70/75/80/85/90 plus 3/3.3/3.6/3.9/4.2/4.5 (+1.2% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's Max HP per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack.

If there is no enemy within range, Yoyo will attack Turrets or the Base instead.

This skill deals 20% extra damage to Minions.

abilities.name: Buoyant Bounce
abilities.description: Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including Turrets and Base), she can leap again in the Joystick's direction. If she lands on an enemy with the first leap, she deals 200/220/240/260/280/300<scaleAD> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to them.

abilities.name: Curtain Call
abilities.description:
Cici throws Yoyo at the target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing 100 (+10% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together for 4s.

During this time, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one target is within the range of Yo-Yo Blitz, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25/35/45%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, find two enemy heroes that are close together and toss Cici's Ultimate on one of them, then use her 2nd Skill to jump in and pop her 1st Skill mid-leap to start dealing continuous damage.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Cici's Basic Attacks to stack some Delight before using her 1st Skill on the opponent, and use her 2nd Skill if they attempt an escape.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Cici works well with heroes that have buffs and can boost survivability. Supports like Angela and Floryn can help Cici gain an early advantage by greatly amplifying her combat capabilities to end the game before it drags on too long.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Because of Cici's great kiting ability and her 1st Skill dealing Max HP damage, Cici counters certain Tanks like Fredrinn and Minotaur.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Cici is countered by heroes with targeted CC skills who can stop her dead in her tracks, such as Saber and Kaja.

abilities.name: Snack Time!
abilities.description: Chip starts eating potato chips once every 2s when out of combat, regenerating HP equal to 300 plus 45% of lost HP after finishing a whole bag (requires 4 bites). After eating a bag of chips, Chip will be full and cannot eat again for 5s. (The bite count will be saved if he enters combat before finishing a whole bag.)
abilities.flavor_text: Yummy...yummy

abilities.name: Crash Course
abilities.description: Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> equal to 100/120/140/160/180/200 plus 4% of target's Max HP and applying <highlight>Chip's Mark</highlight> on enemy heroes hit. Chip gains a 300/400/500/600/700/800<scaleAP> (+60% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> Shield upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with <highlight>Chip's Mark</highlight>, detonating the mark to deal 150/175/200/225/250/275<scaleAP> (+30% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and stun each target for 0.6s.

abilities.name: Overtime
abilities.description:
Chip rushes for 2s, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2s.

Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing 200/220/240/260/280/300 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back slightly.
abilities.flavor_text: Sunshine and beach, I'm coming

abilities.name: Shortcut
abilities.description:
Chip drops the Main Portal on an enemy hero, dealing 200/250/300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 25%. The Main Portal deals 2 times the damage and immobilizes them for 1s after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates Connecting Portals near allied heroes 10 units away and behind the allied Base. The Main Portal and Connecting Portals last up to 15s.
Connecting Portal: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from Connecting Portals to the Main Portal, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5s and a 500/750/1000 shield.
Main Portal: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the Main Portal for 2s to return to the Connecting Portal they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time.
abilities.flavor_text: Get it done and let's leave work early.

abilities.name: Why Walk?
abilities.description: Chip has 4 fixed <highlight>Beacons</highlight> on the map when the battle starts. Use this skill to teleport to any other <highlight>Beacon</highlight>. (This skill cannot be used in combat.)

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Chip's 2nd Skill preemptively to build up speed, then hit a target with his Basic Attack and deploy the Main Portal with his Ultimate. Follow up with his 1st Skill on the enemy and another Basic Attack to stun them while the Main Portal's delayed effect slows them, and continue the fight as allies portal in.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: When ganking, use Chip's 2nd Skill to quickly get behind the target and knock them into your team with the enhanced Basic Attack, then follow up with his 1st Skill and another Basic Attack to stun them.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Chip's Ultimate allows his team to group up from anywhere, so he works well with heroes who can't cross the map quickly but excel in teamfights, such as Alpha, Hanabi, and Kadita.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Chip possesses strong initiation and CC abilities, making him a great counter against heroes with low mobility or those who are relatively squishy, such as Vexana, Layla, and Ixia.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Since enemies can also use Chip's Connecting Portals, certain heroes with strong teamfighting abilities, like Barats and Tigreal, can use them to their advantage.

abilities.name: Crimson Butterflies
abilities.description:
Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 5% of her Max Mana.
Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.

abilities.name: Fluttering Grace
abilities.description: Zhuxin deals 150/162/174/186/198/210<scaleAP> (+30% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of <highlight>Soul Snare</highlight>. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20/24/28/32/36/40% and gains 20/24/28/32/36/40% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Lantern Flare
abilities.description:
Hold: Hold the skill button to move the Spirit Lantern. It deals 35/44/53/62/71/80 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies within range every 0.33s (Magic damage increases to 60% against Minions) and applies Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit. When an enemy hero has 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies will capture them, pulling them airborne for 1s.

Release: Throws all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200/240/280/320/360/400 (+150% Total Magic Power) +10/11/12/13/14/15% of the captured target's Max HP as Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. If an enemy is hit multiple times, subsequent hits deal 80% less damage.

After a target is captured, Soul Snare cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15/17/19/21/23/25% increased damage to that target.

abilities.name: Crimson Beacon
abilities.description: Zhuxin blinks to the target location while gaining a 400/550/700<scaleAP> (+100% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> shield. While flying, she creates a field around her for 6s. The field deals 60/75/90<scaleAP> (+20% Total Magic Power)</scaleAP> <magicDamage>Magic Damage</magicDamage> and applies 1 stack of <highlight>Soul Snare</highlight> to enemies every 0.5s.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Zhuxin's 1st Skill to slow the opponent and increase her own Movement Speed, then use her 2nd Skill from a safe position and try to hit the Minions and the opponent at the same time to both poke and clear the lane. Once the enemy has enough stacks, throw them into the Minions for additional damage.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, use Zhuxin's Ultimate to blink into a good position, then follow up with her 1st Skill to slow the enemy team and use her 2nd Skill to build stacks at a safe distance. Try to capture as many enemies as possible with her 2nd Skill, then throw them out of position while also grouping them up.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Zhuxin can provide great damage and CC, but she can't realize her potential until later in the game, so heroes with CC can help Zhuxin get through the early period. Zhuxin also works well with sustained damage heroes like Belerick, Kimmy, and Cici to dish out a surprising amount of damage.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Zhuxin is a good counter to enemies with less range and low mobility, such as Popol and Kupa and Cyclops, where she has a big advantage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Like most Mages, Zhuxin is countered by heroes with high mobility and burst, such as Fanny and Saber, who can quickly take her down.

abilities.name: Transient Immortal
abilities.description:
Tap-casting any skill will put Suyou in his Mortal form, granting him 40 Movement Speed and decreasing the interval between Basic Attacks.
Hold-casting any skill will put Suyou in his Immortal form, increasing the damage of Basic Attacks to 125% and granting him 20% Physical Damage Reduction. In this form, for every 20 extra Physical Attack Suyou has, he gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction (up to 40%).

abilities.name: Blade Surge
abilities.description:
Tap: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250/270/290/310/330 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375/420/464/510/555 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250/270/290/310/330 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6s. The charge distance increases with the hold time.
Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

abilities.name: Soul Sever
abilities.description:
Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing Physical Damage equal to 280/320/360/400/440 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) plus 15% of target's Lost HP to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Hold: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal 225/260/295/330/365 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the final strike deals 360/416/472/528/584 (+128% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovers 150/170/190/210/230 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) HP for himself.

abilities.name: Evil Queller
abilities.description:
Tap: Suyou glides backward and swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420/460/500/540/580 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and on his path backward, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s.
Hold: Suyou uses the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580/635/690/745/800 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target hit. The range increases with the hold time.
Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: Hold-cast Skill 3 to poke before the team fight, then hold-cast Skill 1 to engage and control the enemy at their back, then hold-cast Skill 2 to deal massive damage. Then tap-cast Skill 3 to keep your distance from the enemy, and when the skill cooldown is up, tap-cast Skill 1 and Skill 2 to quickly kill the target.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Hold-casting Skill 1 in the Bush allows Suyou to attack unexpectedly and control the enemy; then hold-cast Skill 2 to deal massive damage and follow up the Basic Attack by tap-casting Skill 3 to leave the battlefield.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Heroes that provide control (like Tigreal) make it easier for Suyou to deal massive damage; heroes that provide recovery and extra movement speed (like Rafaela) help Suyou kite better.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Suyou's powerful long-range burst and pursuit abilities make it impossible for heroes without Blinks or Charges, such as Xavier and Ixia, to escape.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Because Suyou requires hold-casting skills, heroes with control can easily interrupt his attacks, such as Badang and Melissa.

abilities.name: Hero's Resolve
abilities.description:
Lukas gains 0.5 Resolve per second and an additional 2 Resolve when attacking heroes.

Lukas consumes 10 Resolve per second while in [Sacred Beast] form.

abilities.name: Flash Combo
abilities.description:
Passive: Basic Attacks enhance Flash Combo up to 2 times, lasting 4s.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 220 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 5% of his Max HP when hitting a hero.
1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him.
2 Stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target and follows up with 2 attacks that deal 50/60/70/80/90/100 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit. He will then spin his tonfa hammers to deal 100/120/140/160/180/200 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, gaining Control Immunity during this period.

abilities.name: Flash Combo
abilities.description: <highlight>Passive</highlight>: Basic Attacks enhance <highlight>Flash Combo</highlight> up to 2 times, lasting 4s.</br>Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 220/280/340/400/460/520<scaleAD> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and recovering 8% of his Max HP when hitting a hero.</br><highlight>1 Stack</highlight>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 100<scaleAD> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him.</br><highlight>2 Stacks</highlight>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and follows up with 2 attacks that deal 50/60/70/80/90/100<scaleAD> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> per hit. He will then spin his tonfa hammers to deal 100/120/140/160/180/200<scaleAD> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> 3 times, gaining Control Immunity during this period.

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction and turns his next Basic Attack within 4s into Flash Strike.

Flash Strike: Lukas blinks behind the enemy, dealing 60/72/84/96/108/120 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He then gains increased Attack Range, 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed, and his Basic Attacks trigger lightning storms to deal 50/60/70/80/90/100 (+125% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage, lasting for 4s.

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction and turns his next Basic Attack within 4s into Lightning Clash.

Lightning Clash: Lukas charges toward the enemy, knocking them back and dealing 60/72/84/96/108/120 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed, and summons sacred lightning with Basic Attacks to deal 50/60/70/80/90/100 (+25% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage, lasting for 4s.

abilities.name: Unleash the Beast
abilities.description:
Lukas transforms into his Sacred Beast form (briefly gaining Control Immunity). His base Movement Speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15/17.5/20%, and his skills gain new effects.
Use Again: Fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450/775/1100 (+155% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and causing 3 aftershocks that each deal 0 Physical Damage.
All attributes: HP, Physical Attack, Attack Speed, Physical & Magic Defense, and Attack Range.

abilities.name: Shockwave Blast
abilities.description: The Sacred Beast fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction (gains Control Immunity during cast) that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450/775/1100<scaleAD> (+155% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: Lukas should use his 2nd Skill to close in on the enemy, then use the enhanced Basic Attack plus another Basic Attack to get 2 stacks of Vigor. Now use his fully powered 1st Skill to inflict high damage and stun and displace the target, then back off to avoid the enemy's counterattack.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In Sacred Beast form, use Lukas's 2nd Skill followed by an enhanced Basic Attack, then another Basic Attack to get 2 stacks of Vigor. Use his 1st Skill to inflict high damage and CC, and finish off with Shockwave Blast to devastate the enemy with a massive AOE attack.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Lukas's Sacred Beast form has extended attack range and enhanced mobility, which synergizes well with heroes possessing AOE CC, such as Atlas, Tigreal, and Gatotkaca.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Lukas excels in close-quarter combat and is a good counter to heroes with low mobility and CC, like Hanabi and Ixia.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Lukas needs to stay close to enemies to deal damage, which makes him vulnerable to heroes with strong burst and CC, such as Fanny, Valir, and Julian.

abilities.name: Surge of Life
abilities.description:
After casting a skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she will absorb the Water Zone to enhance her next three Basic Attacks with different effects:
First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 140 (+8*Hero Level) (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 40 (+10% Total HP) (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for herself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP.
Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, dealing 70 (+4*Hero Level) (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and creating a new Water Zone. Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Wavebreaker
abilities.description: Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 200/230/260/290/320/350<scaleHP> (+5% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Tidal Strike
abilities.description:
Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience) while dealing 150/175/200/225/250/275 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a Water Zone during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150/175/200/225/250/275 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience).

abilities.name: Tsunami Slam
abilities.description: Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction (drag the Joystick to change landing spot). She gains Control Immunity during this process. Upon landing, deals 300/400/500<scaleAD> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to the target and nearby enemies.

combos.name: Laning Combos
combos.description: While ganking with Kalea, use her 2nd Skill to close in and CC the target, then use her 1st Skill to activate her enhanced Basic Attacks and unleash them on the target.

combos.name: Teamfight Combos
combos.description: In teamfights, Kalea should prioritize enemy Mages or Marksmen. Use the first part of her 2nd Skill to dash into an obstacle near the target, then dive down to CC them, and follow up with her Ultimate to slam them into your team. Use her 1st Skill to trigger her Passive, and unload her enhanced Basic Attacks on the target.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Kalea's strong single-target CC makes her work well with heroes who have high single-target burst, like Eudora, Harley, and Clint.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Kalea counters heroes who lack mobility like Layla and Chang'e.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: However, Kalea cannot grab enemies with Control Immunity, so heroes like Diggie and Minotaur can effectively counter her.

abilities.name: Celestial Armament
abilities.description:
Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s, stacking up to 10 times.
Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who dares approach her while dealing 90(+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. She also gains a 300(+20*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Shield that lasts 3s. This effect has a 120s cooldown.

abilities.name: Phoenix Strike
abilities.description:
Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave, up to 3 times. While casting, Zetian can use other skills.

The 1st, 2nd and 3rd Phoenix Waves deal 150/175/200/225/250/275 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, 150/175/200/225/250/275 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and 360/420/480/540/600/660 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, respectively. The third wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect).

The Spell Vamp ratio is limited to 65% against Minions.

abilities.name: Phoenix Descent
abilities.description:
Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150/170/190/210/230/250 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20/24/28/32/36/40 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10/12/14/16/18/20% while revealing their surrounding area.
While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

abilities.name: Fury of the Phoenix
abilities.description:
Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40/50/60% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400/550/700 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time.
Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

combos.name: Teamfight Combos
combos.description: In teamfights, use Zetian's Ultimate to boost her team's Movement Speed and launch the global attack, then immediately use her 2nd Skill to slow enemies, making it easier for the Ultimate to land. Follow-up with her 1st Skill for more AoE, and recast the 2nd Skill if enemies try to leave its range.

combos.name: Laning Combos
combos.description: In the laning phase, Use Zetian's 2nd Skill to slow the enemy and reduce their Magic Defense, then use her 1st Skill while moving to reposition and deal sustained damage. If enemies leave the area of the 2nd Skill, use it again to move the Phoenix on top of them.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: While Zetian already has decent survivability, when paired with supports who can protect allies like Floryn and Rafaela, Fighters with limited range will struggle even more to approach Zetian. And with the healing from these supports, Zetian can win any ranged battle of attrition.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Zetian's Passive counters melee heroes with limited gap closers like Balmond and Zilong, allowing her to continue poking the enemy from a safe distance.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Zetian's Ultimate can strike down anywhere on the map, but having such a powerful Ult means a hero like Valentina can also use it against Zetian's team.

abilities.name: Return to Bone
abilities.description:
Obsidia gains Bone Energy whenever she deals damage. Basic Attacks grant 1 Energy against non-hero units and 2 against hero units. Skills grant Energy equal to 3 times the amount granted by Basic Attacks against the same unit type. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps.

When Bone Energy reaches 30, it forms a Bone Shard, up to 25 shards. Killing an enemy hero directly grants 1 Bone ShardBone Shards strike the target, each dealing (+6% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inheriting 6% Attack Effects.

Obsidia's Basic Attacks deal 70 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, inheriting 100% Attack Effects.

abilities.name: Abyssal Bone Needle
abilities.description: Obsidia launches an <highlight>Abyssal Bone Needle</highlight>, dealing 325/360/395/430/465/500<scaleAD> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit and triggering <highlight>Return to Bone</highlight> on the first enemy hero struck.

abilities.name: Phantom Shadowmeld
abilities.description: Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters <highlight>Shadowmeld Form</highlight>, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

abilities.name: Hunt of Bone
abilities.description:
Obsidia shoots Bones of Wrath in the target direction, dealing 125/175/225 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit, and pulls herself near them. The Bones of Wrath then tether to the enemy, preventing Obsidia from moving more than 4 units away from them. The enemy cannot use displacement skills, and their movement will pull Obsidia along. During this time, Obsidia gains 5 temporary Bone Shard(s). This effect lasts 3s.
During this time, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving. Phantom Shadowmeld is enhanced, with its duration increased to 1s and cooldown reduced to 33%.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: During teamfights, use Obsidia's Basic Attacks and 1st Skill to poke the enemy, and her 2nd Skill to reposition herself. Look for opportunities to close in on a target with her Ultimate and pick them off with your team. Finally, use her mobility and powerful Basic Attacks to clean up the remaining enemies.

combos.name: Laning Combos
combos.description: During the laning phase, use Obsidia's 1st Skill often on enemy Minions and heroes to quickly stack her Passive. When the enemy's HP drops low enough, use Obsidia's 2nd Skill and Ultimate on them and finish them off with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Obsidia usually reaches her damage potential in the mid-to-late game, so she wants support heroes who can help her in the early game, like Angela and Estes.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Obsidia's Ultimate will disable dash and blink skills, making her excellent at countering heroes who rely on them,  such as Hayabusa, Freya, and Lancelot.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Obsidia struggles during the early laning phase, making her vulnerable to other Marksmen with strong early game, such as Bruno and Layla.

abilities.name: Mystic Surge
abilities.description:
Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent by using his Ultimate. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. At 5 stacks, he unlocks his True Art.
Thunder: Converts 30% Max HP into Physical Attack at 10% ratio, adopting an assassin style.
Torrent: Converts each point of 30% Physical Attack into 10 Max HP, adopting a tank style.

abilities.name: Sundering Strike
