abilities.description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140/156/172/188/204/220<scaleAD> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, then lunges forward, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440<scaleHP> (+5% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. He can dash after striking.

abilities.name: Sundering Strike - Thunderflash
abilities.description: Sora strikes four times, dealing 140/156/172/188/204/220 <scaleAD>(+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, then lunges forward, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440 <scaleHP>(+5% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. He can move freely during this skill.

abilities.name: Sundering Strike - Overwhelm
abilities.description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140/156/172/188/204/220 <scaleAD>(+50% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, and slowing enemies for 40%. He then lunges forward, dealing 240/280/320/360/400/440 <scaleHP>(+5% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, stunning enemies for 0.5s.

abilities.name: Windstride
abilities.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140/152/164/175/188/200<scaleAD> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches max range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional 140/152/164/175/188/200<scaleHP> (+8% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2s.

abilities.name: Windstrike - Thunder Rush
abilities.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 120/132/144/156/168/180 <scaleAD>(+45% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>. Upon hitting a hero or reaching the max distance, he summons a thunderstorm, dealing 120/132/144/156/168/180 <scaleHP>(+6% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing enemies by 50% for 0.5s. This skill can be cast again within 4s if it hits an enemy.

abilities.name: Windstrike - Skyfall
abilities.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140/152/164/176/188/200 <scaleAD>(+55% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage>, knocking enemies airborne, and knocking them back to the landing point. He then smashes the ground, knocking enemies airborne for 0.5s, dealing 140/152/164/176/188/200 <scaleHP>(+8% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and slowing them by 50% for 1s.

abilities.name: Shifting Skies
abilities.description:
Swipe left to ascend into Thunder for 10s. Sora gains a brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 time(s), each dealing 140/170/200 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Swipe right to ascend into Torrent for 10s. Sora gains Control Immunity. After a short delay, he pulls nearby enemies in and deals 250/350/450 (+8% Total HP) Physical Damage.

abilities.name: Heaven's Wrath
abilities.description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes a target area 16 times, dealing 60/80/100 <scaleAD>(+40% Total Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

abilities.name: Stormbind
abilities.description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes a target area 5 times, dealing 100/125/150 <scaleHP>(+6% Total HP)</scaleHP> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> and briefly stunning enemies with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In mid-to-late game teamfights, Sora is able to adapt to different situations. He can ascend to Thunder form to dive the enemy backline, or Torrent form to become a CC machine and take control of the battlefield.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: When the opponent is focused on clearing Minions, poke them with Sora's 1st Skill, then use his 2nd Skill to create distance. Use the mobility from his 1st and 2nd Skill to effectively kite enemies. Sora's damage is reliant on hitting with his 1st Skill.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Sora's transformed Ultimate deals considerable damage, and pairing him with Tigreal, Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and other strong CC heroes will maximize Sora's damage potential.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Sora excels at diving in with explosive burst damage and AOE CC, so squishy heroes without escape abilities—like Layla, Miya, and Hanabi—will find themselves helpless against Sora's relentless assault.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Sora relies on landing his 1st Skill to get Cloudstep stacks. Heroes with high mobility or Knockbacks, like Fanny, Arlott, and Valir, can prevent Sora from gaining this precious resource.

abilities.name: Platinum Snap
abilities.description:
Marcel's split soul, Clemar, enters the camera to freeze the moment. His Basic Attacks deal 50 (+40% Total Physical Attack)(+40% Total Magic Defense)(+40% Total Physical Defense) Physical Damage. His Extra HP is converted into 1.5% Hybrid Defense.

Clemar automatically snaps photos of enemy heroes near Marcel, causing a brief Frozen Moment and dealing 20 (+ 5% of Max HP) True Damage (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target.

abilities.name: Framed Moment
abilities.description:
Clemar focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within by 60%.
After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing 350/420/490/560/630/700 (+50% Total Physical Attack)(+120% Total Magic Defense)(+120% Total Physical Defense) Physical Damage to enemies within.

abilities.name: Tracking Shot
abilities.description:
Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters the Tracking Haste state for 3s, gaining 15/17.5/20/22.5/25/27.5% Movement Speed. This bonus increases to 75/82.5/90/97.5/105/112.5% when moving toward an enemy hero.

Use Again: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind while the Framed Moment area remains at the original location.

abilities.name: Golden Hour
abilities.description:
Marcel and Clemar perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, Clemar takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 2s. During this time, Marcel enters the Tracking Haste state while inside the area. All other units in the area are put into a Frozen Moment and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay (targeted projectiles will deal 50% damage).

Golden Hour resets the cooldown of Platinum Snap for each enemy hero.
Allied heroes with the Platinum Snap shield can move freely within the area.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, Marcel should activate his 2nd Skill, followed by his 1st Skill. Run into the enemy's formation, then use the 2nd Skill again to dash away and drop his 1st Skill on top of them. Once the enemies are immobilized, use his Ultimate.

combos.name: LANING COMBOS
combos.description: During the laning phase, use Marcel's 2nd Skill to run up to the enemy and cast his 1st Skill. While the enemy is immobilized, lay into them with Basic Attacks.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Marcel is more effective against low-mobility heroes, such as Layla and Vexana, as they are easily caught by his Ultimate, allowing him and his allies to secure easy kills.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: Heroes who possess Invincibility or Untargetable effects that can bypass Marcel's CC, like Ling and X.Borg, will reduce his impact on the battlefield.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Because of Marcel's excellent AOE CC, he pairs well with allies with high AOE damage, like Hanabi and Ixia, to maximize their damage potential.

abilities.name: Twin Fans: Ukifane
abilities.description:
Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.

Hirara has 2 Crimson / Death Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 Crimson / Death Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of Meisen-e. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.

Hirara only deals 30(+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

abilities.name: Meisen-e
abilities.description: Hirara rides the waves using <highlight>Meisen-e</highlight>, performing up to two <highlight>joystick dashes</highlight> (the first dash goes in her facing direction). She deals 150 <scaleAD>(+50% Extra Physical Attack)</scaleAD> <physicalDamage>Physical Damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit.

abilities.name: Falling Maple
abilities.description:
Hirara enhances Kaerazu with the power of Meisen-e to cast a combo skill.
She becomes untargetable and immobilized for up to 1s.
After 0.6s, she deals 3.5 times Crimson Maple damage, and can then cast the second joystick dash of Meisen-e to end these states early.

abilities.name: Kaerazu
abilities.description:
Hirara uses Kaerazu to unleash the Crimson Maple, dealing 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

After a short delay, she deals damage again at the target location, dealing 2 times the initial Crimson Maple damage.

abilities.name: Infernal Torrent
abilities.description:
Hirara enhances Meisen-e with the power of Kaerazu to cast a combo skill.
After casting the first joystick dash of Meisen-e, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the Crimson Maple damage and immobilizing enemies for 0.8s.

combos.name: JUNGLE COMBOS
combos.description: In the laning phase, use Hirara's 1st Skill to close in, then use a 1st + 2nd Combo Skill to immobilize the target. Follow up with a 2nd + 1st Combo Skill to deal heavy damage and dash away to safety.

combos.name: TEAMFIGHT COMBOS
combos.description: In teamfights, wait for the enemy backline to become isolated and use Hirara's 1st Skill to dive in. Use a 1st + 2nd Combo Skill to deal damage and apply CC, then follow up with a 2nd + 1st Combo Skill to burst the target down and dash out of the enemy formation. Finally, use her 2nd Skill to deal additional damage.

relationships.title: weak
relationships.description: However, while Hirara is quick and nimble, she is also quite fragile. Against burst Assassins with targeted abilities, such as Saber and Natalia, it can be difficult to predict their attacks and use her 2nd + 1st Combo Skill in time. If she gets caught, she'll be taken down instantly.

relationships.title: assist
relationships.description: Hirara has high damage output in the early-to-mid game, but the delay in her skills makes landing them less consistent. Hirara works especially well with strong early-game heroes with CC, such as Angela and Minotaur, allowing her to build an early advantage more easily.

relationships.title: strong
relationships.description: Hirara's high mobility allows her to dive the enemy backline with ease, making her an excellent counter to squishy heroes who lack self-protection, like Ixia and Pharsa.The untargetable effect from Hirara's 2nd + 1st Combo Skill is great against delayed skills that deal high damage, giving her a big advantage when facing heroes like Yin and Gusion.
